description:
**Job Description**
**What if your next playground was to build a global, iconic Brand, with a creative machine that never sleeps, and compounds?**
Then you’ll love this.
  
  
We’re not looking for a "Social Media Manager" to follow a calendar. We’re looking for an AI-native Creative Director (Brand & Content).
  
  
Someone who understands that to win today, you don’t just need "content", you need a Movement.
  
  
**This isn’t another content job.**
Most content teams use AI to write captions faster. That’s the 99%. We want to be in the 0.1%: a media where AI runs the creative loop, from the signal to the hook, the cut, the post and the lesson. Every day, on every platform, in French and in English. You bring the taste. The machine you build brings the scale.
  
  
Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. We aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents.
  
  
**What Ai-native Content Means At Paradox 🤖**
Paradoxically, the more AI runs our content, the more human it has to feel. AI doesn’t make more of what everyone makes. It makes more of what only we can make.
  
  
**Our Creative Machine Has To Be Able To**

* Read the signals. Comments, DMs, retention graphs, saves, shares, search trends, objections from sales calls, and what the best creators and advertisers in the world are publishing right now.
* Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, years of interviews, lives and courses, member stories, and every past post with what it taught us, in one shared company brain.
* Generate in our voice. Hooks, scripts, shorts, carousels, cuts, thumbnails and captions, in French and in English.
* Ship. Format, schedule, publish and answer, on every platform.
* Measure with real KPIs. Retention, shares, saves, follower growth, and the followers who become leads and members. Not likes.
* Learn and loop on its own. Double down on what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content and wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.
  
  
**OUR MISSION**
At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken.
  
  
Most learning platforms are used the same way: consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.
  
  
People deserve more: a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.
  
  
That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.
  
  
**We Do That By Merging**

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.
  
  
**Short history**
Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION 🚀**
You lead the Content Factory not by management, but with creativity.
  
  
Your goal is to produce content that is so good, unique, and aligned with our values that people would cry if they had to unsubscribe.
  
  
In a classic content team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the volume, you design the machine, set the bar and make the calls. Humans do what no machine can: taste.
  
  
**🎯 YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**

* Architect the "Dual-Brand" Strategy
* Build a symbiotic strategy where David Laroche’s personal brand and Paradox’s company brand reinforce each other without cannibalization.
* Implement radical new formats (documentaries, conceptual shorts) that shatter the boring codes of the "Self-Help" industry.
* Define distinct, sharp editorial lines for each platform: Depth & Search for YouTube, Aesthetic & Vibe for Instagram, and Authority & Authenticity for LinkedIn.
* ❌ The old way: a strategy deck written once a year, and a calendar filled by habit.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents watch every platform, every competitor and every comment continuously. They tell you which angle is rising, which format is tiring and which story our audience asks for. The strategy updates every week, on evidence.
* Radical Concepting & End-to-End Delivery
* Take responsibility for the entire production chain from hooks to storyboarding the narrative, and ensuring the final cut matches the vision.
* Own the packaging: titles, thumbnails and the first 3 seconds. You test variants every week and know your click-through and retention numbers by heart.
* Deliver what you pitch.
* ❌ The old way: one shoot becomes one video and a handful of posts.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: one shoot, one live or one interview becomes dozens of hooks, shorts, carousels and ad cuts by the next morning, in both languages. Concepts are tested with AI-generated drafts before we spend a day shooting them.
* Build the Content Factory: humans and agents
* Your taste becomes the eval. You write down what makes a great hook, a great cut, a great carousel and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Act as the final quality check: nothing gets published if it doesn’t meet the "Paradox Standard" of aesthetics and storytelling, whether a person or an agent made it.
* ❌ The old way: a creative team briefs an editor, waits three days and gets two versions.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents draft, cut, caption, translate and schedule. You keep the best, and next week their first drafts are already closer to your bar.
* Fuel the Growth Engine
* Analyze retention graphs, CTR, and CPL to iterate based on feedback, killing what fails and aggressively scaling what works.
* ❌ The old way: someone pulls the stats at the end of the month and nobody changes anything.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents read the numbers of every post every day, explain why it worked or didn’t, and propose the next test. You measure the machine itself: posts per week, time from idea to live, hit rate, and the share of the work done without a human.
* Go global, and keep the soul
* We started in French. You build the machine that takes Paradox to English-speaking audiences: channels, formats and voice that feel native, not translated.
* And always: real stories told with consent, no fake claims, no fake scarcity. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

**How you’ll know you’re AI-native:**
you spend your time on concepts, taste and calls, not on resizing, captioning and exporting. The output grows every month while the team doesn’t.
  
  
**THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE 😍**
**Experience**

* Proven Content Builder: You have successfully grown a media brand, a YouTube channel, or a personal brand to significant scale (100k+ followers or millions of views). You understand the mechanics of virality and retention. You’ve created at least one format that broke out, and you can show its click-through and retention numbers.
* Elite Scripting Skills: You can show us scripts you wrote that performed. You know how to structure a narrative, write a hook that stops the scroll, and keep an audience engaged for 20+ minutes.
* Performance Fluency: You have worked in environments where content had to drive business results (ads, launches, conversion), not just vanity metrics.
* AI-native Creative: you’ve built content pipelines with AI yourself: Claude Code, automations, generative video, image and voice tools, evals. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

**Traits :**

* Intolerant to Mediocrity: You have "Taste." You are physically pained by a bad font, a clumsy cut, or a weak headline. You fight for the details that others ignore, including in what AI produces.
* Psychology Obsessed: You don’t just "make content"; you study human nature. You constantly ask why people click, why they share, and what emotion drives them.
* A "Doer" with Authority: You command respect not by title, but by competence. You can jump into a project, write the script, direct the shoot, and fix the edit if needed.
* Loop thinker: you see every platform as a loop that can learn, and you can’t stop yourself from closing it.
* No Ego, Just Impact: You don’t fall in love with your ideas. You accept that even the best concepts can flop. When it happens, you don’t take it personally; you analyze the data, pivot immediately, and ship the next concept with renewed energy.

**Language**
French: Native / Bilingual
  
  
English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.
  
  
Our chosen language for written communication is English.
  
  
**IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU**
❌ If you need clarity before chaos: wrong place.
  
  
❌ If you prefer balance over intensity: wrong season.
  
  
❌ If you don’t genuinely care about the topics we cover: wrong place.
  
  
❌ If you want to strategize without getting your hands dirty in scripting, directing, or the editing suite: wrong role.
  
  
❌ If you think AI content means generic content: wrong role. We use AI to multiply what only we can make.
  
  
❌ If you want to manage a large team: we’d rather build the machine than grow the headcount.
  
  
**WHY JOIN US ❤️**
Help us market a product that fuses neuroscience, design, and AI to reinvent how humans grow.
  
  
Build one of the first truly AI-native media, and write the playbook others will copy.
  
  
Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.
  
  
You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.
  
  
**Growth & Ambition**

* > 🏅 Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

**Competitive Salary**
But you don’t just want a competitive paycheck, you also want…
  
  
**Impact & Meaning**

* > Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people
* > Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something!

We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.
  
  
But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve…
  
  
**Freedom & Well Being 🗽**

* > 😎 A company culture based on autonomy & accountability
* > 🗽 Flexible working hours (but very hard working)
* > 🌎 A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want
* > 🧍‍♀️ Standing desks paid by the company if you live far from our offices
* > 💻 Work on Mac, for us it counts :)
* > 🏀 350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself (for your gym, or dance class or whatever make you feel great)
* > 📚 150€ of books or education - At Paradox, we are learner lovers and we want to support you in that
* > 🔥 Access to Athena - our Paradox AI Coach supporting you on anything personal or professional, we want you to live your best life

**How To Apply 📃**
⚠️ To complete the recruitment process, each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this : do not apply ⚠️
  
  
If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us 🚀🚀🚀🚀
  
  
**HIRING PROCESS 📃**
That job description resonated with you?
  
  
Here is your tailor made hiring process
  
  
📃 A 6 to 8 minutes application survey, with links to content you made and something you built with AI
  
  
💻 A 30mn video call with Timy, HR, to deep dive into your career path and ambitions
  
  
💻 A 1h video call, to discuss how you’d fit into Paradox’s content team
  
  
💻 A 1h culture-fit video call, to assess alignment with our values and mindset
  
  
💻 A 1h final video call with David, CEO, to discuss the creative vision and the next milestones to build
  
  
💼 Reference check to understand how you operate across environments and help set you up for a smooth onboarding
  
  
🫵🚀 Welcome aboard!
  
  
**About Our Hiring Process**
Our recruitment process is tailored to do our best to avoid that you or us realize that we’re not a perfect fit. Every step serves a purpose and will allow us to get to know you better as much as it’ll help you understand more where you’ll be stepping in.
  
  
We also want you to have time to ask all of your questions regarding the mission, the long-term vision of your team and the company, our values, with the relevant interlocutor in front of you.
  
  
If you’re not joining to post content.
  
  
If you’re here to build a media that changes how millions of people grow.
  
  
Welcome to Paradox.
  
  
Let’s build the Operating System for Greatness.

description:
### **About Point**

**✨ Real Impact, Real People:** Our mission at Point is to make homeownership more valuable and accessible. Your work directly helps homeowners access their wealth, achieve financial flexibility, and realize life changing goals.

**✨ Funding:** With over $175M raised from top investors like Andreessen Horowitz, WestCap, Greylock, and Prudential, we're scaling fast! You have the opportunity to join us at a pivotal stage.

**✨ Game-changing Product:** We're building a category defining company in home equity. We've earned a 4.7 Trustpilot rating and an A+ from the BBB, a testament to the value we provide to our 20,000+ customers.

**✨ Great Place to Work:** Our employees love working here! We are a Certified Great Place to Work and a Fortune Best Workplaces in the Bay Area.

**✨ Remote First Culture, Genuine Connection:** Work from anywhere in the U.S. while staying closely connected through virtual collaboration, team gatherings, and a people-first culture. Select roles may require onsite work at our Palo Alto office one day per week.

  

**Local or 100% Remote**

  

**About the role**

Point is hiring its first Creative Director to build and lead our creative studio. You'll own all campaign creative across paid social, display, direct mail, landing pages and brand, from concept through design, copy and video. This is a player-coach role: you'll do a meaningful share of the work yourself while you hire and develop a small, senior team. The brand team will more than double in 2027, and this is the first leadership hire, so you'll shape how the studio works from day one. Most homeowners have never heard of a product like ours, which puts creative at the center of how Point grows.

  

**Your responsibilities**

* Set Point's creative direction across paid, direct mail, web and brand, and hold the quality bar for everything the studio ships.
* Run a creative testing program with Growth Marketing: develop hooks, angles and concepts, read the results, and use them to decide what to make next.
* Lead campaign and performance copy for ads, direct mail and landing pages, working with Product Marketing to apply our messaging framework.
* Own the marketing design system and brand standards, and keep them consistent across channels, vendors and partner teams.
* Scale production through our creative vendor, managing quality, turnaround and spend efficiency.
* Hire and manage the studio: one existing designer today, a visual designer next, and a creative producer when volume calls for one.

  

**About you**

* Strong design communication skills, with the ability to articulate your vision and get people behind it.
* 9+ years in creative roles, including 5+ years leading designers and writers.
* A portfolio that shows both brand work and performance creative, with results you can speak to.
* Hands-on craft in design or copy, and the judgment to direct the other.
* Experience running creative testing in paid social and other performance channels.
* Experience managing agencies or production partners at volume.
* Experience in a regulated category such as lending, financial services or insurance, working through legal and compliance review.
* Interest and fluency in AI tools for concepting and production.

**Nice to have**

* Video and UGC production experience.
* Experience building a creative team from a small base.
* Experience marketing to homeowners or in consumer finance.

  

Compensation at Point will be determined by skills, experience, and geographic location. Point has identified the expected annual base salary for this role at this level based on the market by tiers (Region | Location | Market Salary):

* Tier 1 | San Francisco Bay Area, New York, and Seattle | $200,600 - $247,800
* Tier 2 | Austin, Boston, Chicago, Denver, Los Angeles, Miami, Philadelphia, Portland, Sacramento, San Diego, Santa Barbara & Washington DC | $182,800 - $225,750
* Tier 3 | All other US metro areas | $168,300 - $207,900

This does not include any other potential components of the compensation package, including equity, benefits, and perks outlined above. At the launch of each position, we benchmark compensation to the appropriate role and level utilizing competitive compensation data from various data sources as references. At the offer stage, we use the signal we received from our interviews, coupled with your experience, location, and other job-related factors, to determine final compensation.

  

Location Requirement: This is a remote position. However, candidates must reside in one of Point's states of operation: AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, KS, KY, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI.

### **Our benefits**

* **Generous health benefits:** We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans with options for flexible spending accounts (Health Care FSA) and health savings accounts (HSA).
* **Unlimited paid time off:** Recharge with unlimited paid time off and 10 company holidays.
* **Flexible remote and onsite work:** Our teams work from many different locations and time zones. We support fully remote work and also have an amazing in-person environment in our downtown Palo Alto, CA HQ.
* **Fully paid parental leave:** Point will supplement state Paid Family Leave (PFL) so employees receive 100% of their regular base pay, plus two additional weeks of fully paid leave after state PFL ends. In states without PFL, Point offers up to 8 weeks of paid parental leave. In addition, employees also receive 4 weeks of fully paid transition time, during which you may work 2–3 days per week while receiving full base pay.
* **Equity:** We offer meaningful equity because we believe in sharing the value you help create. Your contributions directly impact our growth, and your equity gives you a stake in our future success.
* **Financial wellness:** We provide 401K retirement plans for employees as well as guaranteed life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage.
* **Extra work/life benefits:** We provide monthly stipends for internet, mobile plans, wellness perks, a one-time home office reimbursement, and company provided equipment including a MacBook and monitor.

  

Point is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities regardless of age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected class. Each individual at Point brings their own perspectives, work experiences, lifestyles, and cultures with them, and we believe that a more diverse team creates more innovative products, provides better services to customers, and helps us all grow and learn.

title: Creative Director
description:
**Luxury Presence** is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 100,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We build the platform that helps high-performing real estate agents stand out in their market. Our own brand has to be the best example of an agent's aspiration for brand design. As we enter our next stage of growth, we're looking for a **Creative Director** to lead our in-house brand design team and set the creative standard for everything our customers and the market see from us.

You'll lead the design team and decide what great looks like on every surface. You'll have the authority to say a piece isn't ready, and the judgment to explain why in terms a designer can act on. You'll report to the SVP of Partnerships, Brand, and Community, and you'll work with our CEO on the work that carries the brand.

You'll do well here if you can spot the gap between good and great, close it with clear feedback, and still ship on the committed date. You use AI to get more out of a small team, and you hold every asset to the same standard whether an employee, a freelancer, or an agency made it.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

**The creative standard**

* Write and publish a quality standard with real examples for each surface, including web, email, video, social, and events, within your first 90 days.
* Review work and give specific feedback that raises it in a single round of revisions.
* By day 90, the CEO and SVP, Brand review your team's output and agree that 90% of randomly selected pieces meet the bar.

**A brand system that morphs**

* Own a brand system that flexes to the standards of each channel and context, so what good looks like differs by surface while the brand remains unmistakably one brand.
* Bring every surface up to the new standard by month 6, from website and product imagery to newsletters, YouTube, and our offices.

**The team**

* Lead, coach, and grow a small design team of fewer than five direct reports.
* Decide where in-house talent, freelancers, and outside firms each fit, and hold all of them to the same bar.

**Predictable, well-run delivery**

* Run design intake and delivery so requesters always know what is coming and when. By month 6, at least 90% of requests ship by the committed date.
* Get at least 85% of assets approved within one round of revisions, and end day-before creative notes on delivered work.
* Keep the team aligned to business priorities, and flag requests that are not aligned early and often.

**How You'll Work**
-------------------

You'll work closely with Brand, Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, and Product. You'll take feedback from senior leadership and partner teams, and you'll give it back just as directly. Politics have no place here, and the best work wins the argument.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

**Experience**

* 8+ years in design, with experience leading design teams.
* A portfolio of luxury or premium brand work that spans web, brand, and motion.

**Leadership and mindset**

* Exacting taste and the judgment to tell great work from good work.
* The ability to define a quality bar, explain it, and coach others to it.
* Full ownership of the output of the entire design function, including vendors and freelancers.
* Comfort influencing senior stakeholders, including the CEO.

**Technical foundation**

* Command of brand systems across web, email, video, social, and events.
* Strong process and operational habits for intake, prioritization, and review.

**Location**
------------

This is a remote role open to candidates in the United States, with a **preference for New York, Los Angeles, or Austin.**

**Join us in shaping the future of real estate**

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.

Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.

Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

**Primary Focus:**

As Director, Performance Creative Strategy at Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG), you are responsible for defining the strategic priorities, audience opportunities and learning agenda that shape Fanatics Casino performance creative. You'll uncover the hooks, angles and player insights most likely to resonate, translate them into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative team, and track performance to understand what works and why. This role is the strategic link between player insight, creative development and performance results, ensuring the right problems are being solved and that learnings continuously inform future briefs across acquisition, engagement and retention.

This position reports directly to the Senior Director, Performance Creative & GTM, and manages one Associate, Performance Creative.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the Casino performance creative strategy across paid social, app networks, CTV, affiliates and lifecycle, aligned with business priorities, audience insight and brand positioning.
* Build and evolve the Casino creative variation framework, mapping hooks, angles, reasons to believe, formats and offers to audience and funnel stage.
* Translate business objectives and player insight into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative agency, including scripts, hook variations and iteration briefs on winning concepts.
* Own the Casino testing agenda, defining what we want to learn, how we measure a win, and which tests run each month.
* Drive a high-velocity testing program across hooks, openers, formats, offers and creators, continuously improving hit rate and speed to learning.
* Partner with Media and Analytics to track creative performance, identify winners and fatigue early, and apply learnings to the next round of briefs.
* Write concise test readouts and maintain a living library of what works for Casino players.
* Identify and define the performance territories, audience tensions and messaging opportunities to support creative briefs
* Embed performance requirements into brand and full-funnel campaign briefs from the outset (in collaboration with integrated marketing and media), ensuring channel, audience, format and measurement needs are clear before creative development begins. Partner with the Casino Creative Studio to translate those requirements into effective creative, with the Studio retaining ownership of creative direction and execution.
* Advise Brand and agency partners on hooks, edits, cutdowns, aspect ratios and platform-native versions, so big campaign moments carry through to always-on performance and lifecycle.
* Source player insight, competitor ad libraries, creator content and platform trends to identify new angles and white space.
* Lead performance strategy/creative insight sessions and contribute a strong POV to creative brainstorms, working closely with the Casino Creative Studio.
* Present performance learnings and recommendations in GTM forums and monthly reviews, turning results into a clear story for senior leadership.
* Lead, mentor and develop an Associate, building their craft in briefing, analysis and testing.

**How This Role Connects Across the Team:**

* Partners with the internal producer, who owns production timelines and delivery, to keep briefs, priorities and the content calendar aligned.
* Partners with the Casino Creative Studio and Integrated Marketing to shape high-quality output, providing direction and feedback while respecting executional ownership.
* Partners with Brand and Integrated Marketing to embed performance best practice into campaigns, ensuring work is both distinctive and built to perform across the funnel.
* Partners with Media, Analytics and CRM to define success measures, read results and feed learnings back into strategy.
* Works with Legal, Compliance and Creative Operations to keep all creative compliant and aligned with Responsible Gaming standards.
* Partner with the affiliates teams to produce UGC briefs aligned to channel best practice, adapting content that's optimised for performance (via creative briefs)

**Skills & Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in creative strategy, performance creative or brand strategy, including 3+ years leading creative strategy for a fast-growing D2C brand, mobile app, gaming or casino business.
* Portfolio demonstrating hook-led, insight-driven creative and the performance results behind it.
* Deep knowledge of platform-native creative across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Snap and app networks, including UGC and creator formats.
* Proven track record building and running creative testing programs at volume.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to read performance data, size results and translate them into clear recommendations.
* Excellent storytelling and writing skills, from a 6-second hook to a campaign narrative to an executive readout.
* Experience influencing brand and integrated campaigns across matrixed teams without direct ownership.
* Experience managing and developing direct reports.
* Willingness to travel occasionally for team meetings and Fanatics events.

title: Creative Director (Organic Social)
description:
Marriage Reset is on a mission to save one million marriages. Our coaching programs help men rebuild their relationships and become better husbands. More than 7500 clients have enrolled, and our content has generated millions of views across social platforms.

We are hiring a Creative Director to take full ownership of our organic social department. Paid media currently drives most of our client acquisition. We want to build a stronger organic presence that earns trust in the brand and consistently generates qualified inbound calls.

Instagram is our main growth priority. You will be responsible for the content strategy and creative standards across all our organic channels, with the autonomy to lead the department and accountability for its performance.

**The role**

You will work directly with Josh Hudson, our co-founder and main spokesperson, to develop the brand’s organic content strategy. You will plan several months ahead, establish the monthly content agenda, and direct the work from initial concept to final approval.

Your responsibilities include developing content angles, writing scripts in Josh’s voice, and preparing recording briefs. You will run a content waterfall that turns long-form recordings into content tailored to each platform, with a consistent production and publishing schedule.

You will manage and develop the editors and copywriters, review their work, and take responsibility for the quality of everything we publish. You will also work with the wider marketing team to maintain a consistent brand across our digital presence.

Performance analysis will guide the strategy. Across all organic channels, you will assess audience growth and content performance, then work with sales to understand the contribution to qualified enquiries and booked calls. You will use that evidence to set priorities and improve results.

We expect you to take initiative, make informed creative decisions and lead the department without close supervision.

**Requirements**

* **Proven organic social growth |** A track record of growing an account for a founder, brand or yourself, supported by starting and ending audience figures, a clear timeframe and evidence of your personal contribution.
* **Strategic content leadership |** Experience developing content strategies over several months, directing production and adapting the plan based on performance. You must be able to connect day-to-day creative decisions to the wider business objectives.
* **Advanced copywriting and scriptwriting |** Strong command of hooks, storytelling and copywriting frameworks, with the ability to translate a founder’s expertise into compelling content that retains their voice.
* **Content waterfall implementation |** Experience building and managing a repeatable system for turning long-form recordings into short-form video and other content adapted to different platforms.
* **Management of both video editors and copywriters |** Direct experience setting briefs, reviewing scripts and edits, coaching team members, and holding them accountable for quality and deadlines.
* **Practical AI experience |** Experience integrating AI into content production or editing workflows, with editorial oversight to protect accuracy, quality, and brand voice.
* **Excellent written and spoken English |** The ability to write persuasive, natural copy for an English-speaking audience and communicate precise creative direction.

**Preferred experience**

We place particular weight on substantial growth achieved for a founder’s account, especially on Instagram. Candidates with strong results from their own accounts or other brands will also be considered.

* **Significant audience growth |** Adding around 100,000 followers to another person’s account, or growing your own account to that size, is highly valued. This is a preference, not a minimum eligibility requirement.
* **Coaching industry experience |** Experience in any coaching specialty is an advantage. We also consider candidates from other industries who meet the core requirements.
* **YouTube or other long-form audience growth |** A record of building an audience through long-form content.
* **Commercial results |** A demonstrable contribution to multimillion-dollar sales, with a clear understanding of how that contribution was measured.

**Working arrangement**

* This is a fully remote engagement under an independent contractor agreement, requiring a full-time commitment. The compensation package includes a base salary plus performance incentives linked to sales.
* Time zone and core working hours: EST/PST

**Applications**

* ***Please apply only if you meet the required criteria and can provide evidence of your experience. Applications that do not meet these requirements will not be progressed.***
* Applications must be submitted through this job posting or our website. Please do not send applications or follow-up enquiries by direct message.
* Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within ***one to two weeks*** of applying. If you have not heard from us within two weeks, your application has not been shortlisted.

*Thank you for your interest in Marriage Reset!*

description:

---------------

By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like True Classic, Native, Seed Health, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

About the Role
  
  
The Creative Director is the visual and conceptual voice of Stord. Reporting directly to the VP of Marketing, you will set the creative vision for how Stord looks, sounds, and feels across every channel, and lead the studio that brings it to life.
  
  
This role is for a hands-on creative leader who moves comfortably between big ideas and finished work. You have strong opinions about what great creative looks like, a portfolio that proves it, and the leadership skills to inspire a studio team and manage agency and freelance partners. You know that creative and performance work together, and you build campaigns that prove it for DTC founders, ecommerce leaders, and the broader commerce ecosystem.
  
  
You will partner closely with Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Content, and Sales to make sure Stord's creative is consistent, differentiated, and commercially effective at every touchpoint.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Creative Vision & Brand Identity**

* Own Stord's creative vision, visual identity, and brand expression, keeping them consistent and distinctive across all channels and audiences
* Turn Stord's positioning into a clear visual language, voice, and point of view that resonates with mid-market DTC founders and ecommerce operators
* Act as the creative steward of the brand: set standards, educate the organization, and push for quality at every touchpoint
Partner with Product Marketing so creative ladders up to GTM messaging and positioning  

  

**Creative Studio Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop the in-house studio of designers, creatives, and content producers
* Set creative direction and review work across campaigns, sales collateral, web, events, and product marketing assets
* Build efficient creative processes (briefing, intake, review, and approvals) so the studio delivers high-quality work at the pace of a high-growth company
Manage agency and freelance relationships to scale output when needed  

  

**Campaigns & Content Creative**

* Develop big ideas and integrated campaign concepts that bring the brand to life across digital, video, social, events, and owned media
* Direct the creative for thought leadership, video, and editorial content that earns attention and builds brand affinity with DTC founders and ecommerce leaders
* Partner with Demand Generation and Sales to create work that drives pipeline, and use performance data to sharpen it
Make sure all creative reinforces Stord's position as the default operating system for modern commerce  

  

**Brand Experience & Visibility**

* Guide creative for major company moments, including product launches, partnerships, and executive announcements
* Support executive visibility and PR efforts with strong creative storytelling and polished visual assets
Collaborate with Communications and Content on a consistent narrative across press, social, and owned channels  

  

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* 10+ years of progressive creative or marketing experience, with at least 4 years in a Creative Director or equivalent creative leadership role, ideally in VC-backed, high-growth B2B SaaS or tech-enabled services
* A strong portfolio showing concept-to-execution work across brand, digital, video, campaigns, and sales or product marketing assets
* Proven experience building or scaling a creative function from an early or underdeveloped state
* Deep fluency across creative direction, brand identity, design, and storytelling, with the judgment to operate at the strategic level without losing touch with craft
* Experience leading and developing in-house creative or studio teams, and the ability to attract, retain, and inspire A-players
* Experience managing agencies, freelancers, and production partners
* Comfort working as a player-coach: you set direction and hold a high bar, and you roll up your sleeves when the moment calls for it
Superior storytelling, presentation skills, and executive presence, with the ability to defend creative decisions and represent the brand with conviction  

  

**Leadership Competencies**
---------------------------

* **Creative Vision:** Turns complex positioning into simple, memorable ideas and visual systems that connect to commercial outcomes
* **Builder's DNA:** Thrives in ambiguity; builds the processes, standards, and teams where none existed
* **Creative Rigor:** Holds a high bar for quality while moving at the speed of a high-growth business; knows when to ship and when to push
* **Cross-Functional Influence:** Earns trust with Marketing, Sales, Product, and executive stakeholders; drives alignment without relying on authority
* **Coaching & Talent Development:** Gives clear, constructive feedback and grows creative talent at every level
* **Customer Obsession:** Uses voice-of-customer insight to inform creative decisions and keeps the DTC founder and ecommerce operator at the center of the work
* **UX Ownership:** Brings deep understanding and empathy for the user experience and owns translating it into exceptional, engaging design

  

**Education & Experience**
--------------------------

* 10+ years of creative or marketing experience, including 4+ years leading creative direction in a high-growth B2B environment
* Experience managing and scaling an in-house creative or brand studio
* Demonstrated ability to deliver integrated campaigns that drive measurable business results
* Bachelor's degree in design, communications, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* Bonus: prior experience in ecommerce SaaS, logistics, or commerce-adjacent technology

title: Associate Creative Director, Performance
description:
**About Sequencing**  
Sequencing is the world’s largest direct-to-consumer whole genome sequencing platform, helping define the future of AI-powered personalized health.

We’re a Series A venture-backed, fully remote company turning clinical-grade whole genome sequencing into meaningful, personalized insights. Through AI and a growing ecosystem of genomic applications, we’re building the trusted home for every genome.

In 2026, GenomeWeb named Sequencing a Best Places to Work winner, highlighting our fully remote culture of autonomy, transparency, and growth. As our COO, Shara Birn, put it: “We hire talented people, give them meaningful responsibility, and trust them to make decisions.”

**About the Role**

Sequencing.com turns clinical-grade whole genome sequencing into a lifelong source of personalized health insights, from everyday wellness questions to serious health decisions. We're rebuilding how that story looks, sounds, and performs, and we need an Associate Creative Director to lead it.

You'll define the new brand and make it earn its keep in paid channels. You'll work side by side with our product designers and agencies so the brand shows up in the product as clearly as it does in an ad. You report to marketing leadership and partner with growth, lifecycle, product marketing, and product design. This is a hands-on seat for someone who wants to ship, not just direct.

**What You'll Own**

* **The rebrand, end to end.** Lead our visual identity, voice, and creative language from concept through rollout across web, product, paid, and lifecycle.
* **Performance creative that works.** Concept, make, and iterate high-performing ads across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, CTV, and emerging AI-native channels. You live in the metrics and know why a creative won.
* **Partnership with product designers.** Work shoulder to shoulder with product design so the brand and the experience feel like one thing, from first ad to in-app moments to subscription flows.
* **Stories people trust.** Turn complex genomic data into clear, emotional, scientifically responsible stories that help people understand their genome and act on it.
* **Creative systems that scale.** Build templates, modular assets, and guidelines across acquisition, engagement, retention, and subscription so the team ships faster without losing quality.
* **Fast learning loops.** Run rapid experiments, read the results with growth, and turn what you learn into the next round.
* **A high, consistent bar.** Guide internal teammates, freelancers, and agencies, and stay close to the craft yourself: art direction, writing, design, motion, prototyping, and production.

**Who You Are**

* 8+ years in creative roles, with 2+ years leading creative or owning a brand at a startup or growth-stage company.
* Proven experience leading or driving a rebrand, ideally at an earlier-stage company where you built the identity and the system, not just applied one.
* A portfolio of performance creative with real results on Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or CTV in consumer subscription, DTC, wellness, or tech. You can show the numbers behind the work.
* Hands-on craft in design, video, motion, and creative strategy.
* A track record of working closely with product designers to bring a brand into the product experience.
* Solid digital marketing instincts: funnels, testing, attribution basics, and how creative drives acquisition and retention.
* You use AI tools every day for image, video, motion, copy, and ideation, and can show how they've made your work faster and better.
* Staying power. We value people who commit and grow in a role, so a history of multi-year tenures stands out.
* High ownership and autonomy in a fast-paced, fully remote environment. Experience leading teams, freelancers, and agencies is expected.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in wellness, healthtech, biotech, or another category where trust and science matter.
* Familiarity with design tools your product designers use (Figma) and comfort prototyping in them.
* Experience with lifecycle and subscription creative, such as email, onboarding, and win-back.

**Why Sequencing?**

For decades, the human genome has been one of the richest health information in the world, but most people have never been able to truly understand or use it. We’re changing that.

We're transforming billions of genetic variants and decades of scientific research into technology people can interact with naturally and trust. This isn't another health app. It's a new category that brings together bioinformatics, genetics, and consumer health.

**Your work won’t just help build Sequencing. It will help redefine how people understand themselves through their DNA for decades to come.**

**Benefits**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off
* Paid volunteer time off
* Fully remote work, with equipment provided and internet and cell reimbursements
* Parental bonding leave
* Private, confidential clinical-grade whole genome sequencing for you and your immediate family

*Join us in helping build the interface between humanity and its DNA!*

This position is assigned to the Non-Appropriated Fund (NAF) Fitness, Sports, and Deployed Forces Support Branch; Fleet Readiness; Commander, Navy Installations Command (CNIC); Naval Station Rota, Spain. Incumbent has oversight of the Fitness, Sports, and Aquatics programs at the installation. Additional programs (e.g. Deployed Forces Support) may be included based on need and installation size.

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

### **The public**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Military spouses**

Military spouses of active duty service members or whose spouse is 100 percent disabled or died on active duty.

### **Family of overseas employees**

Family members of a federal employee or uniformed service member who is or was, working overseas.

### **Clarification from the agency**

United States Citizens Worldwide, including local U.S. Citizens that are 1) Current permanent NAF/APF employees; or 2) Spouses of active duty military members; or 3) Family members of active duty military member; or 4) Family members of DoD civilians.

  

**Duties**
----------

**Program Management (includes but not limited to):**

* Plans, organizes, develops, implements, and manages a diverse and comprehensive fitness, sports, and aquatics program, within the scope of objectives and guidelines established at higher organizational levels, to include related facilities (e.g., group exercise classes; self-directed fitness sports, and aquatics programs; aquatics programs; incentive programs; special events; intramural, extramural and varsity sports; instructional programs; and awareness and education programs).

* Coordinates with city, state, other military bases, and pertinent organizations in establishing a well-rounded fitness and sports program and to effectively promote all aspects of health/wellness to the community.

* Coordinates with base organizations to ensure fitness advisory members are assigned and the bylaws and philosophy of fitness programs are thoroughly understood.

* Conducts meetings and hosts collaborated events/educational seminars/information fairs, etc.

* Maintains records of command participation and determines the winner of individual and base awards and makes arrangements for presentations.

* Interprets considerable data relating to program trends, costs, problems, and needs; refines ormodifies program methods and techniques based on findings.

* Prepares appropriated fund (APF) and NAF budgets, which include the expenditures required to conduct the fitness, sports and aquatics programs (categories A and B).

* Monitors contract services and properly performs quality assessment and evaluation (QAE) responsibilities.

* Completes local needs assessments and/or local surveys annually to determine customer needs and incorporates these finding into the annual program plan.

* Coordinates with marketing staff to plan and develop promotional advertising, commercial sponsorship, and publicity strategies.

* Assists local Command Fitness Leaders (CFL) in conducting and administering safe and proper Physical Readiness Tests.

* Solicits, interviews, selects, and directs volunteers and contract instructors for activities and specialty programs.

* Maintains appropriate records and submits deserving volunteers for recognition through the base volunteer recognition program.

* Reviews research publications and health journals to ensure currency in methodology and philosophy in the area of health and fitness (e.g., exercise physiology, life-style management, nutrition, and physical conditioning).

* Ensures the program meets or exceeds industry standards as established by governmental and private organizations such as the Cooper Institute, Presidents Council on Physical Fitness, Occupational Safety and Health Administration, Department of Defense (DoD), American College of Sports Medicine, etc

  
**Facility Management (includes but not limited to):**

* Coordinates the use and maintenance of indoor and outdoor facilities, which may include but is not limited to, gymnasium(s), fitness center(s), tennis court(s), swimming pool(s), softball field(s), jogging track(s), football field(s) and soccer field(s) to accommodate the comprehensive installation fitness, aquatics, and sports programs.

* Coordinates with and assists engineers on requirements related to construction of all new indoor and outdoor fitness and athletic facilities.

* Coordinates with Naval Facilities Engineering Command, and other base agencies (e.g., Safety Office) regarding requirements for maintenance and repair of fitness, sports and aquatic facilities and purchase and installation of new equipment.

* Develops a five-year facility improvement program to maintain a state of the art program, prepares construction plans for renovations/additions or expansion and submits work orders for all minor construction projects from inception to completion.

* Ensures inventory control of all property, equipment and supplies to protect government assets and determines replacement requirements levels.

* Takes timely and appropriate action to comply with safety, fire and environmental directions and ensures safe, healthy, contemporary, comfortable, and adequate facilities.

  
**Supervisory duties comprise 25% of incumbent's time and include but are not limited to:**

* Directs work to be accomplished by a staff that includes Fitness Coordinator, Sports Coordinator Aquatics Coordinator, Fitness Facility Coordinator, Outdoor Maintenance Supervisor and other subordinate staff.

* Assigns work based on priorities, difficulty and requirements of assignments, and staff capabilities.

* Conducts annual performance reviews of staff.

* Participates in MWR Fitness staffing decisions.

* Ensures staff receives proper training to fulfill requirements of their positions.

* Addresses potential disciplinary and/or performance issues timely and takes appropriate, corrective action(s) as necessary.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

* Occasional travel of less than 10% may be required.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a valid state driver’s license.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation and First Aid certification.
* Must have ability to maintain fitness/health certification from a National Commission for Certifying Agencies (NCCA) or Distance Education Accrediting Commission (DEAC).

### **Qualifications**

**KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED BY THE POSITION**
  
  
Knowledge of a wide range of principles, concepts and techniques that govern physical fitness programs which includes knowledge of exercise science, strength conditioning, nutrition, weight loss/control, cardiovascular endurance, exercise requirements and projected results.
  
  
Knowledge of bio-mechanics, fitness testing and exercise prescription supplemented with a knowledge of proper procedures in the use of strength training equipment, nutrition, exercise, physical fitness programming and testing equipment.
  
  
Skill in planning and executing a comprehensive fitness, aquatics, and/or sports program that includes a variety of fitness and aquatics activities and individual and team sports.
  
  
Knowledge of anatomy, physiology, and kinesiology as related to exercise and physical fitness.
  
  
Knowledge of military physical fitness standards and testing procedures.
  
  
Knowledge of the physical and psychological factors that impact training, performance and recovery of individuals and team sports.
  
  
Knowledge of CNIC's EEO policy and procedures.
  
  
Knowledge of NAF and/or APF budgeting processes including ability to prepare budgets.
  
  
Skill in the use of Microsoft Office Programs (e.g., Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook).
  
  
Knowledge of safety, fire and environmental regulations and procedures.
  
  
Ability to develop and effectively deliver presentations and/or training.
  
  
Skill in developing and adapting new methods, approaches and procedures for the most effective
  
management of a fitness program.
  
  
Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing

### **Education**

Per DoD MWR Fitness Standards (issued 21 July 2016) this is a supervisory position responsible for total facility oversight including operation, programming and staffing. While elements (a) through (c) are preferred, a combination of two of these elements may sufficiently qualify an individual to perform their duties as program director:
  
  
a) professional certification from a National Commission for Certifying Agencies (NCCA) or Distance Education Accrediting Commission (DEAC) accredited health/fitness organization.
  
  
b) competency in business and the design and delivery of exercise programs; and
  
  
c) at least three years of experience in the fitness industry/field for civilian personnel.

description:
### **Summary**

Ready to help shape the future of neuroscience drug development? As Clinical Development Medical Director, you will provide medical and scientific leadership across global clinical programs, helping translate innovative science into meaningful outcomes for patients. Working across multidisciplinary teams and with external experts, you will influence clinical strategy, guide high-quality trial delivery, and contribute to critical development and regulatory decisions in areas including neuromuscular and rare diseases.

### **About the Role**

**#LI-Hybrid**

**Primary Location:** London, UK

**Other Locations:** Barcelona, Spain

**Relocation Support:** This role is based in London, UK or Barcelona, Spain. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support: please only apply if accessible.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Provides clinical leadership, scientific and medical strategic input for all clinical deliverables in the assigned or defined program activities as applicable. Clinical deliverables may include (sections of) individual protocols consistent with the Integrated Development Plans (IDP) and CDP, clinical data review, program specific standards, clinical components of regulatory documents/registration dossiers, and publications.
* Leads development of clinical sections of trial and program level regulatory documents (e.g., Investigator’s Brochures, briefing books, safety updates, submission dossiers, and responses to Health Authorities).
* Drives execution of the section of the clinical program in partnership with global line functions, assigned Clinical Trial Heads (CTHs), and regional/country medical associates if applicable.
* Provides medical oversight and leadership of trials and may act as medical monitor. Provides input into final analyses and interpretation including the development of the Clinical Study Report(s) (CSRs), publications and internal/external presentations.
* Supports GPCH or Sr CDMD in ensuring overall benefit/risk assessment and monitor safety of the molecule for the assigned section on an ongoing basis and may be a core member of the Safety Management Team (SMT), and supports overall program safety reporting (e.g., Periodic Safety Update Reports (PSURs), Drug Safety Update Reports (DSURs), and other safety related documents) in collaboration with Patient Safety.
* May be assigned to provide medical input into IDP/CDP and CTP reviews and contributing/driving development of disease clinical standards for new disease areas.

As the medical/clinical lead interacts with and represents Novartis to global key opinion leaders and experts and may lead or co-chair steering committees for defined clinical trials or section of a clinical development program.

About the role
  
  
As Associate Director, Cloud Data Platform Architecture, you will define the technology strategy and architecture for cloud data platforms supporting the Novartis Drug Development portfolio. You will guide the delivery of secure, compliant, scalable and reusable platform capabilities supporting a wide range of data and AI use cases.
  
  
A key focus will be evolving an established, multi-tenant cloud data mesh platform already operating in production. You will lead the architecture of new AI capabilities and enhancements to existing capabilities, improving the platform's self-service experience while maintaining robust data governance, GxP compliance and protection of highly sensitive data.
  
  
You will bring deep technical expertise in cloud data platforms and work closely with internal teams and external partners to shape architecture, technology strategy and delivery direction.

### **About the Role**

------------------------

* Lead the architecture and design of cloud data platform capabilities supporting Drug Development use cases, reviewing and approving architecture and technical designs with oversight from the Platform Architecture Director.
* Define technology strategy, architecture standards and reusable platform patterns.
* Guide the evolution of the existing multi-tenant cloud data mesh platform, supporting the delivery of new capabilities and enhancements to existing functionality and self-service interfaces.
* Partner with Domain IT, Platform Engineering, Data Management, Governance and external vendors to align platform capabilities with business priorities.
* Prioritise capability backlogs, shape delivery roadmaps and coordinate MVP delivery with engineering teams.
* Lead technology evaluations, technical spikes and proofs of concept to inform platform decisions.
* Provide technical direction to project delivery vendors implementing prototypes and review outcomes against architectural requirements.

title: Lead Deployment Strategist - EMEA
description:
**The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.**

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

* Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders
* Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects
* Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what *you* can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Your main goal will be to build and lead a high-performing Deployment Strategist team that helps n8n's enterprise customers turn automation opportunities into measurable business impact. You'll own the methodology that drives successful Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) engagements, accelerating customer adoption, getting high-value workflows into production, and enabling customers to become independent builders.

To achieve this, you'll focus on four key areas:

### **Build & Lead the Deployment Strategist Team**

* Hire, onboard, and coach a team of Deployment Strategists who partner with Forward Deployed Engineers to deliver high-impact customer engagements.
* Set a high bar for executive discovery, ROI definition, change management, and customer handovers, ensuring consistent delivery quality across the team.
* Stay hands-on by leading customer engagements yourself while building the team, creating a culture of ownership, continuous learning, and customer impact.

### **Own & Scale the Deployment Methodology**

* Build and continuously improve our four-phase engagement methodology (Define, Identify, Co-build, Handover), including ROI frameworks, discovery guides, opportunity assessments, and handover templates.
* Partner with CSMs, AEs, and Sales leadership to identify and qualify high-impact customer opportunities, define clear success criteria, and scope the right engagement model.
* Turn learnings from workshops, hackathons, on-site builds, and staff augmentation engagements into repeatable playbooks that scale across FDE, Customer Success, and partner teams.

### **Drive Customer Adoption & Business Outcomes**

* Lead executive discovery and ROI conversations to align customer stakeholders on high-value automation opportunities, success metrics, and organizational change.
* Measure engagement success through workflows deployed to production, customer adoption improvements, and measurable business outcomes, rather than services delivery alone.
* Ensure seamless handovers to Customer Success Managers and provide CS and GTM leadership with visibility into engagement results, customer ROI, and expansion opportunities.

### **Scale Delivery Quality & Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Partner with the Partner Delivery Manager and Partnerships teams to ensure external delivery partners follow the same engagement methodology and quality standards.
* Help define readiness, certification, and quality expectations for partner Deployment Strategists to enable consistent customer experiences at scale.
* Work closely with FDEs, Product, and Engineering to turn customer feedback, technical gaps, feature requests, and custom integration needs into actionable product insights.

**REQUIREMENTS**
----------------

### **Must-haves**

* **Enterprise Customer Experience:** You have 7+ years of experience in customer-facing roles such as professional services, solutions consulting, implementation, or customer success within a software company.
* **People Leadership:** You have 2+ years of experience leading, coaching, and developing customer-facing teams, with a track record of building high-performing teams.
* **0-to-1 Builder Experience:** You've built or scaled a deployment, implementation, or professional services function and know how to create structure and repeatable processes in an evolving environment.
* **Executive Stakeholder Management:** You're experienced in leading executive discovery, building compelling ROI cases, and securing buy-in from multiple stakeholders within enterprise organizations.
* **Technical Fluency:** You're comfortable discussing workflow automation, integrations, and AI use cases with technical stakeholders and collaborating closely with engineers without needing to write code yourself.
* **Operational Excellence:** You know how to define success metrics, build scalable methodologies, and turn customer engagement learnings into actionable playbooks.
* **Customer Outcome Mindset:** You're focused on driving measurable customer adoption and long-term value, rather than simply delivering projects or completing engagements.

### **Nice-to-haves**

* **Automation Platforms:** You're familiar with n8n or other workflow automation, integration, or low-code platforms.
* **Change Management:** You have experience helping enterprise organizations drive adoption, navigate organizational change, and embed new technologies into their ways of working.
* **Partner Ecosystems:** You've worked with systems integrators, consulting firms, or external delivery partners to deliver customer implementations or technical engagements.

**Why join us?**

At n8n, you'll have the opportunity to build a brand-new function at the heart of how we scale enterprise customer adoption. You won't just manage a team — you'll shape how we engage customers, demonstrate the value of automation, and turn high-impact use cases into production workflows that drive lasting business outcomes.

You'll work closely with leaders across Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Engineering, with significant visibility and influence over our enterprise growth strategy. As one of Europe's fastest-growing startups, we offer the opportunity to build from the ground up, experiment with new approaches, and create a scalable deployment model that helps customers become independent, successful builders.

You'll join a supportive, remote-first team that values autonomy, collaboration, and continuous learning, where your impact will be visible from day one.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.  
  
At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.  
  
Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

**About the Role**
------------------

Perk is changing how companies manage travel and spend, and how we show up in front of our buyers, in person and inside their accounts, is one of the biggest drivers of how we win. We are looking for a Director of Field and Events Marketing to bring ABM, field marketing and every event we run together into one global team, and to build it into the engine that puts the right people from the right accounts in the room with our sales teams.

This is a global leadership role with real scale. You will lead the full events portfolio alongside our field marketing teams in every region, and you will work hand in hand with sales leaders on where pipeline is needed and how we go and get it. You will set the standard for how a fast-growing company runs events, and be measured on the pipeline you create and the retention and expansion you help drive. There is a lot to build in this role, and you will have the mandate and the budget to build it.

The right candidate is a strategic operator with deep ABM expertise, who loves the commercial side of events, gets energy from working shoulder to shoulder with Sales, and wants to build an events centre of excellence people in the industry talk about. It is an exciting time to join, with real momentum behind the business, in an AI-first company that expects its leaders to rethink how work gets done.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Build and scale ABM**

* Scale our account-based approach across regions, segments and the full sales cycle, from creating pipeline in target accounts to accelerating deals and growing existing customers, with a clear standard for how target accounts are chosen and engaged, agreed with Sales and Revenue Operations.
* Extend ABM beyond the field team, working with Product Marketing, Growth, Content and Brand so that campaigns across marketing are built around the same priority accounts.
* Define the milestones that show an account is moving through a long sales cycle, run regular account reviews, and shift resource towards the accounts and programmes that are making progress.

### **Build an events centre of excellence**

* Build and lead a centre of excellence that brings every type of event we run into one team, from demand generation events and trade shows to conferences, customer events and F1 hospitality, with a single planning calendar, shared standards, and the playbooks, templates and vendor approach that let every region deliver to the same quality.
* Set the events strategy in line with our business goals, go-to-market plans and integrated campaigns, and own the portfolio, deciding which events and sponsorships we invest in, scale or stop based on what each one delivers for pipeline and for our customers.
* Manage a global budget for events and field marketing, allocating it across regions, formats and programmes and moving investment towards what performs.

### **Partner with Sales**

Partnering with Sales is a critical part of this role. You will work with sales leadership in every region to decide where pipeline is needed and which programmes will deliver it.

* Build one alignment model for the global team, with field leads working inside each region's sales leadership, joining pipeline reviews and planning, so that priorities are shared and investment follows where pipeline is needed most.
* Create one front door for every event and field request from Sales, with clear intake, triage and funding rules.
* Equip sales teams and executives to get the most from every programme with target lists, outreach templates and follow-up plays, and own the pipeline plan for our biggest events, including invitations, meetings and executive sessions.

### **Drive pipeline and customer growth**

* Own the pipeline targets for ABM, field and events, partnering with Revenue Operations on attribution and reporting pipeline created and influenced, and cost per opportunity by programme and region.
* Make sure every programme you run contributes to growing our net revenue retention, using events and ABM to deepen relationships with existing customers and drive expansion alongside winning new business.
* Establish experimentation and testing frameworks across event types, turning what you learn into repeatable programmes and investment decisions.

### **Team and ways of working**

* Lead, coach and grow a global team of field marketing managers and events marketing managers, hiring where needed and building a culture of ownership, creativity and continuous learning.
* Be AI fluent and AI first in your approach, using automation for account research, event operations, follow-up and reporting so the team delivers more than its headcount would suggest.
* Work closely with Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, Brand, Content and PR so that events and field programmes support our major launches and company moments.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 10+ years in B2B marketing, with deep ABM and field marketing expertise and experience running events at scale.
* A proven track record of sourcing pipeline through account-targeted programmes, with the numbers to show it, ideally in a company with a meaningful enterprise or mid-market sales motion.
* Experience running a multi-format events portfolio, including conferences, trade shows, hospitality and customer events, and managing sponsorships and vendors.
* Strong credibility with sales leaders, built through partnering with them on pipeline reviews and regional planning.
* Experience using events and ABM to drive expansion and retention as well as new business.
* Experience building and leading teams, including managers and regional leads, across time zones.
* Experience managing and forecasting large budgets, and partnering with finance and RevOps to measure and report ROI.

### **Skills and traits**

* Strategic thinker who can turn vision into a global plan, with a roll your sleeves up approach to execution.
* Operational rigour, building target lists, funding rules and reporting before booking venues.
* A strong point of view and the confidence to make hard calls.
* Executive presence, with excellent written and verbal communication.
* One team mindset, collaborating with global teams while working closely with regional sales and marketing.
* A growth mindset, and willingness to travel as programmes require.

**AI at Perk**  
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

**How We Work**

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

**Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.
