title: Senior People Operations Engineer
description:
Qdrant is an **open-source vector** search engine powering the next generation of AI applications, from semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to AI agents and real-time recommendations.

Trusted by global leaders like **Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom**, we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising **$50M in Series B** funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data.

As a remote-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI.

**The Team and Your Impact**
----------------------------

Hi, I'm Gio, and I lead People & Culture at Qdrant. I joined in April 2026 to build the People function from scratch. We have laid the foundations: went live with Ashby and with a new HRIS, launched our first engagement survey, a leveling framework, and our first review and compensation cycles are coming in 2027.

Our colleagues are spread across about 30 countries, and our People team is small by design. We need systems that scale as Qdrant does. As our Senior People Operations Engineer, you’ll build how People Ops runs, write the policies behind it, and automate every process that doesn’t need a human touch.

*You don't need "People Operations Engineer" in your title to apply. If you are an HR generalist who automates everything, or an HR systems person who has handled multi-country cases, we want to hear from you.*

**What you will own**
---------------------

About 60% of your time goes to running People Ops, and about 40% to building. The mix will shift with what the business needs. Your first year has four main areas:

* **AI-native People Ops**

  + Use Claude and MCP frameworks every day to build agents and automations that take repetitive work off the team, starting with request triage and policy questions
  + Get the process and documentation right before you automate it, and decide what should stay human
  + Share what you learn, so the rest of the team picks up the same tools
* **People platforms, data, and analytics**

  + Own our HRIS and people stack, including integrations, access, and data quality
  + Build people analytics and reporting, and work with me to turn the data into decisions leadership can act on, from attrition and engagement trends to headcount planning
* **Global employment and payroll**

  + **Lead our move to a single global payroll provider**, replacing today’s mix of US PEO, EOR, and local payroll setups with one platform, and make sure employment contracts, visas, and Finance coordination carry through the transition without gaps.
  + Design onboarding, mobility, and offboarding so they work the same way in every country
  + Be the go-to person for tricky cases like relocations, with external counsel behind you
* **Policies and benefits**

  + Own our employee policies end to end, from drafting and legal review with counsel to rollout and upkeep
  + Design and launch a global benefits offering, country by country
  + Build a self-service documentation library, so people can find answers without asking

**Who you are**
---------------

* You've spent **5 or more years** in *People Ops, HR operations, or People Systems,* including time in a scaling, **remote-first** People function with **EU and US presence**
* You've **employed people in several countries** across entities, EOR, and freelancers, with hands-on **US and EU experience**, and you know how to keep it compliant
* You've worked with **EOR, PEO, and global payroll platforms** and can spot what looks off in payroll inputs before it goes out
* You've owned an **HRIS and people stack** hands on, from setup to integrations and data quality, and you have real people analytics experience
* You have strong **Claude and Claude Code** skills and use AI and MCP daily. You've built agents, skills, automations, or integrations that took real work off a team, ideally on HR or business systems. You know how to use AI with people data safely and in line with GDPR
* You know your way around **HR and automation tools**: ideally Ashby and Leapsome (or HiBob, Greenhouse, or Personio), Deel or Remote, Jira, and n8n, Zapier, or Make

### **Nice to have**

* Comfort with APIs, webhooks, or light scripting
* Knowledge of German or Spanish employment law, and a working grasp of US labor and employment rules
* You have built a benefits offering across countries or consolidated EOR and payroll vendors

**This role is probably not for you if you:**
---------------------------------------------

* Need to be told what to fix first, or wait for a playbook before deciding
* Want the process designed before you run it
* Would rather someone else figure out the solution, and just implement it
* Struggle with ambiguity and change. We're scaling and adapting as the market evolves, so priorities will shift
* Prefer a quick call to writing things down, since we work async first

**Interview process**
---------------------

* A 45-minute call with me (Gio). We talk about Qdrant, the role, and your background, and I am your point of contact throughout.
* A practical exercise: show us how you’d approach a real People Ops challenge
* Technical interviews:

  + A deeper conversation with me and the team (45 min)
  + A call with another colleague, so you get to know us too (30 min)
* A final call with one of our leaders.

I review every application myself after the application deadline, so take the time to tell us why you're a fit!

**Why join us**
---------------

* A remote-first, international team working on cutting-edge AI infrastructure.
* A competitive salary with additional perks.
* Flexible working hours and async-friendly culture.
* High ownership and real impact.
* Open-source, engineering-driven culture.
* Choose your own laptop equipment.

For US-based full-time employees, we also offer a comprehensive benefits package including 401k match, health, dental, and vision insurance, plus flexible PTO policy.

Qdrant is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe the best ideas come from diverse teams, and we actively welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If this role excites you but you don't check every single box, we'd still love to hear from you! We don't want to miss out on great people because of a checklist.

**Come build with us!**

### **For information on how we handle your personal data, please refer to our** **Recruitment Privacy Policy** **#LI-REMOTE**

title: Process Automation Engineer
location: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, CN, Spain
description:
##### ***-******Las Palmas De Gran Canaria******-***

**Alien Technology Transfer** empowers top-class innovators to transform visionary product concepts into commercial realities. We do this by helping companies with concrete growth ambitions to secure funding for their product development through our innovation consulting expertise. To date, we have raised more than $700 million for our clients - Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) - across many domains, including agri-tech, artificial intelligence, biotechnology, clean-tech, cyber-security, quantum computing, space, and transport.

We’re looking for a versatile **Process Automation Engineer** to join Alien Technology Transfer at **our office in Las Palmas**. Working closely with and reporting directly to our CEO, you will play a central role in a company-wide review of how each of our departments operates. Your job is to understand how work actually gets done, identify where time, quality and effort are being lost, and then design, build and maintain the tools that fix it. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role that combines process analysis with full-stack engineering. You will spend time with department heads and their teams to map workflows and pinpoint inefficiencies. You will turn your findings into standardised processes and reliable software that is easily adopted. We are not looking for a specialist in a single layer, nor for someone who only writes code to a specification. We need a strong generalist who can diagnose a business problem, decide what should be standardised, automated or eliminated, and then deliver a working solution end-to-end.

To join our team, you must possess a genuine interest in technology and business, be fluent in English, and take a highly analytical, articulate, and well-organised approach to your work. We are seeking a self-motivated team player with a strong startup attitude and the stamina to thrive within an ambitious, goal-driven environment. The ideal candidate is eager to take on high levels of responsibility, possesses sharp problem-solving skills, and is proactive about staying up to date on the latest tools — AI or otherwise — to ensure top performance. You are energised by wearing multiple hats—effectively managing priorities and diverse deliverables autonomously without needing a detailed playbook. If you are ready to make a meaningful impact in this dynamic role, we would be excited to hear from you.

* **Contract Type:** Permanent.
* **Hybrid Work Modality:** Monday to Thursday at the Office (Las Canteras area) and Friday Work from Home.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

Process Diagnosis & Standardisation

* Work with each department to map current workflows and understand how work is actually done.
* Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, duplicated effort, error-prone manual steps and activities that add little value, and quantify their impact where possible.
* Define standardised processes, templates and quality checks that reduce variability and prevent quality issues before they reach clients.
* Present findings and recommendations to the CEO and department heads, and prioritise improvements by impact and effort.

Tool Development & Platform Engineering

* Design, build and maintain internal tools and applications that enhance the performance of each department, from data layer through to API and user interface.
* Integrate tools with the systems our teams already use, such as Google Workspace, Odoo, and other AI-powered tools, so that solutions fit naturally into existing workflows usable by department personnel.
* Write clean, tested, maintainable code, and keep internal tools documented and easy to hand over.

Infrastructure & Deployment

* Set up, maintain, and improve our deployment pipelines, infrastructure, and environments.
* Handle the operational side of running the platform: CI/CD, monitoring, and keeping things stable and secure.

Adoption & Continuous Improvement

* Support teams in adopting new tools and processes through clear documentation, training and hands-on support.
* Define and track metrics that show whether each change is improving department performance, and iterate based on results and user feedback.
* Continuously identify new opportunities for standardisation and automation as the business evolves.

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrable full-stack breadth.
* Strong backend engineering skills, with proficiency in Python.
* Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM or other AI/ML-based solutions.
* Proven ability to analyse business processes and translate them into practical software or automation solutions.
* Ability to translate user needs into clear UI/UX requirements (user flows, screens, states, edge cases) and to evaluate and refine interfaces until they are intuitive for non-technical users.
* Practical experience with infrastructure, deployment, and DevOps practices (CI/CD, cloud environments, containerisation).
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work with non-technical colleagues, understand their needs, and explain technical trade-offs clearly.
* A generalist mindset: comfortable owning a problem from diagnosis through to a deployed, maintained solution.
* Fluency in English (C1/C2 level) with strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with AWS or Google Cloud.
* Experience building AI tools that work with documents, such as searching, summarising, extracting or checking text (e.g. RAG, vector databases, NLP).
* Experience with Google Workspace APIs and workflow-automation platforms (e.g. Zapier, n8n, Make).
* Knowledge of process-improvement methods such as Lean, Six Sigma or business process mapping.
* Experience in consultancy or professional-services environments, particularly in document-heavy work such as proposal or report writing.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive Fixed Salary
* Relocation & Bureaucracy Support: Dedicated guidance and administrative assistance for obtaining your Spanish NIE, social security, and local residency registration in Las Palmas.
* Work Flexibility: Hybrid work model (4 days onsite / 1 day WFH) + 20 extra remote working days per year to use at your convenience.
* Health & Wellbeing: Private health insurance coverage.
* Time Off: 30 days of paid annual leave.
* Company Culture: Regular team-building events, social activities, and a vibrant work environment in a co-working space just 50 meters from the beach in Las Palmas de Gran Canaria.

Please note: Due to the high volume of candidates, we are unfortunately unable to provide individual feedback on the outcome of every application.

title: Director of Product Management – AI & Platform Capabilities
description:
**Nombre de vacante**

Director of Product Management – AI & Platform Capabilities

  

**Descripción**

About the role
  
  
Help shape how AI transforms the work of small businesses, accountants and bookkeepers.
  
  
As Director of Product Management, Small Business Platform Intelligence & Connectivity, you will own the strategy, roadmap and delivery of shared capabilities that connect trusted data, systems and agents to enable world-class AI-driven experiences across Sage and its ecosystem.
  
  
We want you to help us see where these technologies can make the biggest difference: saving customers time, helping them grow their businesses, improving their day-to-day work and making their lives easier. You will set a clear direction, make informed investment choices and turn that direction into capabilities and experiences that deliver measurable value.
  
  
You will lead a dedicated group of Product Managers and Product Owners, partnering with Product Management leaders, Engineers, Architects and UX Designers to deliver reusable platform capabilities. You will balance ambition with practical delivery, customer trust and the cost of operating AI at scale.
  
  
This is a hybrid role working 3 days a week in our Barcelona office.

  

**Responsabilidades principales**

Key accountabilities
  
  
Set the strategy and direction
  
- Own and evolve the product vision, strategy and roadmap for Small Business Platform Intelligence & Connectivity, aligned with Sage’s wider product and business priorities.
  
- Identify where Sage should invest, experiment, scale or stop. Make clear choices about the customer problems to solve and the capabilities needed to solve them.
  
- Bring an informed perspective on emerging AI technologies, market developments and ecosystem opportunities. Distinguish promising experiments from capabilities ready for dependable use at scale.
  
  
Connect opportunity with customer value
  
- Build a deep understanding of critical Accounting, Payroll and HR journeys, including how accountants and bookkeepers support small businesses.
  
- Work with product teams, research and design to identify opportunities to remove repetitive work, improve decisions and help customers complete tasks with confidence.
  
- Balance time savings, quality and ease of use with delivery effort and ongoing cost. Choose the appropriate approach for each problem, whether AI, machine learning or established automation.
  
  
Build intelligence that scales
  
- Define the direction for Small Business Platform Intelligence & Connectivity capabilities, enabling teams to build consistent AI experiences using shared capabilities rather than duplicating effort across products.
  
- Partner with Architecture and Engineering on the capabilities needed for agents and workflows, customer context, data access, integration, evaluation and monitoring.
  
- Make adoption practical through clear onboarding, documentation, integration patterns and a strong developer experience. Understand product team needs and use their feedback to improve the Factory.
  
- Work with partner and developer teams to enable appropriate external use of capabilities through secure APIs and tools, including MCP, where this supports the strategy.
  
  
Own delivery and the economics of AI
  
- Translate strategy into a prioritised roadmap with clear customer outcomes, milestones, dependencies and accountable owners. Align shared capability delivery with product launches.
  
- Lead decisions on priorities and trade-offs with Product, Architecture and Engineering. Resolve blockers, manage dependencies and communicate mitigation plans when delivery is at risk.
  
- Own the product investment case and track operating costs alongside benefits. Assess model and infrastructure choices with technical teams, including build, buy and reuse decisions.
  
- Set measurable success criteria before delivery and evaluate results after launch. Track customer adoption, task completion, time saved, quality, reliability and cost per successful task; use the evidence to improve or stop investments.
  
  
Deliver experiences customers can trust
  
- Embed responsible AI, privacy, security and appropriate controls into product decisions, working with Sage’s specialist teams and established governance.
  
- Ensure AI actions respect existing customer permissions and access rights. Define where customers need visibility, confirmation or control over automation and agent actions.
  
- Agree quality and evaluation expectations with technical teams, including accuracy, failure handling and monitoring, before capabilities are released and scaled.
  
- Lead people and influence across Sage
  
- Lead, coach and develop a dedicated group of product managers and product owners, setting clear expectations for product judgement, delivery and outcomes.
  
- Build strong relationships across Product Management, Architecture, Engineering, UX and commercial teams. Securing agreement on priorities, adoption, commitments and ownership.
  
- Communicate the strategy, evidence and decisions clearly to senior leaders, teams and partners. Encourage challenge and feedback, and build alignment through change.
  
  
What you will bring
  
  
Essential experience and capabilities
  
- Senior product leadership: Experience owning strategy, roadmap and outcomes for a complex platform or technical product portfolio at Director level or equivalent.
  
- Production AI delivery: A track record of launching and scaling AI capabilities, including generative AI or agentic experiences, with measurable improvements in quality, adoption and cost.
  
- Platform product management: Experience building shared capabilities that multiple teams or partners adopt to deliver valuable customer experiences.
  
- Technical fluency: Confidence working with engineers and architects on AI systems, APIs, integrations, data access and cloud platforms to assess feasibility and make informed trade-offs.
  
- People leadership: Experience developing product managers or product owners, strengthening their judgement and accountability for outcomes.
  
- Customer and commercial judgement: The ability to connect platform investment to customer needs, build credible business cases and prioritise competing opportunities.
  
- Leadership across boundaries: A record of resolving complex trade-offs and securing commitment across teams and senior stakeholders.
  
- Practical AI fluency: Hands-on use of AI tools for discovery, prototyping and analysis, with sound judgement about their outputs and limitations.
  
  
Additional experience that would be valuable
  
- Building agent frameworks, workflow orchestration, AI evaluation or observability capabilities, or developer platforms for AI.
  
- Working with MCP, secure tool access, agent interoperability or external developer and partner ecosystems.
  
- Delivering products where sensitive data, financial accuracy, permissions and auditability are central to customer trust.
  
- Experience in accounting, fintech, payroll, HR or software for small businesses and professional practices.
  
- Scaling shared capabilities across products, markets or complex technology estates.
  
  
What success looks like
  
- Small Business Platform Intelligence & Connectivity has a clear strategy and an agreed roadmap, with investment connected to priority customer and business outcomes.
  
- Product teams and partners can adopt shared capabilities more quickly and confidently, with increasing reuse and less duplicated effort.
  
- AI experiences deliver measurable improvements in the work customers do, including successful task completion, time saved and confidence in the result.
  
- Connectivity enables valuable workflows across Sage and its ecosystem, with clear access controls and a dependable developer experience.
  
- Quality, reliability and operating costs are understood and actively managed as adoption grows.
  
- The product managers and product owners have clear ownership, grow their capability and deliver effectively with their engineering, architecture, design and product partners.
  
  
At Sage, we offer you an environment where you can grow professionally without compromising your personal well-being. Our benefits package is designed to provide stability, flexibility, and balance:
  
- Medical and dental insurance: Fully funded medical and dental insurance.
  
- Flexible benefits: Exchange part of your salary and make tax savings on meal and transport vouchers, childcare, and training.
  
- Well-being: Free access to the Calm app (for up to 5 users), 24/7 counselling, and emotional support from our Healthy Mind Coaches. We also offer self-care and parenting resources through the Cleo app.
  
- Flexible working: flexibility of working one hour in, one hour out, shortened workdays on Fridays and during the summer, and the opportunity to work from over 40 countries for up to 10 weeks per year through our Work Away program.
  
- Annual leave: 23 working days of vacation, 5 paid days per year for volunteering.
  
- Extended leave: 7 extra days of maternity leave and 5 extra days of paternity leave, on top of the legal allowance, available after one year of service.
  
- Financial support: Life and disability insurance, salary advances of up to 3.5 times your net monthly pay, a €300 net marriage bonus, and access to Sage's employee stock purchase plan at a discounted rate.
  
- Learning and development: Free premium subscription to external learning platforms
  
  
Health and Safety Responsibilities
  
- Fostering the safety culture leading by example.
  
- Ensuring a safe work environment by implementing and monitoring preventive measures, that is crucial for maintaining productivity and employee well-being.
  
- Regularly reviewing and updating safety protocols that will help prevent workplace accidents and ensure compliance with regulations.
  
- Participating in safety training sessions and adhering to preventive guidelines and procedures, the objective is minimizing risks and protecting yourself and the rest of your colleagues.
  
  
This role is not open to visa sponsorship. Candidates must have a valid work authorization for the location listed and not require sponsorship now, or in the future, for their application to be considered.

title: Growth & Partner Marketing Manager – UK & Ireland (HealthTech)
description:
### **Help us shape the future of digital healthcare!**

At **Top Doctors Group**, we are transforming the way people access healthcare. Through technology, we connect patients, healthcare professionals and healthcare providers to make healthcare more accessible, efficient and human.

Today, we operate in **10 countries** and develop digital solutions that help thousands of healthcare professionals grow their practices while enabling millions of patients to find the care they need.

We believe technology creates the greatest impact when it serves people. That's why we're continuing to grow and looking for talented people who want to help us build the future of digital healthcare in an international, innovative and fast-moving environment.

### **Why is this role exciting?**

Because you'll have a direct impact on the growth of our brands across the UK & Ireland.

As **Growth & Partner Marketing Manager**, you'll own the B2B marketing strategy for **Top Doctors, iWantGreatCare, Manitex and Top Health Tech**, designing initiatives that drive partner acquisition, engagement and growth across one of our most strategic markets.

Reporting directly to the **Head of Marketing**, you'll lead a team of two marketing specialists (UK Social Media, UK Performance Marketing), helping them grow while ensuring every initiative contributes to business objectives.

This is a unique opportunity to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You'll have the autonomy to shape the marketing roadmap for the region, working closely with Sales, Business Development and specialist marketing teams to transform ideas into measurable business growth and pipeline impact.

### **What you'll do**

##### **Drive Growth & Demand**

* Plan and run multi-channel B2B campaigns (paid, email, social, web, events) to generate leads and drive partner acquisition, engagement and activation across the UK & Ireland.
* Design and deliver multi-brand go-to-market plans for product launches, brand activations and new services aimed at doctors, clinics, hospitals and healthcare partners.
* Use data and commercial insights to identify growth opportunities, optimise customer acquisition strategies and improve marketing efficiency across the funnel.
* Analyse campaign performance, customer behaviour, pipeline metrics and market trends to generate actionable insights and continuously improve marketing ROI.
* Collaborate with Sales and Product teams to shape pricing strategies, commercial offers and value propositions based on market research, competitive analysis and performance data.

##### **Lead & Collaborate**

* Lead, coach and develop your team — the UK Social Media, UK Performance Marketing and Ireland Digital Marketing specialists — keeping execution aligned with brand objectives and growth priorities.
* Orchestrate the wider marketing supply chain: partner with our in-house Design, Email Marketing and SEO specialists, and manage our external paid media agency, to ship high-quality, on-brand assets and campaigns (landing pages, decks, microsites, email, events).
* Partner closely with Sales and Business Development to align marketing with pipeline goals and revenue targets.

#### **Stay Ahead of the Market**

* Conduct market and competitor research to adapt messaging, positioning and commercial strategy to the evolving UK & Ireland healthcare and eHealth landscape.
* Monitor industry trends, pricing strategies and customer needs to identify new business opportunities and recommend data-driven marketing initiatives.
* Champion a test-and-learn culture, bringing new ideas, technologies and AI-powered marketing approaches that improve performance and team efficiency.

### **We'd love to meet you if...**

If you enjoy building growth strategies that combine creativity, data and commercial impact, you'll probably thrive in this role if you have:

4+ years of experience in B2B Marketing, Growth Marketing or Demand Generation, ideally within SaaS, technology, digital services or marketplace businesses.

A proven track record of generating qualified leads and pipeline growth through multi-channel marketing campaigns.

Previous experience leading or mentoring marketing professionals, helping teams grow while delivering outstanding results.

Strong command of performance and digital channels (paid search & social, LinkedIn, email, SEO, landing pages / CRO) and tools such as Microsoft Dynamics (CRM), Google Ads, Meta & LinkedIn Ads, and GA4 — enough to set direction for your team and steer an external paid media agency.

Experience collaborating with external agencies and cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

A data-driven mindset with the ability to analyse performance, optimise campaigns and make informed business decisions.

Native or professional-level English.

### **You'll stand out even more if you are ...**

Comfortable using AI in your day-to-day marketing work to automate workflows, improve lead generation, run A/B tests and create high-quality, on-brand content.

Experience in marketing to healthcare professionals, clinics, hospitals or NHS stakeholders.

You have developed brand marketing, partner marketing or channel marketing strategies.

Spanish or another European language.

### **What you'll find at Top Doctors Group**

Real opportunities for professional growth and career development.

Hybrid working model.

Full-time schedule: Monday to Thursday from 9:00 am to 6:30 pm, and Fridays from 9:00 am to 3:00 pm.

Salary range from 40.000€ to 45.000€

Your birthday off.

Flexible compensation and employee benefits.

️ Relocation support could be provided (UK citizen)

Healthcare discounts.

An international, collaborative and fast-growing environment.

Leaders who prioritise coaching, autonomy and professional development.

A team you'll learn from, grow with and genuinely enjoy working alongside.

### **Diversity & Inclusion**

At Top Doctors Group, we believe that diverse experiences, perspectives and backgrounds help us build stronger teams and better products. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to grow and succeed.

If you require any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, we'll be happy to help.

### **Interested?**

If you've made it this far and see yourself in much of what we've described, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Cluster E-Commerce Manager
description:
**The role**
============

* **Reporting to:** Cluster Director of Revenue & Distribution
* **Scope:** Almanac Barcelona, Almanac Palais Vienna and Almanac X Alcron Prague; Esplanade Zagreb to follow
* **Location:** Remote / Barcelona
* **Purpose:** Maximise net room revenue from digital and distribution channels: invest every euro where it returns most, convert demand into direct bookings, and prove the result in the numbers. A hands-on, revenue-led role at the interface of Revenue, Distribution, Marketing and Technology.

**Key responsibilities**
========================

* **Paid media:** plan, run and optimise Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Hotel Ads), Meta and emerging AI-search advertising for all properties: budgets, bidding, keywords, audiences, campaign calendar, creative briefs and landing-page requirements; manage ad accounts, pixels and conversion tracking.
* **Distribution:** execute distribution across OTAs, GDS, metasearch and connectivity partners: channel content and mapping, rate-parity monitoring, OTA visibility and advertising programmes, and cost-of-acquisition reporting by channel, in line with the cluster revenue strategy.
* **Direct booking and conversion:** own the commercial performance of the hotel websites and booking engine: conversion, abandonment, merchandising, packages and campaign landing pages; drive fixes with IT and technology partners.
* **Organic and AI visibility:** improve SEO and visibility in AI-driven search and recommendations, together with Marketing.
* **Digital KPI tracking:** own a monthly scorecard by property covering conversion rate, cost per acquisition, ROAS, channel mix, and direct versus OTA booking share.
* **Attribution analysis:** analyse attribution across paid, organic, metasearch, CRM and OTA channels; reconcile platform data with PMS/CRS actuals; use tests to distinguish incremental bookings from existing demand.
* **CRM and loyalty:** support conversion-focused newsletters, pre-arrival and repeat-stay campaigns and GHA DISCOVERY activation with Marketing, in line with consent and privacy requirements.
* **Partners:** brief, manage and evaluate technology and marketing partners against clear performance scorecards.
* **Hotel activation:** translate need periods, leisure and MICE priorities and offers into measurable digital activity with the hotel teams; run a monthly test-and-learn plan and scale what works.

**Key interfaces**
==================

* **Revenue & Distribution:** pricing, inventory, forecasts and channel strategy; you execute and recommend within the agreed budget.
* **Marketing & Communications:** brand, editorial and creative standards; you own performance briefs, conversion requirements and campaign measurement.
* **Hotel teams:** product knowledge, offers and fulfilment; you coordinate implementation and measure outcomes.
* **IT and technology partners:** technical implementation; you define requirements, validate outcomes and escalate issues.

**What success looks like**
===========================

* Growth in net direct room revenue and direct booking share
* Lower cost of acquisition per channel and per property
* Improved website and booking-engine conversion
* Reliable tracking and attribution that reconcile with hotel actuals
* Clear, measurable return on digital marketing and technology spend

**About you**
=============

You think like a revenue and distribution manager and work like a digital specialist. You know what every euro invested returns, by channel, by property and by segment.

* Strong understanding of revenue management and distribution: pricing logic, channel mix, OTA economics and cost of acquisition
* Hands-on expertise in performance marketing, with a focus on return on every euro spent: Google Ads (including Hotel Ads and Performance Max), metasearch and Meta
* Solid grasp of SEO and GEO (visibility in AI-driven search and recommendations)
* Technical confidence across booking engines/CRS, channel managers, GA4, tracking and attribution; the natural interface between commercial teams, IT and technology partners
* Analytical and numbers-driven: you build your own reporting, reconcile data with actuals and act on what it shows
* Background in hotels, travel, airlines or e-commerce; hospitality experience is an advantage, not a requirement
* Fluent English; German, Spanish or Czech an advantage.

title: Onboarding Analyst
description:
**About us:**

BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.

We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.

Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.

Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today

By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.

We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.

We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:

* CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)
* FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)
* Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)
* LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)

**About this role in the team:**

Due to our expanding business, there is an increased demand for a Compliance Onboarding Analyst to join the Team. The role requires a high level of initiative, as well as expertise in a FinTech environment and cooperation with corporate and individual clients. This role requires high attention to clients needs, self education and self organization. This role will form part of our global team, and will work closely with Operations, Trading Team, Sales, and Management.

**Key Areas of Responsibilities:**

* Manage the onboarding and due diligence process for the Company's Corporate clients, ensuring adherence to best practices in onboarding, compliance, and risk management
* Oversee the end-to-end Corporate customer application process, including collection and verification of required documentation
* Accurately identify Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBOs) and Directors of Corporate clients, and gather all relevant details in line with internal policies
* Collect, review, and verify all required documentation for Corporate applications in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements
* Conduct screening and due diligence checks (e.g. Sanctions, PEPs, Adverse Media), and resolve any potential matches or flags
* Ensure compliance with all relevant laws, regulations, and internal standards, as well as external industry best practices
* Make case-by-case decisions regarding the need for further investigations or escalations, and follow through on appropriate actions
* Perform risk assessments for all customers and follow the company's approval and escalation protocols
* Identify and suggest improvements to onboarding processes to enhance efficiency, compliance, and customer experience
* Support the onboarding of Private Individuals on the BVNK platform across various products, ensuring processes are applied consistently

**What we need from you:**

* Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills
* Minimum 2 years of experience in B2B (corporate) customer onboarding within the payments or crypto industry
* Previous experience in a fintech or payments environment, with a good understanding of KYC/AML onboarding practices
* Demonstrated experience onboarding clients with complex ownership structures and from high-risk industries
* Proven ability to onboard and manage various legal entity types, including private limited companies, partnerships, trusts, and foundations
* Strong research and analytical skills, with the ability to identify UBOs and assess corporate documentation
* Hands-on experience using Salesforce or similar CRM tools for customer management and onboarding workflow tracking
* Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced, high-growth environment while maintaining high standards for accuracy, productivity, and compliance
* Comfortable managing multiple onboarding cases simultaneously, with strong organizational and time management skills

**What you can expect from us:**

* Fair and **competitive salary** at every stage of your growth
* **Flexible working** hours, with hybrid working at its heart
* A **culture** built on passionate, growth-minded people
* A **flexible approach to holiday**
* Opportunities to travel to our **offices around the world**
* An **open and creative environment** where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets

*At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we'd encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team.*

title: Group Product Manager (Core)
description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

**Our vision:** A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

### **About the Role:**

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. We're looking for a Group Product Manager to lead Wrike's Core unit - the product area at the heart of how customers plan, structure, manage, and scale work in Wrike.

In this role, you will lead a unit of five product teams and manage a team of five Product Managers. You will define the vision and strategy for Core Wrike going forward, balancing three critical forces: increasing product power, preserving ease of use, and evolving the experience to be suitable for the AI-native future.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who can combine strong product judgment, people leadership, customer empathy, and strategic prioritization. You will help shape the foundation of Wrike's product experience while developing a team of PMs into stronger strategic product leaders.

### **Your Impact:**

* Set the Core strategy: Define and evolve the vision, strategy, and priorities for Wrike's Core unit, ensuring the product remains powerful, scalable, easy to use, and ready for AI agents collaboration as well as for human.
* Lead a multi-team product area: Manage five Product Managers across five teams, ensuring clarity of ownership, strong decision-making, and consistent product quality across the unit.
* Prioritize ferociously: Balance customer requests, enterprise needs, technical investments, usability improvements, and long-term strategic bets — with a clear view of what matters most.
* Enable AI-native R&D: Contribute to building the processes, tooling, and mindsets needed for the R&D organization to scale output and outcomes by 10x with AI-native ways of working.
* Develop the PM team: Coach, mentor, and grow Product Managers, helping them to achieve the next level.

### **Your Qualifications:**

* Product leadership experience: Proven experience leading product managers or managing a complex product area with multiple teams and stakeholders.
* Strong core PM craft and customer-centric mindset: Deep understanding of product discovery, customer validation, roadmap strategy, prioritization, metrics, and product delivery.
* Enterprise SaaS experience: Strong knowledge of B2B SaaS and enterprise customer needs, including scalability, adoption, usability, configurability, and change management.
* Strategic prioritization: Ability to make hard trade-offs across incomparable investments, customer escalations, technical complexity, and long-term platform direction.
* Cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management: Ability to align teams and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, GTM, and executive leadership.
* People management skills: Experience coaching, mentoring, hiring, developing, and managing performance of product managers.
* Excellent UX judgment: Ability to balance power and simplicity in complex product experiences.

### **Standout Qualities:**

* Experience in B2B SaaS enterprise products in collaboration or productivity area
* Practical understanding of AI-native product development and agentic workflows.
* Visionary mindset and ability to redefine complex products vision
* Strong technical fluency and ability to partner effectively with engineering leaders.

### **Our Work Style:**

* Core product impact: You will shape the foundational Wrike experience used by customers every day to manage work at scale.
* Strategic complexity: The role requires balancing power, simplicity, customer demand, technical depth, and AI-readiness in one of Wrike's most important product areas.
* People leadership scope: You will directly develop a team of five PMs and influence the product culture of a larger R&D unit.
* AI-native transformation: You will help define how Core Wrike evolves for a future where AI changes how teams create, structure, and manage work.
* High visibility: Your decisions will influence Wrike's product direction, customer value, and long-term competitiveness.

### **What's Next?**

* Exploratory call with a Recruiter
* Meeting with the hiring manager - Product Director
* Panel interview with Product, Engineering, and Design representatives
* Home task
* Final interview with the CPO

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.  
  
#LI-AV1

### **Who Is Wrike and Our Culture**

We're a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

**Hybrid work mode**

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.

While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

#### **Our persona**

**Smart:** We love what we do, and we're great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.

**Dedicated:** We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We're committed to helping our teammates win, too!

**Approachable:** We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

#### **Our culture and Values**

**Customer-Focused**

**We care about our customers.** We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

**Collaborative**

**We work as one and win together,** each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

**Creative**

**We strive to succeed through continuous innovation.** It's our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

**Committed**

**We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization,** by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

title: KAM Senior
description:
Somos una de las marcas de mayor crecimiento en España en el cuidado del hogar.

Buscamos un/a **Key Account Manager (KAM) Senior** para liderar nuestra expansión en el canal moderno en España. Una oportunidad para construir, con mucha autonomía, el siguiente capítulo de una marca que está cambiando las reglas de la categoría.

Fabricamos en España, tenemos presencia en varios países europeos y ya trabajamos con cadenas de supermercados e hipermercados. Ahora toca ir a por más: nuevos lineales, más referencias y más cuota de lineal en las cuentas actuales.

**Por qué este puesto es especial**
-----------------------------------

* **Impacto real y visible:** tu trabajo se traduce directamente en crecimiento de la marca, desde el primer trimestre.
* **Marca con producto diferencial:** vendes un producto innovador, con una historia potente y diferente a todo lo que hay en el lineal.
* **Autonomía y confianza:** equipo pequeño, decisiones rápidas y acceso directo a la dirección. Nada de burocracia.
* **Visión completa:** trabajarás codo con codo con el Director Comercial en la estrategia de trade marketing, y con datos de mercado para argumentar cada negociación.
* **Crecimiento:** una marca en expansión europea que necesita a alguien que crezca con ella.

**Tus responsabilidades**
-------------------------

* Gestionar y desarrollar la cartera de cuentas clave del canal moderno (supermercados, hipermercados y cadenas regionales), con revisiones comerciales periódicas para supervisar el rendimiento y la ejecución.
* Negociar y cerrar acuerdos comerciales y contratos, y hacer seguimiento de la facturación.
* Abrir nuevas cuentas y conseguir la entrada en nuevos lineales, así como ampliar referencias y cuota de lineal en las cuentas existentes.
* Preparar presentaciones para compradores apoyadas en datos de mercado para demostrar potencial de ventas y distribución.
* Analizar de forma continua la posición competitiva y del cliente, y definir junto al Director Comercial la estrategia y acciones de trade marketing a corto y largo plazo.
* Definir y dar seguimiento a los KPIs de los distintos canales de distribución.
* Coordinarte con finanzas, operaciones y administración para asegurar un servicio excelente al cliente.

**A quién buscamos**
--------------------

**Requisitos**

* Mínimo **4 años de experiencia como KAM** (o rol equivalente) en **productos de droguería / limpieza del hogar en canal moderno**.
* Conocimiento del sector y relación con compradores de cadenas de supermercados e hipermercados en España.
* Experiencia demostrable en negociación comercial y cierre de acuerdos con retail.
* Capacidad analítica para trabajar con datos de ventas y construir argumentos comerciales.
* Residencia en **Barcelona o Madrid**.

**Competencias**

* Dominio de técnicas de venta y negociación.
* Gran capacidad para gestionar el tiempo y priorizar; automotivación.
* Capaz de asumir responsabilidad y resolver retos de forma creativa.

**Cómo trabajamos**
-------------------

Somos un equipo joven, ambicioso y con ganas de hacer las cosas bien. Tenemos base en Barcelona y trabajamos con un modelo remote-first: buscamos a la persona en **Barcelona o Madrid**, con encuentros presenciales con el equipo que acordaremos juntos.

Aquí cada persona es una pieza clave en su función. Si quieres jugar en la liga grande de una marca que está creciendo rápido, ¡queremos conocerte!

title: Cuentas (Barcelona) - Moda & lifestyle y Gran consumo & Lifestyle.
description:
**Queremos conocerte en el equipo de Cuentas Barcelona**

Somos una agencia de comunicación creativa.

Nuestro propósito es conectar a las marcas con sus audiencias de forma genuina, memorable y hecha para durar.

Estamos cerca de la cultura y conectados a las conversaciones que marcan la vida de las personas. Entendemos qué le importa a cada audiencia, y quién la inspira, para ayudar a las marcas a crear contenido relevante y a ganarse un lugar con sentido en la mente de la gente.

Queremos conocer a profesionales de **dirección de cuentas** que quieran formar parte de nuestro equipo en Barcelona. Abrimos 2 posiciones para liderar la comunicación de marcas de **Moda y Gran consumo. (Moda & lifestyle y Gran consumo & Lifestyle)**

* Define las estrategias de comunicación y relaciones públicas del sus marcas y vela por que cada acción responda a ellas.
* Dirige al equipo multidisciplinar que formamos (prensa, social media, influencers, eventos, contenidos, creatividad, video..) y coordina su trabajo.
* Gestiona la rentabilidad del proyecto: desde el presupuesto y la facturación hasta su cierre de resultados.

* **Equipo implicado y con ganas de hacer proyectos retadores,** con una buena dirección general creativa y dirección de negocio.
* **Modelo híbrido:** lunes, martes y jueves en oficina, y miércoles y viernes de teletrabajo voluntario. También se teletrabaja en agosto, Navidad y Semana Santa.

* **Beneficios:** seguro médico y ticket guardería.

  

* Experiencia demostrada (Mínimo 4 - 6 años) en agencia de comunicación y/o relaciones públicas.
* Experiencia en la definición de estrategias de comunicación y relaciones públicas para clientes de moda para la posición de moda y de gran consumo para la de gran consumo&lifestyle.
* Experiencia liderando equipos multidisciplinares.
* Experiencia en la gestión económica de clientes.
* Curiosidad por las tendencias, la cultura y el negocio de tus clientes.
* Inglés fluido. ( valorable, catalán)
* Pensamiento crítico y uso habitual de herramientas de IA en tu trabajo.

title: Product Director (Midcore Direction)
description:
**Who are we?**
---------------

**Tripledot** **Studios** is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who **LOVE** making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

**This role is based within our studio, Belka Games**
-----------------------------------------------------

Belka Games is a game development company ranked by Sensor Tower among the top 30 highest-grossing game developers in Europe. Our games have reached more than 110 million players worldwide

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for a **Product Director** to lead and strengthen our **Midcore Direction**. The key goal at the current stage is a successful global launch of our game Train of Hope and its further scaling.

As part of the Belka Games leadership team, you will contribute to the company’s broader product strategy and long-term development.

The role includes responsibility for the product strategy and business performance of Train of Hope, including its revenue, profitability, long-term product value, and investment efficiency. You will also build a strong product team and look for new growth opportunities for the game, from the best solutions on the market to IP collaborations and partnerships.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Part 1 - Product ownership and global launch**

* Define and implement the product strategy and long-term vision for Train of Hope: target audience, positioning, core gameplay pillars, and a 1-3 year development horizon
* Own the preparation and execution of the global launch: target KPIs and readiness criteria, go/no-go decisions, the launch plan together with Marketing and Development, and post-launch scaling
* Drive the business performance of the direction, including revenue growth, profitability, long-term product value, and investment efficiency
* Drive improvements in long-term retention, engagement, payer conversion, ARPPU, monetization, LTV, and other key product and business metrics
* Drive an AI-first approach to content production: introduce AI tools to automate and optimize the creation of locations, characters, art, text, and localization, reducing production time and cost without compromising quality
* Grow higher-margin monetization and distribution channels, including direct-to-consumer sales
* Balance short-term priorities with long-term product investments and allocate team resources accordingly
* Make decisions on the launch, scaling, iteration, or termination of in-game features and product initiatives
* Ensure high-quality and timely delivery of product updates together with the Development Director and Producers, and reduce product and technical risks of server-side and social features
* Build transparent cross-functional decision-making processes and align Product, Game Design, Narrative, Art, Development, Analytics, Marketing, and Finance around shared goals and priorities
* Partner with the CMO on player acquisition and re-engagement economics and UA scaling decisions for the global launch, taking into account the longer payback of midcore audiences
* Partner with the Belka Games leadership team on the company’s product strategy and long-term development
* Hire and develop strong product leaders and key specialists with midcore expertise (meta and combat design, competitive economy, narrative), and build an autonomous and scalable team

### **Part 2 - Market research and new growth opportunities**

* Continuously research the midcore market, audience, and competitors: successful mechanics, LiveOps and monetization practices, genre and setting trends, and changes in user acquisition costs
* Identify successful solutions on the market and adapt them for Train of Hope, managing a pipeline of in-game hypotheses and experiments
* Source and evaluate IP collaborations for Train of Hope: selecting IPs and partners, building the business case, integrating collaborations into content and LiveOps, and measuring their impact on acquisition, retention, and revenue
* Evaluate other growth opportunities for the game: new markets and localizations, new platforms, partnerships and cross-promotion, new game modes and content formats
* Apply a data-informed and hypothesis-driven approach to prioritizing and validating new opportunities
* Define success criteria in advance and evaluate initiatives against relevant midcore product, market, and business benchmarks
* Develop business cases for major initiatives and partnerships, including the opportunity, expected impact, required resources, timelines, and key risks
* Systematize learnings from experiments, collaborations, and post-release analysis of content and features, scale effective practices, and eliminate ineffective approaches

**Required Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
--------------------------------------------

* Senior product leadership experience in the games industry as a Product Director, Head of Product, Executive Producer, or in a comparable role
* Strong experience with live mobile F2P midcore games (e.g. RPG, strategy, 4X, battlers), including soft launch, global launch, and subsequent scaling
* Proven experience defining and implementing product strategy
* Experience owning product business performance and allocating investment and resources
* Strong analytical and business skills, including experience building business cases and making data-informed product and investment decisions
* Deep understanding of midcore meta, progression, hero and collection systems, game economies, social and competitive features (guilds/alliances, PvP), LiveOps, and F2P monetization, with proven experience improving long-term retention, monetization, revenue, profitability, and product health
* Experience building autonomous cross-functional teams and hiring and developing senior Product Managers, Game Producers, or other product leaders
* Excellent leadership, communication, cross-functional management, and stakeholder alignment skills
* Ability to make clear decisions in uncertain conditions and take ownership of their business consequences
* Fluent in English and Russian

**Would Be a Plus**

* Experience with narrative-driven or content-heavy games and managing a regular content production pipeline
* Experience with IP collaborations, partnerships, or licensed projects
* Hands-on experience introducing AI tools into game content production

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* A successful global launch of Train of Hope that meets target product and business metrics
* Sustainable growth of key metrics after launch
* A predictable content and LiveOps cadence with production costs that pay off
* An established process for finding and implementing new growth opportunities for the game, including IP collaborations
* A strong, autonomous product team with midcore expertise
* Increased maturity and effectiveness of the product function across the company

**Working at Tripledot**
------------------------

* **Hybrid Working:** We work in the office 4 days a week
* **25 days paid holiday** in addition to bank holidays to relax and refresh throughout the year
* **20 days remote working:** Work from anywhere in the world, or use the time to cover mandatory office days to WFH, 20 days of the year
* **Regular company events and rewards:** Join in regular events and rewards that celebrate cultural events, our achievements and our team spirit
* **Private Medical Cover:** Have peace of mind with private medical cover, ensuring your health is in good hands
* **Life & Critical Illness Cover:** Protect your future with our life and critical illness cover
* **Family Forming Support:** Receive vital support on your family forming/ fertility journey with our support program [subject to policy]
* **Employee Assistance Program:** Access confidential support anytime through our Employee Assistance Program
* **Sport Compensation:** Stay fit and active with our sport compensation benefit
* **Meal and Transport Vouchers:** Save on meals and transport with our convenient vouchers
* **English & Spanish Classes:** Enhance your English and Spanish skills with our provided language classes
* **Continuous Professional Development:** Propel your career with continuous opportunities for professional development

title: Senior Manager, Antibot Engineering
description:
**Company Description**

At NIQ Digital shelf, scraping isn’t just about collecting data, it’s about **outsmarting the obstacles** that stand in the way of visibility. Every day, we process **tens of billions of data points** from thousands of sources, both web and mobile, and transform them into actionable insights for the world’s top retailers and brands.

You'll join a team of **60+ scrapers**, engineers, analysts, and data lovers from across the globe. As part of our scraping and R&D team, you’ll have space to **experiment, push boundaries**, and bring bold ideas to life. You’ll collaborate closely with **Customer Success**, **Operations**, and **Data** to ensure we extract high-quality, actionable data — fast and at scale.

 **Job Description**

**The Role**

The Senior Manager, Antibot Engineering takes leadership responsibility for a defined part of the Antibot Engineering organization. Based in Spain and reporting to the Director of Antibot Engineering, this leader manages a distributed team located in Western Europe and Algeria. The geographic footprint describes where the team is located, not a regional mandate: the role contributes to the global Antibot Engineering mission and priorities.

This is a senior people-leadership role with three core accountabilities: building and developing a strong engineering team; prioritizing retailer work in line with business requirements; and driving an R&D roadmap that improves the effectiveness, durability, and scalability of Antibot capabilities. The leader works across Web Data Acquisition, Product, Engineering, Operations, and business stakeholders to turn demand into clear engineering choices and measurable outcomes.

**What You Will Do**

**Lead part of the global Antibot Engineering organization**

* Translate the Director of Antibot Engineering’s strategy into clear team objectives, priorities, roadmaps, and execution plans.
* Balance retailer unblocking and long-term R&D projects.
* Provide clear visibility into retailer priorities, R&D progress, capacity, dependencies, risks, and trade-offs.

**Drive retailer prioritization and engineering execution**

* Establish a transparent prioritization process that converts business requirements, customer impact, operational risk, and technical dependencies into an executable retailer backlog.
* Partner with business, product, delivery, and operations stakeholders to clarify demand, challenge assumptions, resolve priority conflicts, and communicate trade-offs.
* Ensure prioritized retailer unblocking work is planned, staffed, tracked, and delivered with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.
* Balance urgent retailer needs with platform development, solution durability, technical debt, and longer-term engineering capacity.

**Lead, develop, and retain the team**

* Lead, coach, and develop engineering managers, technical leads, and engineers across the distributed team in Western Europe and Algeria.
* Set clear expectations, strengthen accountability, and create an inclusive environment that supports learning, collaboration, and retention.
* Own team workforce and capability planning, including hiring, onboarding, succession, and development of critical Antibot expertise.
* Create effective operating rhythms for planning, reviews, risk management, and communication.

* Own and drive an R&D roadmap for the assigned Antibot scope, aligned with the technical direction set by the Director of Antibot Engineering.
* Identify research and engineering opportunities that improve capability, automation, scalability, maintainability, and resilience.
* Turn experiments and technical learning into clear investment recommendations, reusable solutions, and production adoption plans.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, web data acquisition, applied R&D, or a related technology field.
* 3+ years of people-management experience, including leadership of experienced engineers, technical leads, managers, or multiple teams.
* Demonstrated accountability for engineering delivery and production services in a complex, high-change environment.
* Experience with distributed systems, cloud platforms, automation, observability, incident management, and engineering quality practices.
* Strong organizational leadership, prioritization, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to lead across countries and cultures and to influence teams outside the direct reporting line.
* Professional fluency in English.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with web scraping, reverse engineering, or large-scale data collection.
* Experience leading geographically distributed engineering teams in Europe and/or North Africa.
* Knowledge of antibot solutions, CDN or WAF.
* Experience driving operating-model change, automation, platform adoption, or engineering transformation.

**Success Measures**

* A capable, engaged, and accountable engineering team with clear goals, development plans, and succession coverage.
* Retailer priorities that are traceable to business requirements and delivered with transparent trade-offs and predictable execution.
* An R&D roadmap that produces reusable improvements in Antibot capability, automation, durability, and scale.

title: Especialista en Integraciones Laborales
description:
DESCRIPCIóN

Desde ISPROX, buscamos un/a **Especialista en Integraciones Laborales.**

Formarás parte del Core Team de integraciones de un importante grupo de servicios profesionales consolidado con más de 60 años de trayectoria que, respaldado por un fondo americano, se encuentra en un momento clave de expansión.

Con un plan de crecimiento de unas 10-15 adquisiciones de despachos al año, tu misión será gestionar la transición, homogeneización y migración operativa del área laboral de las compañías adquiridas hacia la estructura central del grupo.

  

No es un rol de gestión de nóminas del día a día; es un puesto estratégico-operativo de consultoría interna enfocado en proyectos de absorción y despliegue tecnológico.

**Tus principales retos y funciones:**

* Mapeo y Migración de Datos: Coordinar y ejecutar el traspaso masivo de históricos, fichas de trabajadores, conceptos salariales y variables desde los sistemas de los despachos adquiridos hacia el entorno centralizado del grupo.
* Estandarización Tecnológica: Asegurar la correcta implantación y configuración del ecosistema A3 en las nuevas delegaciones, optimizando los flujos de trabajo e integrando herramientas de control horario o portales del empleado.
* Auditoría Laboral (Due Diligence Operativa): Analizar el estado de las plantillas absorbidas, convenios colectivos de origen, pactos de empresa y contingencias para asegurar el cumplimiento del Art. 44 del Estatuto de los Trabajadores (Subrogación).
* Soporte Operativo Crítico: Dar apoyo directo en la confección y validación de nóminas, seguros sociales (Sistema RED) y declaraciones durante los meses críticos de transición para garantizar impacto cero en los trabajadores.
* Gestión de Proyectos (PMO): Asegurar el cumplimiento de los deadlines de cada integración, reportando hitos y riesgos al Director de Integraciones.

**¿Qué pueden ofrecerte?**

* Incorporación a un grupo empresarial con más de 60 años en activo, en un momento clave de crecimiento, expansión y automatización.
* Contrato indefinido a jornada completa de 9h a 18h y viernes hasta las 15h con 1 día de teletrabajo a la semana.
* Retribución hasta 40.000€ brutos anuales, según perfil

REQUISITOS

**¿Qué buscamos en ti?**

* Experiencia: Mínimo 3-5 años en departamentos de Laboral Outsourcing, BPO Laboral en Big4/Tier 2 o asesorías de gran volumen, gestionando migraciones o integraciones de carteras.
* Dominio experto del ecosistema A3 (A3innuva / A3asesor). Valorable conocimiento en otras plataformas del mercado.
* Conocimientos técnicos: Sólida base en legislación laboral (subrogaciones, homogeneización de condiciones, cálculo de nóminas y finiquitos) y gestión de plataformas públicas (Sistema RED, Contrat@, Delta).
* Metodología: Familiaridad con gestión de proyectos y herramientas de seguimiento. Excel avanzado (tablas dinámicas, fórmulas de cruce de datos masivos). Muy valorable conocimientos de PMP y Agile.
* Soft Skills: Orientación a hitos y resultados, alta capacidad de adaptación al cambio, interlocución fluida y resiliencia.

title: Global Head of Social
description:
**About Revolut**

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 15,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

**About the role**

Marketing at Revolut is all about clarity, creativity, and commercial impact. Our Social Media team turns bold ideas into campaigns that connect with millions. We work across channels and teams to build a brand that earns attention and drives results, shaping how people see, understand, and engage with our products.

We're looking for a Global Head of Social to own the social media strategy for the company as well as lead community development.

You’ll plan and execute campaigns across our global social channels, boosting community management efforts across new and existing customers to drive customer acquisition, engagement, and brand awareness. You’ll also be responsible for devising the local channel playbook to launch in priority markets.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

**What you'll be doing**

* Devising and deploying the global social media strategy across central platforms, with accountability for connecting social activity to commercial outcomes
* Setting KPIs that go beyond industry standards and link directly to commercial impact
* Building and managing the editorial and content calendar whilst balancing business needs and cultural moments
* Developing the local strategy and relevant playbooks to deploy new channels in priority markets, including supporting hiring efforts in the market
* Managing the global Social Media team to govern asset quality for content calendars, ensuring all assets are high quality and adhere to brand guidelines with timely approvals
* Partnering with Growth, Communications, Product, and Marketing teams to inform and deliver GTMs and 360 integrated campaigns
* Leading and managing a high-performance creative culture across social media teams
* Managing stakeholders across senior leadership, gaining trust to support creative initiatives

**What you'll need**

* Experience in global social media, encompassing both operations and strategy, while remaining hands-on with campaign execution
* The ability to run a global strategy that's hyper-localised to support community management
* Gravitas and experience presenting to C-level executives on global social media strategies
* A proven track record of scaling social media followers across a variety of channels, with a focus on driving engagement and growth in competitive markets
* Expert-level proficiency in social media listening, tracking, and analytics tools to drive data-driven strategies and optimise content performance
* Experience leading and developing high-performing teams across multiple regions

**Nice to have**

* Experience working on 360 campaigns as part of an omni-channel marketing team

**Compensation range**

* Krakow: PLN18,000 - PLN22,200 base gross monthly\*
* Poland: PLN18,000 - PLN22,200 base gross monthly\*
* Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process
* Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience

*Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.*

***Important notice for candidates:***

*Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.*

* ***Only apply through official Revolut channels.*** *We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.*
* ***Always double-check the emails you receive.*** *Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.*

***We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process.*** *If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.*

*By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's* *Candidate Privacy Notice*

title: Key Account Regional (Ciudad Real, Toledo, Guadalajara)
description:
