With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.

We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.

What truly sets us apart is how we work.

We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.

We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.

**The role:**  
  
If you are a social person, with analytical abilities, a results-oriented focus, and a Win-Win mindset then this role is just for you!  
  
It's a great opportunity to develop and execute the customer-focused regional business strategy and plan. You will be responsible for the deliveries, as well as the profits and losses that occur in different categories, along with the implementation and optimization of the strategy within each category.  
  
You will work with the Channel Head to maximize business opportunities and sales in the area.  
  
**What you'll be responsible for:**

Business Strategy and Plan

* Develop the strategic business plan in their respective categories. In some accounts, you may create a joint business plan for the corresponding categories.
* Optimize collaboration and communication with managers for customer entry and channel marketing to generate the best business plan.
* Optimize administrative and logistical efficiencies with an impact on resources and investments from various areas of the company.
* Develop an optimal integrated promotion plan (including selling the plan to the consumer) and manage promotion investments. Customer P&L management.
* Deliver the agreed plan and monitor the success of the established counterparts in the agreement.

Negotiation

* Close deals with the customer through negotiation of commercial terms, financing, and the agreement of the strategy among all involved parties.
* Oversee customer investments in their category in a general sense.
* Monitor customer performance by tracking customer contribution and market share for key categories when available.
* Work together with CD Finance to define the best negotiation strategies.

Active Ambassador Role

* Highly active ambassador role with the customer.
* Develop a strong team spirit with other coordinators and account managers, seeking the best solution for the business, even if it is not aligned with your customer.

**We're looking for someone who:**

* Holds a degree in Business Administration, Economics, or a related field, with 2–3 years of experience managing accounts within the HORECA channel
* Has a good level of English
* Demonstrates strong interpersonal and social skills, combined with solid analytical and organizational capabilities
* Is energetic, results-driven, and brings a proactive mindset with leadership potential
* Adopts a win-win approach when negotiating with clients
* Thrives under pressure and is able to work effectively within tight deadlines
* Has strong influencing and persuasion skills

**What you'll get:**  
  
Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes

* Market-competitive pay and performance-related rewards
* Flexible ways of working
* Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work
* Time off to rest and recharge
* Ongoing learning and development opportunities
* 100% remote working model
* Daily allowances (meal expenses)
* Company car
* Private health insurance option, with Magnum covering 40% of the policy cost
* Pension plan
* Wellhub (gym & wellbeing platform) access
* And much more!

**Why join us?**

This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!

You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.

**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**

If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.

If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.

The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

description:

Cadiz, ES

Application closing date: N/A

Inspired Education is the leading global group of premium schools, with a portfolio of 125 premium private schools spanning 6 continents which utilise proven educational practices from every corner of the globe, ensuring over 95,000 students receive a world-class learning experience from Kindergarten to Year 13.

In 28 countries, Inspired schools are individually developed and anchored in the vibrant cultures of their respective locations. They collectively form an international family of schools that nurtures each student's academic and personal development in a progressive, dynamic, and innovative learning environment.

By joining our award-winning team of over 14,000 employees, you can work in state-of-the-art facilities alongside industry-renowned educators and leaders in some of the world's most desirable locations. We invest heavily in our team members who enjoy industry-leading professional development, exceptional career opportunities, and mobility across our group.

**ROLE SUMMARY:**
-----------------

Sotogrande International School, part of the Inspired Education Group, is seeking to appoint an outstanding Vice Principal of Performing & Creative Arts to join our Senior Leadership Team from August 2027. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Drama specialist, senior educational leader and practising artist to lead the development of Performing and Creative Arts across the whole school, while launching and directing our new Elite Pathway in Performing Arts & Film for students aged 16–18.

  

Based at our new SIS Global Arts Centre, featuring a 400-seat professional theatre, dance and drama studios, music facilities and film editing suites, the successful candidate will play a key role in establishing Sotogrande International School as a leading destination for aspiring performers, artists and filmmakers.

  

In addition to this position, you may also be interested in our in-person Inspired Careers Event in London on Saturday 23rd January 2027. This school and over 30 other UK and international Inspired schools will be attending to connect with teachers seeking new roles starting from August 2027. For more information and to register, please click here: https://jobs.inspirededu.com/job-invite/10814/

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**
-------------------------

* Provide strategic leadership for Drama, Music, Dance, Film & Media and Visual Arts across the whole school.
* Lead the development and implementation of a coherent arts curriculum across the IB and UK pathways.
* Design, launch and lead the new Elite Pathway in Performing Arts & Film for 2027/28, including specialist training, external qualifications and industry partnerships.
* Oversee teaching standards, curriculum development, assessment and student outcomes across the arts departments.
* Personally teach Drama on a reduced timetable, modelling outstanding teaching and professional artistic practice.
* Lead an ambitious programme of productions, performances, concerts, exhibitions, screenings and creative events.
* Build partnerships with drama schools, conservatoires, universities, theatres and creative industry organisations.
* Recruit, lead and develop teaching staff, specialist tutors, visiting practitioners and technical teams.
* Manage departmental budgets and oversee the strategic use of the SIS Global Arts Centre.

**THE IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:**
----------------------------------

* A degree in Drama, Theatre, Performing Arts or a closely related subject.
* A recognised teaching qualification and QTS or equivalent.
* Extensive experience teaching Drama within the IB and UK curriculum, ideally MYP, DP Theatre and A Level.
* Proven senior leadership experience in Performing Arts or Drama.
* A strong track record of academic results, directing productions and preparing students for LAMDA, Trinity and drama school auditions.
* Professional experience in theatre, film, television or the wider performing arts, with established industry contacts.
* A practising artist with recent experience as a performer, director, writer or creative practitioner.
* Excellent leadership, communication and organisational skills, with the ability to inspire students and colleagues.
* Fluent English, both written and spoken. Previous international school experience and Spanish language skills would be an advantage.
* Visa sponsorship can be arranged for the right candidate.

title: Conversion Oriented Copywriter
description:
En Natulim buscamos un/a **Creative Strategist – Paid Ads** que nos ayude a llevar nuestras creatividades publicitarias al siguiente nivel.

Buscamos una persona que combine **creatividad, storytelling y mentalidad de performance**: alguien capaz de detectar qué hace que un anuncio funcione, convertir insights en conceptos creativos y aterrizarlos en vídeos, hooks y guiones que generen resultados.

No buscamos un perfil puramente conceptual ni un/a editor/a de vídeo. Queremos a alguien que **piense la creatividad de principio a fin**, desde el insight y el concepto hasta la estructura del anuncio y su ejecución, trabajando junto al equipo de contenido, edición y performance.

### **Qué harás**

* Desarrollar **conceptos creativos y ángulos de comunicación** para campañas de paid ads.
* Crear y testar diferentes **hooks, narrativas, claims y estructuras de vídeo** para mejorar el rendimiento de los anuncios.
* Escribir **guiones y briefs creativos** claros para producción y edición.
* Analizar anuncios propios y de competidores para identificar oportunidades y nuevos enfoques.
* Analizar resultados de las creatividades y entender qué elementos están funcionando: **hook, retención, engagement, CTR, conversión, etc.**
* Transformar aprendizajes de performance en nuevas ideas y ciclos de test.
* Trabajar estrechamente con los equipos de **Performance, Content y Editing** para producir y escalar las mejores creatividades.
* Adaptar tendencias, formatos y códigos de redes sociales al universo de Natulim.
* Participar en la creación de contenido tanto **short-form como long-form**, siempre con foco en su aplicación a paid media.
* Mantener un sistema continuo de **testing e iteración creativa**.

### **Qué buscamos**

* **2+ años de experiencia** creando contenido creativo en vídeo para redes sociales y/o paid media.
* Experiencia real desarrollando **anuncios en vídeo para plataformas como Meta, Instagram, TikTok o YouTube**.
* Experiencia escribiendo **guiones, hooks y conceptos creativos**.
* Haber editado vídeo o tener suficiente conocimiento de edición para entender cómo llevar una idea a ejecución.
* Entender las estructuras que hacen que un vídeo funcione: **hooks, retención, ritmo, storytelling y CTA**.
* Experiencia trabajando con marcas de **e-commerce, belleza, FMCG o consumo**.
* Capacidad para interpretar métricas de performance y convertir datos en aprendizajes creativos.
* Buen criterio creativo y capacidad para convertir ideas en piezas concretas y ejecutables.
* Perfil autónomo, proactivo, curioso y muy conectado con tendencias y formatos actuales.
* **Permiso de trabajo en España.**

### **¿Qué ofrecemos?**

* **Acceso y formación en herramientas de IA**, trabajando con tecnología puntera como Claude.
* **Contrato indefinido**, estabilidad laboral y oportunidades reales de crecimiento.
* **Jornada completa de lunes a viernes**, con flexibilidad de entrada y salida.
* **Formación interna y externa** para impulsar tu aprendizaje continuo.
* **Retribución flexible** adaptada a tus necesidades (seguro médico, restaurante, transporte y guardería).
* **Hasta un 50% de descuento en productos Natulim.**
* **Días de adaptación escolar**, para acompañar a hijos menores de 3 años cuando lo necesites.
* **Un equipo joven, dinámico y con muy buen ambiente**, donde las personas y las ideas cuentan.  
    
  Te esperamos!

title: Digital Operations Team Lead - Music Rights & Royalties
description:
What you will be doing

As an Operations Team Lead, you will play a central role in guiding and empowering the Digital Operations team to deliver on its objectives. Reporting to the Head of Digital Operations and acting as their deputy, you will lead the team’s day-to-day work and oversee execution across core DSP processing and reporting pipelines, ensuring high-quality data exchange, timely royalty allocations, and strict compliance with client Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Your contributions will directly shape how the team runs and how we deliver DSP Processing and Reporting for our clients , making you an integral part of our team.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Execute the workflows and priorities set with the Head of Digital Operations, collaborating with Business Line, Engineering, and the wider Operations team, including operational support and communication with all of our DSP Processing and Reporting clients.
* Act as deputy to the Head of Digital Operations, covering for them when needed and making operational decisions on behalf of the team. Serve as the primary escalation point for the Operations Specialist team, triaging complex queries related to catalog ingest, matching exceptions, and output generation.
* Manage agreed business priorities, task allocations, and daily operational workflows for the Digital Operations Specialist team.
* Coordinate end-to-end DSP processing cycles across major platforms (including YouTube, Spotify, Amazon, and SoundCloud).
* Oversee the organization and maintenance of strict delivery schedules.
* Mentor and train team members, fostering a collaborative, supportive, and continuous learning environment.
* Manage pre-distribution calculations, conflict resolution lifecycles, and claiming output generation

### **Collaboration and Team Dynamics**

You will work closely with the Head of Digital Operations to plan priorities, track team performance, and continuously improve how we operate. You will also collaborate with Business Line, Engineering, Product, and Partnership teams to optimize system reliability and operational scale. These collaborations are pivotal for achieving our organizational goals and ensuring effective communication and alignment across different areas of the company.

 **Requirements**

All about you

* Preferably 5+ years of experience in Music Industry Operations.
* Experience in managing a team or related roles is preferred but not mandatory.
* Demonstrate understanding of music copyrights principles, practices, and relevant regulations.
* Deep familiarity with music metadata standards, Common Works Registration (CWR), DDEX Digital Sales Reports (DSRs), etc.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to articulate technical and operational requirements clearly across diverse global teams.
* Ability to effectively communicate with team members, stakeholders, and external partners.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities effectively.
* Demonstrate strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to analyze large volumes of usage data, diagnose root causes of operational discrepancies, and design efficient process solutions.
* Proficiency working with complex data platforms (YouTube CMS/Content ID), Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets, SQL querying, and SFTP data exchange protocol.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion.
* Proactive attitude with a willingness to learn and take initiative.
* Demonstrate adaptability and openness to feedback and learning opportunities.
* Collaborative team player with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Outstanding organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and high-stakes client deadlines.
* Fluency in English. Proficiency in Spanish and Catalan is highly appreciated, but not mandatory.
* The role is located in Barcelona. Local candidates are preferred, but remote work arrangements may be considered.

### **Expectations of the role**

Within 30 Days:

During the first month, your primary focus will be on familiarizing yourself with essential aspects of the role and supporting foundational tasks.

* Familiarize yourself thoroughly with BMAT’s core operating platforms and DSP processing lifecycle standards.
* Align with the Head of Digital Operations on team priorities, ways of working, and responsibilities.
* Establish working relationships with direct reports and key cross-functional partners across Engineering, Product, and Partnerships.
* Assume day-to-day oversight of operational queues and SLA tracking for core processing clients

Within 60 Days:

By the second month, you'll be expected to take on more complex responsibilities and actively contribute to team and strategic initiatives.

* Autonomously manage daily task distribution, priority queues, and technical escalations for the Digital Operations team.
* Lead high-priority client distribution cycles, ensuring 100% on-time delivery of claim files, pre-distribution reports, and DIF files.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to implement automated matching QA rules and streamline conflict resolution tracking.
* Facilitate the transition of routine client invoicing workflows from Partnerships to Operations in collaboration with Finance.

Within 90 Days:

At the end of the probationary period, you'll be expected to autonomously manage tasks, contribute to strategic planning, and take on leadership roles as appropriate.

* Autonomously manage team operations, performance evaluations, continuous training, and skill development.
* Drive measurable improvements in operational throughput, team capacity, and SLA compliance across all Tier 1 and Tier 2 DSP accounts.
* Represent Digital Operations in cross-departmental readiness reviews and platform feature validations.

  
**Benefits**  

### **You Can Enjoy**

* Flexible working hours and location
* Flat hierarchy
* You can make the role your own and run your own development
* Online language classes to improve your Spanish or English
* Online and onsite courses and music industry workshops run by inhouse experts
* We’ll provide you with all equipment needed for you to be comfortable
* Unlimited time off because we believe that you know best when you need to rest.
Barcelona HQ office available to you, kitted out with a rehearsal room https://www.bmat.com/bmat-house/  

  

### **Who the FAQ are BMAT**

BMAT started in 2005 when a group of engineers with a passion for music decided to spin-off from an audio research lab in Barcelona. We’re now over 250 people, spread across Barcelona, Buenos Aires, Lima, Rio de Janeiro, London, Paris, New Jersey, Oslo, LA, Singapore, Tokyo, Manila, Bangkok and Lagos.

We’re a team of pretty decent people who enjoy working with each other. We’re open-minded and well-traveled, coming from all parts of the world. We’ve got rappers, producers, cello players, DJs, and songwriters. The passion for music and the excitement for innovative technology have proven to make a good combination.

BMAT has grown as a company of companies. Within BMAT there are a number of products and services that developed semi autonomously for different players – Digital Service Providers, Publishers and Collective Management Organisations.

*Diverse perspectives drive innovation, and innovation is kind of our thing. Our open-minded and flexible culture organically fosters this diversity. We've learnt that we thrive on learning from each other, so we don't just welcome but actively hire a range of open-minded people from all walks of life. Our team is made up of people with different backgrounds, perspectives, orientations, abilities, musical tastes, dress sense and time-zones - but we all have one common goal: Making the music world a better place. With equal opportunities for everyone, BMAT is a pretty nice place to work.*

title: Demand Partnership Manager
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

EXTE is a leading AdTech platform, specializing in video, content, and performance. Our mission is to design comprehensive advertising solutions based on creativity and technology to ensure brand value within the advertising ecosystem and relevance for agencies, media, and users; offering advertisers the right audience in a safe and brand privacy-respecting environment.

We want to be the trusted partner of brands, amplifying their stories across media through enriching advertising experiences that challenge convention and raise industry standards.

The Role

This is a full remote role that could be located anywhere.

As a Demand Partnerships Manager at EXTE, you will play a key role in expanding our global demand ecosystem and unlocking new revenue opportunities. Your mission will be to identify, attract and establish strategic partnerships with programmatic platforms, independent ad networks, DSPs and other demand sources worldwide, with a particular focus on small and mid-sized players.

You will own the full partnership development process, from identifying potential buyers and opening new business opportunities to negotiating agreements, coordinating integrations and driving partner activation. Working closely with our commercial, technical and operations teams, you will help diversify our demand sources, maximize traffic monetization and accelerate EXTEs growth across international markets.

What you will be doing

1. Drive global demand acquisition: Proactively identify, research and approach new demand partners worldwide, with a particular focus on independent, mid-sized and emerging AdTech platforms, DSPs, ad networks, exchanges and other potential buyers of EXTEs advertising inventory.

2. Build and expand the demand ecosystem: Develop a strong pipeline of potential partners across different geographies, verticals and advertising formats, identifying new channels and opportunities to monetize EXTEs traffic.

8. Develop a global industry network: Represent EXTE at international conferences, industry events and business meetings, continuously identifying new partnership opportunities and strengthening the company position within the programmatic ecosystem.

* **End-to-end project delivery:** Direct projects from initial briefing and discovery workshops through conceptual ideation, review cycles, and final toolkit delivery, ensuring clear communication of milestones, dependencies, and deadlines.

* **Campaign & deliverable scope:** Proven experience managing global master toolkits, conceptual campaigns, and integrated creative assets across:
  + ATL, Digital & Social
  + Motion Graphics & Video

title: Digital Workplace Operations Director, Madrid (M, ES)
description:
**Location:** Madrid, M, ES

As Digital Workplace Operations Director, you will be accountable for the global delivery, performance and evolution of Swiss Re's employee workplace technology operations. Your scope spans Workplace Service Management, remote second-level support, onsite Field Services across Swiss Re locations, workplace hardware lifecycle services, and meeting room and multimedia technology support. You will lead a geographically distributed organization and govern the outcomes delivered by internal teams and external service partners.

This is a senior enterprise leadership role with end-to-end accountability for service reliability, employee experience, operational risk, service economics and transformation. You will set a consistent global operating model, connect workplace products and engineering with day-to-day delivery, and ensure employees experience one integrated service regardless of location, channel or provider.

You will drive the shift from reactive support to proactive, data-led operations through automation, self-service, knowledge management and AI-enabled support. Success requires a leader who has already managed comparable global operations, developed strong leadership teams and taken executive decisions during business-critical incidents and complex change.

**Key Responsibilities:**

You will have global leadership accountability for Workplace Operations, its people, service outcomes, delivery partners and continual improvement.

**Digital Employee Experience, Operational Intelligence and Product Improvement**

* You will establish a customer-centric, data-driven approach to Digital Workplace Operations, ensuring that operational insights and employee experience continuously inform product and engineering priorities.
* You will bring together service performance data, incident and problem trends, digital employee experience telemetry and direct employee feedback to identify systemic issues, recurring friction and opportunities for improvement.
* Working closely with Product and Engineering leaders, you will establish a structured feedback loop that translates these insights into actionable engineering priorities, addressing underlying product, platform and integration weaknesses rather than relying on operational workarounds or repeated support interventions.
* You will ensure that improvements are measured against tangible outcomes, including reduced incident recurrence, lower support demand, improved employee productivity and experience, and sustainable reductions in operational cost.

**Global workplace operations and service ownership**

* Set and execute the global Workplace Operations strategy, service portfolio and operating model across service management, remote support, regional onsite support and multimedia services, with clear responsibilities and consistent standards.
* Own end-to-end service delivery outcomes and the interfaces across the enterprise Service Desk (first level), remote second-level support, onsite teams, engineering specialists and managed-service providers.
* Translate business priorities into measurable service objectives, service catalogues, location coverage and capacity plans, balancing global consistency with justified local requirements.

**Regional Field Services and employee technology lifecycle**

* Lead onsite technology support across the Americas, EMEA and Asia Pacific, including executive and business-critical support, ensuring effective regional leadership, service continuity and a consistent employee experience.
* Oversee operational delivery of end-user hardware throughout provisioning, onboarding, deployment, replacement, recovery, reuse and secure retirement, including inventory availability and demand planning in partnership with Engineering, Procurement and suppliers.
* Ensure technology readiness and support for meeting rooms, multimedia services, office openings, moves and closures, and major employee events, in coordination with relevant workplace and infrastructure teams.

**Service management, quality and operational resilience**

* Lead Workplace service-management governance and operational performance across incident, major incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, service-level and service-transition practices, aligned with enterprise processes.
* Ensure effective escalation, restoration and communication during major disruptions; drive rigorous root-cause analysis, permanent remediation and a reduction in recurring incidents and avoidable service demand.
* Establish meaningful service levels and experience measures (SLAs, XLAs and operational KPIs), and maintain a transparent view of quality, reliability, employee impact, risk, demand and improvement priorities.

**Security, controls and governance**

* Ensure workplace services operate within applicable security, privacy, regulatory and internal-control requirements, with clear operational ownership for risk, vulnerabilities, privileged support access and third-party obligations.
* Oversee audit readiness, control evidence, management actions, service-continuity arrangements and supplier resilience, ensuring risks are raised early, remediation is effective and accountability is clear.

**Managed services, commercial and financial leadership**

* Own Workplace Operations financial planning and performance, including operational budgets, forecasts, service cost drivers, workforce and supplier spend, investment cases and sustainable cost optimization.
* Lead strategic partner governance, sourcing and service transitions; manage vendors against contracted outcomes, quality, experience, innovation and value rather than resource counts alone.
* Maintain effective oversight of workplace technology assets, service contracts and relevant licence consumption, partnering with Finance, Procurement and product owners on lifecycle cost and value.

**Transformation and employee experience**

* Build an evidence-led improvement roadmap that uses employee feedback, digital experience telemetry, workflow automation, self-service and AI-assisted operations to reduce friction, prevent incidents and improve productivity.
* Own operational assurance and readiness for workplace transformations, large-scale technology deployments and provider changes, ensuring credible delivery capacity, support acceptance, communication, hypercare and business continuity.
* Strengthen the experience of critical employee journeys, including joining, moving, changing devices, seeking support and leaving, with measurable gains in quality, speed, cost and satisfaction.

**Organizational and executive leadership**

* Lead and develop a multi-region organization of 150+ employees through its service-management, regional Field Services and multimedia leaders; shape structure, talent, succession, workforce planning, performance and a culture of accountability.
* Serve as a member of the Digital Workplace leadership team and partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, HR, Facilities, Finance and business leaders to resolve cross-functional issues and translate strategy into reliable operations.
* Act as the senior escalation and decision point for critical service matters, communicating clearly with executives and making balanced decisions across employee experience, cost, risk, speed and resilience.

**About the team**

In GSTP Digital Workplace, we make it easy for Swiss Re employees to use their digital workplace to connect seamlessly with people, ideas and expertise across the company and beyond. We focus on translating internal client needs into workplace products and services that improve productivity, enable flexibility and support secure ways of working.

Digital Workplace provides the products, services and support that enable Swiss Re's workforce to work from anywhere, anytime, in a stable and secure environment. This includes collaboration, productivity, endpoints, workplace foundations, governance and emerging workplace capabilities such as AI.

Workplace Operations is the global delivery and service-management capability behind that experience. It brings together remote and onsite user support, global Field Services, multimedia technology services and operational governance, in close partnership with the engineering and product organizations accountable for the technology platforms.

**About you**

To be successful in this role, you are already an established senior leader of large-scale, global IT operations or Digital Workplace / End User Services. You bring direct accountability for a comparable operation, not only individual service-management processes, engineering platforms or transformation programmes.

You have led leaders across regions and time zones, managed significant internal and outsourced service capacity, and improved service quality while controlling cost and operational risk. You are credible with engineers and service providers, but you measure success through employee productivity, reliable services and business outcomes.

You combine executive presence, sound judgement and calm incident leadership with the ability to build a strong organization. You know when to challenge, when to empower and how to turn operational evidence into clear priorities and decisions.

**You have:**

* 15+ years in enterprise IT operations or Digital Workplace, including several years as a Director or Head of a significant global service organization.
* Prior end-to-end accountability for global remote support, onsite Field Services, service governance and strategic outsourced service providers.

* Proven experience establishing data-driven operational improvement capabilities, using service analytics, digital employee experience telemetry and customer feedback to influence product roadmaps and engineering priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to work across Operations, Product and Engineering to eliminate recurring issues at their root cause, reduce support demand and improve the end-to-end employee experience.
* A proven record of leading managers across regions, building effective teams and developing talent, succession and delivery accountability.
* Deep practical knowledge of IT service management (ITIL / ITSM), major incidents, problem and change management, service transition, ServiceNow or comparable platforms, and measurable service and experience outcomes.
* Strong commercial and financial leadership, including substantial operating budgets, outcome-based managed-service contracts, supplier negotiation, service cost optimization and sourcing decisions.
* Demonstrated delivery of operational modernization with measurable improvements through automation, self-service, AI-enabled support, digital employee experience insights and continuous improvement.
* A strong understanding of workplace endpoint and collaboration technology, device and asset lifecycles, field support and multimedia services, sufficient to challenge technical and commercial decisions.
* Experience managing security, regulatory controls, audits, operational resilience and risk in a complex enterprise; experience in financial services or another regulated industry is advantageous.
* Credibility with senior executives and the ability to coordinate decisions across Technology, Security, Finance, Procurement and business stakeholders while protecting service continuity during change.

For Spain the **base salary range** for this position is between EUR 98,000 and EUR 163,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:

* the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
* the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.

In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based bonus.

**About Swiss Re**

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.
  
  
Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.
  
  
If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

title: Learning Support Assistant
description:
**About the School - The British School of Barcelona (City):**  
The British School of Barcelona (BSB) is a great school in a wonderful location. We are an HMC school and were judged by a recent BSO (British Schools Overseas) inspection to be outstanding in every area, including quality of education, safeguarding, pupil welfare and academic outcomes.
  
  
BSB is a large, very popular school for children aged 3 to 18. Our curriculum is based on the English National Curriculum, and we offer a wide range of GCSEs, A levels, BTEC and the International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB), all alongside a significant enrichment programme.
  
  
Approximately 2,350 students from more than 74 nationalities attend the school and over 375 staff work at BSB. We are based in several locations across the Barcelona area, including Castelldefels and Sitges, as well as our campuses in the heart of Barcelona: BSB Esperança, offering Early Years and Year 1, and BSB City (Luca), offering Primary, Secondary and Pre-University education.
  
  
In September 2026, we opened a new campus north of Barcelona, in the Maresme area, initially welcoming EYFS and Primary-aged students.
  
  
The growth of the school has been accompanied by significant investment over recent years, including the building of a state-of-the-art Pre-University Centre (Nexus), a full-sized 4G rugby and football pitch, dedicated STEAM facilities and the new BSB City and Maresme campuses.
  
  
Barcelona is a wonderful place to live, combining an amazing city with beaches and mountains nearby. The quality of life is excellent with a mild climate and year-round sunshine.
  
  
The school now has an exciting opportunity for an experienced **Learning Support Assistant** to join our fantastic team.
  
  
**About Cognita:**  
Cognita is a global leader in independent education. Founded in 2004, we are a growing community of 86 schools in 21 countries - in Europe, North America, Latin America, Asia and the Middle East - serving more than 100,000 students. Each of our schools are proudly unique, however our collective purpose is to create an environment where everyone can, "Thrive in a rapidly evolving world".
  
  
**About the Role:**  
We are seeking a **temporary, part-time Learning Support Assistant** to join our team at BSB City campus from **8th January 2027**.
  
  
The ideal candidate will support the education and social development of pupils under the direction of the Headteacher, Director of Student Support, Learning Support Lead and class teachers.
  
  
As a Learning Assistant at BSB, you will form part of the Learning Support Team. You will be required to demonstrate an informed and efficient approach to teaching and learning by adopting relevant strategies to support the work of the teachers and increase achievement of all pupils, including those with special educational needs and disabilities.
  
  
The appointed Learning Assistant will need a proven excellent track-record of:
  

* Demonstrating an understanding of how young children best learn.
* Communicating effectively and sensitively with pupils to adapt to their needs and support their learning.
* Contributing to effective assessment and planning by supporting the monitoring, recording and reporting of pupil performance and progress as appropriate to the level of the role.
* Knowing each individual child and supporting teachers to adapt teaching and learning to meet the specific needs of each pupil.
* Maintaining an interactive and inspiring learning environment.
* Ensuring well-being is at the heart of our provision.
* Having good interpersonal skills and able to work well as part of a team.
* Being committed to on-going professional development.

  
Join a team of enthusiastic individuals who appreciate the rigour of the English curriculum but embrace the freedoms offered by an international setting.
  
  
A commitment to the wider life of the school, and our enrichment programme, is an expectation of the job.  
  
  
**Who We Are Looking For:**  
We require:
  

* English: advanced.
* Qualification in support teaching and/or working with children with special educational needs.
* Minimum 2 years of experience providing support in teaching (desirable).

  
**Benefits at Cognita:**
  
All positions are offered with attractive packages including competitive salaries, places for staff children in BSB, and other local benefits.
  
  
*What we can offer you:*  

* A fantastic team of staff who are committed, supportive and collaborative.
* An opportunity to learn new skills.
* The wider support of BSB including access to high level CPD and future career opportunities.
* The support of the Cognita network including cross-school collaborative learning partnerships.

  
**How to Apply:**  
Complete this application before the closing date: **9am CET (UTC+1), Friday 4th December 2026**.
  
  
Early applications are encouraged, we reserve the right to interview and appoint prior to closing date for the right applicant.
  
  
Cognita Schools are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment. Safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks will be undertaken before any appointment is confirmed.
  
  
We are an equal opportunities employer committed to diversity and treating all employees with dignity and respect regardless of background.
  
  
We understand the value of AI tools and recognise the benefits they can offer to people who may need support with their writing. However, please be aware that we are increasingly rejecting CVs, expressions of interest and applications where the use of AI has resulted in content that feels generic, lacks personality or is indistinguishable from other submissions.
  
  
By using your own words, experiences and ideas to demonstrate your motivation for applying and your alignment with the role, you will give yourself the best opportunity to stand out in a highly competitive field.

title: Director of CRM & Patient Lifecycle Operations
description:
**About Impress**

We believe everyone deserves a smile they’ll love. We are IMPRESS, the largest chain of digital orthodontic clinics in Europe, revolutionizing the invisible orthodontic sector and bringing smiles to people's faces. Our unique combination of medical expertise and digitalization has earned us recognition as one of the top fastest-growing Health Tech companies by Forbes. Born in Barcelona in 2019, we have expanded across 10 countries with more than 110 locations, offering leading care and state-of-the-art technology.

##### **The Mission**

At Impress, we don't just provide orthodontics; we run a world-class operations and CRM engine. As the **Director of CRM & Lifecycle Operations**, you will own the entire patient journey—from the moment a lead is acquired to their final treatment result and beyond.

Your goal is to build a seamless, "always-on" communication ecosystem that maximizes funnel efficiency. You will leverage our existing **AI Voice and Text Agents**, scaling them to the next level to ensure that every patient interaction is personalized, timely, and high-converting.

##### **Location**

This position is **based on-site at our headquarters in Barcelona (Spain)**. You’ll be working closely with our international marketing team in a dynamic, collaborative office environment.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

***End-to-End Journey Orchestration***

Design and optimize the full patient lifecycle across all touchpoints (Email, WhatsApp, SMS, and Voice). You will be responsible for the transition between every key stage:

* **Acquisition & Lead Nurturing**: Turning interest into booked appointments.
* **Show-up Optimization**: Using behavioral triggers to ensure clinic attendance.
* **Patient Experience**: Managing the "in-treatment" journey to ensure clinical compliance and satisfaction.
* **Upselling & Advocacy**: Driving post-treatment value through retainers, whitening, and referrals.

***Next-Gen AI & Automation Leadership***

Impress is already at the forefront of AI. You will take ownership of our **AI Text and Voice Agents**, moving them beyond basic automation to sophisticated, human-like interactions. You will lead the strategy for how AI handles lead qualification, appointment rescheduling, and FAQ handling to 10x our operational capacity.

***Cross-Functional Command***

You are the glue between departments. You will work in the trenches with:

* **Marketing:** To align top-of-funnel messaging with lifecycle nurturing.
* **Booking Conversion Team:** To optimize the "Lead-to-Clinic" bridge.
* **Sales & Clinic Teams:** To ensure digital communications perfectly sync with human follow-ups and in-person experiences.
* **Omnichannel Funnel Efficiency:** Relentlessly audit and improve our multi-channel reach. You will decide when a patient needs an automated WhatsApp nudge, a personalized email, or a call from our AI Voice agent, ensuring we reduce Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) while maximizing Life Time Value (LTV).

##### **Who You Are**

* **The Architect:** You have 7+ years of experience building complex lifecycles in high-growth D2C, Health-Tech, or FinTech environments.
* **AI-Forward:** You aren't afraid of the future. You have experience (or a deep strategic interest) in deploying Conversational AI (LLMs, Voice Synthesis) to automate customer interactions.
* **Master of Orchestration:** You understand that a WhatsApp message must complement—not duplicate—a phone call. You thrive on managing "Online-to-Offline" (O2O) journeys.
* **Data-Driven Leader:** You speak the language of conversion rates, cohort analysis, and attribution. You use data to tell the story of where the funnel is leaking and how to fix it.

title: Account Manager
description:
Everseen: A leader in vision AI solutions for the world’s leading retailers.

### **The Role**

Are you a highly driven sales "hunter" who thrives on the thrill of the chase? Do you love opening closed doors, building pipeline from scratch, and winning net-new logos?

As an **Account Manager** with the EMEA GTM Team, you will be a driving force behind Everseen's market expansion. We are seeking a relentless, high-energy sales professional with a track record of running the full sales cycle to land new accounts. You won't just wait for leads; you will map out the enterprise retail territory, aggressively prospect decision-makers, and win new partners using our state-of-the-art Vision AI platform. If you have a passion for disruptive technology and a hunger to win, this is your next destination.

**At Everseen, you won't just be selling a product; you'll be a trusted partner to the world's leading retailers, helping them solve challenges with cutting-edge Vision AI.**

### **What You'll Do**

* **Hunt Net-New Logos:** Build, execute, and own outbound sales campaigns to break into major target grocery and retail accounts across the EMEA region.
* **Self-Source Pipeline:** Drive multi-channel prospecting (cold outreach, networking, social selling, industry events) to build and maintain a healthy, high-velocity sales pipeline from scratch.
* **Own the Full Sales Cycle:** Lead the entire sales process from initial cold outreach and discovery, through tailored product demos, leading RFI/RFP responses, and navigating complex corporate decision-making units to close.
* **Deliver Highly Strategic Demos:** Showcase the commercial power of Everseen’s suite (**Checkout Intelligence, Store Intelligence, and Data Intelligence**) by articulating clear, quantifiable ROI to retail stakeholders.
* **Negotiate & Close:** Navigate pricing discussions, commercial proposals, and contract negotiations to secure high-value commitments and drive new-business ARR.
* **Collaborative Landing & Expansion:** Seamlessly partner with Everseen’s Product, Engineering, and Operations (Customer Delivery) teams to guarantee successful Proof of Concepts (POCs) that lock in new long-term contracts.
* **Maintain Sales Hygiene:** Take ownership of accurate pipeline forecasting and CRM data discipline (Salesforce/HubSpot) to ensure clear reporting directly to senior leadership.

### **Collaborating With**

Senior sales team, product, engineering, operations (customer delivery) teams

### **Profile and Skills**

* **Experience:** 4-7 years of proven success in a **high-growth enterprise SaaS sales hunter or new-business acquisition role**—specifically targeting large retail, grocery, or complex operational environments in EMEA.
* **Sourcing Prowess:** A demonstrated history of **self-sourcing pipeline** and consistently meeting or exceeding net-new revenue targets.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree required. Sales methodology training (e.g., MEDDPICC, Challenger Sales, SPIN) is highly desirable.
* **Languages:** Fluency in English is essential. Fluency in French, German, or Italian is highly advantageous for regional target markets.
* **Hunter Mentality:**
  + *High Resilience:* You are comfortable with cold outreach, handle objections with ease, and are motivated by converting "no" into "yes."
  + *Strategic Prospecting:* Skilled at mapping complex retail corporate hierarchies, identifying key champions, and engaging C-level decision-makers.
* **Value-Based Selling:** Exceptionally strong business acumen and data literacy. You don't just sell features; you build deep business cases around asset protection, shrink reduction, and operational efficiency to demonstrate immediate ROI.
* **Competencies:**
  + *Ownership & Drive:* Relentless drive for results, owning the new business outcome from the first touch to the signed contract.
  + *Problem Solving:* Ability to navigate long sales cycles and pivot strategy when facing roadblocks.
  + *Collaboration:* Brings cross-functional internal resources together effectively to orchestrate a winning deal.

**About****Everseen**
=====================

Shrink and inefficiency cost global retailers more than a hundred billion dollars each year. But Everseen is changing that equation. We are a leader in vision AI, transforming business operations for global retailers by reducing shrink, improving operations, and delivering a better customer experience.

Supporting 11 of the top 20 global retailers, Everseen’s AI innovations help retailers save millions of dollars every month. Its flagship product, Evercheck, is deployed in 10,000 retail stores and 150,000 checkouts globally. Everseen operates at unmatched scale, processing over 15 million transactions, and more than six petabytes of video data, daily.

Trusted by major food, drug, mass, and specialty retailers around the world - including Kroger, Meijer, and Woolworths - we also partner with leading hardware, AI, and cloud computing providers such as Google, NVIDIA, NCR, and Dell.

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Cork, Ireland, Everseen has over 700 employees globally, with a European headquarters in Cork, Ireland, a U.S. headquarters in Miami, and hubs in Romania, Serbia, India, Australia, and Spain.

We are a dedicated team of inventors, research scientists, engineers, AI experts and retail industry veterans. Our culture is built on accountability, collaboration, and high standards. We take ownership of outcomes, prioritise our customers, operate as one team, move quickly with purpose, and continually raise the bar in everything we deliver.

  

Our Culture

Our culture is built on ownership and accountability, we own outcomes, not tasks. We stay relentlessly customer-first, letting their needs shape our priorities and decisions.

We work as one team: we challenge ideas, align quickly, and commit together. We move with pace, without compromising on simplicity or quality. And every day, we raise the bar, strengthening our talent, pushing innovation forward, and maximizing our impact.

  

Our Values

We OWN THE OUTCOME. No silos, no excuses.

We ARE CUSTOMER-FIRST. They guide our decisions.

We ARE ONE TEAM. Debate, decide, commit.

We MOVE WITH PACE. With simplicity and quality.

We RAISE THE BAR. On talent, innovation and impact.

**Our Commitment**
------------------

Everseen is committed to creating an environment where everyone can succeed. Our employees should feel a sense of belonging, have an opportunity to grow their careers, and feel free to be their most authentic selves. Everseen takes great pride in the diversity of its global workforce, and insists upon a safe, inclusive workplace where our differences are our collective strength. We treat each other with dignity, and respect, and require all employees, officers, and directors to seek to understand the importance and value to Everseen of diversity, and inclusion.

Everseen is committed to creating a safe environment for all employees and has a zero tolerance policy for bias and discrimination of any kind. Our work environment is one without offensive, hostile, or intimidating conduct, whether verbal, written or physical, in nature. **WANT TO REVOLUTIONIZE GOLF?**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a relationship-driven, proactive, and commercially minded Account Manager to join our Account Management team and manage our existing Toptracer Range partnerships across Spain and Portugal. In this role, you will focus on our existing customers, building long-term relationships, ensuring customer satisfaction, and identifying opportunities to grow and develop our partnerships.

As our customer base continues to grow, account renewals and customer retention are becoming increasingly important parts of our business. You will play a key role in strengthening these relationships, managing renewals, and helping our partners maximize the value of Toptracer's technology.

You will work closely with our Sales, Operations, Training, and Marketing teams to ensure an excellent partner experience and contribute to the continued growth of Toptracer in the Iberian region. We are particularly looking for someone with a commercial mindset who enjoys building relationships, understands the importance of customer success, and takes ownership of driving results. This is a fully remote position based in Spain, involving approximately 50% travel across Spain and Portugal. You will report to Head of Sales Operations.

**What You Will Do in Your Role**

* Manage and develop existing customer relationships across Spain and Portugal, acting as a key point of contact for our Toptracer Range partners.
* Drive customer retention and renewals, ensuring long-term partnerships and identifying opportunities to grow existing accounts.
* Help partners maximize their success by providing insights, recommendations, and support to improve venue performance and return on investment.
* Identify commercial opportunities within existing accounts, helping partners expand their use of Toptracer's technology and solutions.
* Build strong relationships through regular contact, including meetings, calls, and on-site visits to understand customer needs and identify opportunities.
* Collaborate across teams, working closely with Sales, Operations, Training, and Marketing to deliver a seamless customer experience.
* Support partner engagement initiatives, including events, marketing activities, and opportunities to strengthen the Toptracer community.
* Support product and feature launches, helping existing customers adopt new functionality and make the most of their Toptracer installations.

**What We Are Looking For**

We believe you will thrive in this role if you are a natural relationship builder who enjoys combining customer engagement with commercial development.

* Previous experience in Account Management, Sales, Customer Success, or a similar commercially focused role.
* A strong commercial mindset and the ability to identify opportunities, manage customer relationships, and contribute to business growth.
* A genuine interest in golf, either as an active golfer or through professional experience within the golf industry.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and develop long-lasting customer relationships.
* A proactive, independent, and results-oriented approach to managing accounts and customer needs.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple customer relationships and priorities.
* Fluency in Spanish and English, both written and spoken.
* Residence in Spain and willingness to travel approximately 50% of the time across Spain and Portugal.
* A valid driving license.
* Experience in the golf industry is highly valued, but we also welcome candidates with a strong commercial background and a genuine passion for golf.

**Why Join Toptracer?**

At Toptracer, we are changing the way golf is experienced, played, and enjoyed around the world. Our technology tracks golf balls in real time and transforms the experience for players, venues, and fans. From driving ranges to televised professional tournaments, Toptracer is helping make golf more engaging, accessible, and entertaining.

description:
**Human Resources | Global Talent & Development**

You will be responsible for shaping highly visible programs that support learning, career development, internal mobility, workforce readiness, and employee engagement across ADP's global workforce.

You'll serve as a key leader in advancing ADP's culture of continuous growth while helping associates navigate career opportunities, develop critical capabilities, and prepare for future business needs.

Success in this role requires strategic thinking, exceptional communication and facilitation skills, executive presence, and the ability to influence stakeholders across a highly matrixed global organization.

**What You'll Do**

**Enterprise Talent Growth Strategy**

* Lead the development and execution of ADP's enterprise talent growth strategy, aligning learning, development, career growth, talent mobility, and workforce readiness initiatives with business priorities.
* Create scalable talent development solutions that support associates across functions, levels, geographies, and different career and growth stages.

* Lead organization readiness initiatives that support the successful adoption of internal talent marketplace, tools, and transformational change efforts.

* Experience supporting talent mobility, career development, skills-based talent strategies, or workforce readiness initiatives.

When you join us, you’ll be part of a team that embraces digital technology and data to transform the way we work and the work we do. Every day, you’ll help make history, empowered to ignite your creativity and build something enduring.

### **Resilient trailblazers**

Here, the answers aren’t always available. So, you’ll need to bring a fearless, self-starter mindset to navigate uncharted territories. You’ll harness your ceaseless energy to discover and make the necessary connections with colleagues to shape the future and achieve maximum impact.

### **Agile movers**

Seize ownership and excel with autonomy to enjoy the constant rush of ground-breaking discovery. Your ability to anticipate sudden shifts and adapt swiftly will prove critical as you make your mark in an environment that rewards initiative and resilience.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID** R-263944 **Date posted** 11/10/2026

**Location:** Barcelona - Spain (3 days working from the office and 2 days working from home)

**Introduction to the role**

As an Associate Director, Study Data Manager, you will provide leadership for Clinical Data Management (CDM) delivery across one or more studies or projects within the Oncology therapeutic area. You will oversee the delivery of high-quality data through external partners or internally run studies, and provide training and coaching to junior colleagues. You will maintain awareness of trends and changes in external CDM approaches and act as a subject matter expert in process development and improvement.

**Typical Accountabilities**

* Acts as a team leader and provides training or coaching to junior colleagues within CDM.
* Performs line management responsibilities such as performance appraisals and mentoring.
* Represents Clinical Data Management at cross functional forums, meetings and provides timely feedback to partners.
* Understands health authority requirements and provide input into the Clinical Data Management related activities associated with regulatory inspections/audits and liaison with Clinical Quality Assurance. Provides CDM leadership for assigned projects, indications and/or studies dependent on size and scale of the project. Takes global accountability and serves as the second line of contact at the project level.
* Demonstrates leadership and operational expertise in the strategic planning and delivery of CDM deliverables at project level. Management and oversight of vendor contracts, resourcing and budget management and oversight of vendor performance for assigned projects and studies.
* Communicates and negotiates effectively with all other project level team members.
* Demonstrates a business understanding of the compound profile to identify and assist in successful application of consistent CDM processes and documentation across assigned projects, (i.e., ensuring consistency across data quality plans.).
* Provide oversight and expertise of external service providers or in-house teams to deliver quality data with compliance to study model procedures and standards; give guidance on AZ standards, processes, systems and expectations to external partners, internal partners, and third-party vendors.
* Responsible for proactive risk management and issue resolution/escalation connected to Clinical Data Management improvement or technology.
* Develops an understanding of CDASH and SDTM or other recognized industry standards and impact to programming team to ensure consistency of program level standards.
* Specialist in TA specific data capture and standards, conducts lessons learned and disseminate across the organization as appropriate.
* Provides data management expertise in supporting strategic and operational aspects of Data Management on project level.
* Demonstrates willingness to take on and lead any project level activity consistent with current or experience in support of study delivery.
* Performs any CDM related ad-hoc requests from Line Manager

**Education, Qualifications, Skills and Experience**

**Essential**

* University or college degree in the life sciences or related subject, pharmacy, nursing or equivalent relevant degree.
* Ability to successfully manage simultaneous trials and meet deadlines.
* Significant Clinical Data Management experience, preferable both from CRO and Pharma industry in more than one therapeutic area.
* Excellent understanding of clinical trials methodology, GCP, GDMP and medical terminology.
* Comprehensive knowledge of clinical standards, e.g., SDTM or CDASH.
* High attention to detail and a strong analytical mind-set.
* Demonstrates a comprehensive knowledge of database structures and of capturing and storing clinical information as they apply to CRF design, database development, data handling and reporting.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and proven ability to operate effectively in a global environment.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, negotiation, collaboration, conflict management and interpersonal skills.
* Cultural awareness.
* Experience of CRO and vendor management.

**Desirable**

* Experience as a lead of a large Phase III trial or multiple smaller trials.
* Knowledge of SQL, 4GL, VBA or R software.
* Experience of managing teams.

title: PPC Marketing Specialist (Remote)
description:
**Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.**

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

**You are the account manager. We do not have any.** You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

**You own the whole funnel, not the campaign.** Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

**You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.** We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

**You can live anywhere.** We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

 **Requirements**

**What the job looks like**

* **Own a set of DTC accounts** as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
* **Own the client relationship.** There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
* **Audit before you touch anything.** Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
* **Run brand and non brand as different businesses.** Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
* **Know what PMax is actually doing.** The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
* **Keep Google's automation on a leash.** Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
* **Own the feed.** Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
* **Own the tracking.** GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
* **Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it.** Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
* **Build the things the account needs.** Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

**You are a fit if**

* **You have done this with real money.** Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
* **You are fluent in the whole stack**, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
* **You are AI native, and you build.** This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
* **You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level.** You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
* **You are skeptical of your own numbers.** You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
* **You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls.** Where you live is up to you.
* Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

**You are not a fit if**

* "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
* You want to be told what to do this week.
* You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
* You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

  
**Benefits**

**Why this role is exciting**

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

Company: Impact Clients

Availability: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

We are building a new portfolio of organic Instagram and Facebook accounts focused on health, wellness, longevity, and supplement-related topics.

* Research viral content daily: Discover high-performing Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and other short-form videos in the health, wellness, longevity, and supplement markets.
* Write high-converting scripts: Develop original short-form video scripts designed to generate strong hooks, watch time, engagement, shares, and supplement affiliate sales.

If you're passionate about viral content, direct-response copywriting, AI technology, and health and wellness, we'd love to hear from you.

This is a role for someone who wants to shape — not just plan — the physical backbone of Amazon’s EU Non-Sort (NS) operations. You’ll own the strategic questions that determine how millions of units flow across the continent, from how volume enters the network to how it reaches the customer.  
  
The Role:  
You’ll lead end-to-end network and topology planning across mid-term (1-year) and long-term (3-year+) horizons for Amazon’s EU Non-Sort (NS) network. You won’t optimize one slice of the chain — you’ll own the whole picture. The role centers on two high-impact mandates:  
  

* Own the CEU+UK non-sort build plan end to end — from demand through fulfillment — meeting future demand at optimal cost across the full network.

  

* Drive EU-wide strategic initiatives that redefine non-sort network design, capacity planning, and operational processes.

  
Stakeholders & Planning Cycles:  
You’ll operate at the center of the organization, leading complex cross-functional programs with senior stakeholders across Finance, Engineering, Operations, Inbound Supply Chain, External Fulfillment (3P), Real Estate, and Transportation. Your recommendations will shape Amazon’s plan of record through every major planning cycle (SPS, OP1, OP2, QxG) and land in front of directors and VPs.  
  
What You’ll Own:  
As the owner of the end-to-end planning process, you’ll take strategic questions from ambiguity to execution: judging demand forecast inputs and building the capacity requirements, identifying solve options, and driving them through Supply Chain and Engineering teams. This means deep analysis across vendor and seller behavior, network-wide program trends, and seasonal demand patterns to build risk-aware plans that hold up against real-world uncertainty.  
  
Working hand in hand with Finance, you’ll define optimal investment levels through rigorous evaluation of options — new permanent and temporary sites, retrofits, and the timing and sequencing of network launches. You’ll own the trade-offs that matter:  

* Cost and risk optimization vs. operational flexibility
* Fixed vs. variable capacity investments
* Short-term operational needs vs. long-term network sustainability

  
You’ll lead the hardest analytical questions in the network: non-sort node optimization (TNS sites, IXD non-sort flows, 3P solutions, specialty handling), the Non-Sort Dual Network Architecture (DNA) framework that defines optimal network configurations. You’ll turn that analysis into clear recommendations on economics and operational viability — and you’ll defend them in the room with leadership.  
  
Beyond the Cycle — Strategy & Innovation:  
Beyond the planning cycles, you’ll constantly redefine the end-to-end non-sort strategy as the network evolves — and the sharpest edge of that work is the trade-off between speed and cost. Your job is to spin that flywheel, embedding what you learn into making step changes to improve EU-wide planning processes. That means:  
  

* Creating frameworks to crack complex business problems
* Building innovative, data-driven solutions
* Forging consensus across diverse and senior stakeholder groups
* Driving execution through multiple organizations

  
Key job responsibilities  
The role covers the following responsibility areas:  
1. Strategic Network Planning & Architecture  
2. Partnership with demand forecasting & capacity solve  
3. Annual Planning Cycle Leadership (SPS, OP1, OP2, QxG)  
4. Cross-Functional Influence & Stakeholder Management  
5. Peak Inbound Strategy & Resilience  
6. Leadership Communication & Decision Enablement

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in program or project management
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in stakeholder management and communication management

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
* Experience leading process improvements
