title: 3D Animator
description:
**Company Description**

**THE WORLD OF UBISOFT**

Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six, to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help us create the unknown!

**Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile** brings together dedicated and experienced professionals that are focused on crafting high-quality F2P games for mobile. We strongly believe in the core values at the centre of our Ubilife, which encourage us to take ownership of our work, continually striving for excellence while promoting the sharing of knowledge across individuals and teams, without losing our sense of enjoyment and fun, while taking care for one another. We strive for a safe and respectful workplace for all team members and we’re transparent about the measures we are taking to do so. For this reason, Ubisoft’s Code of Conduct has been released publicly on our corporate website for all current and future team members.

Do you want to join us in the world of mobile gaming? If so, read on!

 **Job Description**

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Create believable, high-quality animations and directly participating in implementing them in games.
* Define the animation style and workflows for new products under the supervision of the Producer and Lead Artist.
* Be able to rigging/skinning with low to medium polygon counts.
* Take active part in the game creation process by interacting with the design team.
* Contribute effectively to the art pipeline while understanding target platform constraints.
* Have a strong time management skills to reach project deadlines/milestones.
* Collaborate with the rest of the Art Team to obtain a consistent visual style for the game.
* Work with the Programming Team to integrate your animations in the game while respecting technical constraints.

  
**Qualifications**

**PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENTS**

In order for your application to be considered, you must submit a portfolio or other samples of your work. All portfolios must contain a detailed shot breakdown of the work. It must be very clear what you, the applicant, are responsible for in your reel, screenshots, scanned pictures, web page portfolio, etc.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Examples of basic cycles of a character. Cycle of walk, run, idle, attack, jump, etc.
* Examples of physics of movement. It can be a character doing parkour, moving weight, a skateboarder, etc.
* Examples of combination of cycles. Idle + attack, idle + run + attack, etc.
* It would also be interesting if among all the examples there is some quadrupeds, or characters of more than two feet.

* At least 4 or more years of experience in 3D Studio Max, Maya or Blender.
* Have a clear understanding of character motion, camera movement, physics-based motion and of the fundamental principles of animation.
* Be able to define and execute creative and stylish animations (vehicles, objects, characters).
* Positive attitude with the ability to receive and provide objective feedback
* Be a team player: we use agile development methods, where the team members are in permanent contact. Open mind and good communication skills are a must.
* Attention to detail, meticulous and organized working habits. Ability to multi-task and to adapt easily to change.
* Good command of English.
* Work permit for Spain obtained prior to applying for the position is a must.

Bonus

* Solid background in academic drawing, sketching and/or illustration.
* Working Unity experience.
* Have modelling skills (2D/3D), knowledge and experience of Blender, Unity, particle effects creation programs (e.g. combustion, particle illusion, Fork) and motion graphics programs (eg After Effects).
* Experience working on mobile games.
* Passion for games and some knowledge of the games industry.
* Spanish or Catalan is a plus.

  
**Additional Information**

**YOUR LIFE AT UBISOFT BARCELONA MOBILE (and PERKS)**

* **Ticket Restaurant:** 220€ per month, and a flexible compensation plan (ticket transport & ticket nursery free of taxes).
* **Flexible working hours:** 40-hour workweek with start times between 8 AM and 10 AM (or from 7:30 AM when working onsite to avoid traffic jams), and early leave from 4 PM (Fridays from 2 PM).
* **Reduced schedule** (35 hrs per week) in July and August, Easter, Christmas holidays, and special days like Sant Jordi and Revetlla de Sant Joan.
* **Personal Matters Hours:** 24 hours paid for by Ubisoft that you can use for personal matters during your work schedule
* **Holidays: 25 days per year + 1 day** on yourUbi-Birthday.
* **5 extra holiday days** on the year you celebrate your 5th/10th/15th/20th year with us.
* **Health insurance** with Cigna, including physiotherapy and psychology sessions at a reduced price.
* **Life Insurance** with AXA.
* **Office Gym** open from 7 AM to 8 PM
* **Mobile Device Grant** of 400 EUR starting in your 1st year in the company.
* **Language training** for English, Spanish, and French.
* **Professional development training & programs**, based upon request.
* **Ubisoft games** are available at a discount , and Ubisoft Connect in PC is free
* **Locally roasted craft coffee** by INCAPTO (it’s very, very good).

Ubisoft is committed to creating an inclusive work environment that reflects the diversity of our player community. We are an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, ethnicity, religion, gender sexual orientation, age or disability status.

**At ING we are looking for a Customer Journey Expert – Discretionary Portfolio Management**
============================================================================================

**Your role and work environment:**

ING Bank is entering in the Private Banking segment in Spain, a large market serving more than €600b in household wealth and showing a growth rate of 4% annually. ING Bank is in the process of launching a comprehensive new proposition tailored to Private Banking, digitally savvy customers. Join us in shaping the future of banking for Spain’s Private Banking & Investment.

ING Spain is building a new Discretionary Portfolio Management (DPM) proposition as a key component of its Private Banking offering. We are looking for a hands-on **Customer Journey Expert** to join the DPM team, help complete delivery and close existing gaps, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of the product.

You will contribute across the **end-to-end DPM journey**, from requirements and testing to implementation, banker training and continuous improvement. Working closely with the Product Owner and the wider team, you will connect customer and banker needs with technology, operations and regulatory requirements.

You will work in a **highly international and cross-functional environment**, collaborating with **One Investment Platform** and teams across Investments, Technology, Operations, Data, Finance, Risk, Legal and Compliance.

This is a **hands-on Customer Journey Expert role within the DPM team**, combining product delivery, customer experience and support for bankers. **Your key responsibilities:**

You will contribute to **DPM delivery, day-to-day product improvements and further evolution** through the following activities:

* **Complete the remaining DPM delivery**: Define and refine business requirements, document user stories and acceptance criteria, and work with technology and operations teams to bring outstanding capabilities into production.

As a **Customer Journey Expert** you are responsible of:

* **Customer Experience:** Provide the **best customer experience** by designing, mapping and constantly improving the customer journey. With an end-to-end process view being able to collect CX and data, translating into UX and IT landscapes

* **Digital Strategy**: As expert in digital experience, be proactive in the identification of new capabilities in our digital platform to **engage our customers** and increase **efficiency** of our assisted channels bringing the best experience in the moments of truth

* **Commercial Support:** Collaborate with marketing, customer interactions teams and bankers to translate the DPM value proposition into clear customer communications and practical supporting materials, incorporating feedback from the assisted channel.

* **Data Fluency:** Comprehend, define, select, and analyze data to gain insights that enhance the **decision-making process**. Use product and journey data, together with customer and banker feedback, to identify gaps, assess improvements and contribute to balanced cost-benefit assessments before and after implementation.

Work on items prioritized by the Product Owner, contribute to refinement, and deliver agreed activities in short cycles with the team. Identify dependencies, risks and impediments early, support their resolution, and use testing and feedback to improve solutions while reducing complexity.

* Excellent oral and written English skills

* Team player

* **Apply only via official ING platforms:** ING uses **Workday** and **LinkedIn** as its internal recruitment system. Applications should be submitted **only via our official career site or via ING job postings on LinkedIn**.

**En ING buscamos un/a Customer Journey Expert – Gestión Discrecional de Carteras**

**Tu rol y entorno de trabajo:**

  
  

ING Bank está entrando en el segmento de Banca Privada en España, un gran mercado que gestiona más de 600.000 millones de euros de patrimonio de los hogares y que muestra una tasa de crecimiento anual del 4 %. Este es un **rol de Customer Journey Expert con un enfoque práctico dentro del equipo de DPM**, que combina delivery de producto, experiencia de cliente y soporte a bankers. Asumirás la responsabilidad de las actividades acordadas y contribuirás a las mejoras del producto, mientras que la gestión y priorización del backlog seguirán siendo responsabilidad del Product Owner.

  
  

**Tus principales responsabilidades:**

  
  

Contribuirás al **delivery de DPM, las mejoras del día a día del producto y su evolución futura** mediante las siguientes actividades:

* Capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma y tomar la iniciativa.

* Más de 5 años de experiencia profesional en banca.
* Experiencia con productos de inversión y/o customer journeys de Banca Privada; estar familiarizado/a con DPM será un plus.
* Experiencia en gestión omnicanal de la experiencia.
* Conocimientos de técnicas de investigación y diseño de productos UX serán un plus.
* Experiencia práctica traduciendo necesidades de negocio en requisitos y dando soporte a pruebas de aceptación de usuario e implementación.
* Capacidad para explicar productos y procesos de inversión de forma clara y preparar materiales prácticos de formación para bankers.
* Sólido dominio del inglés escrito y hablado.
  

  

**¿Qué ofrecemos?**

  
  

El tiempo que pasas en el trabajo, los retos a los que te enfrentas o las lecciones que aprendes son muy importantes, pero… ¿qué pasa con tu vida personal? En ING queremos que tu trabajo te llene en todos los sentidos, y por eso cuidamos hasta el más mínimo detalle.

¡Descubre todo lo que te espera!

  
  

**Balance That Works.**

Teniendo en cuenta primero las necesidades de nuestros clientes, las del equipo y las tuyas propias, acordamos cuándo venir a ING MAD y cuándo es mejor trabajar desde casa. Más tiempo juntos cuando importa, más libertad cuando la necesitas.

  
  

**Tarjeta restaurante.**
  
Para que pensar qué comer no te quite tiempo ni te quite las ganas.

  
  

**Nuestra casa será tu hogar.**

Para ti y toda tu familia (cónyuge/pareja e hijos/as).

Te ayudamos a proteger lo que más te importa.

Servicio de fisioterapia en las instalaciones.

Servicio Gympass.
  
Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI+), Leonas & RIÑG.
  
Programa internacional de trabajo en remoto.

title: Global Permitting & Approvals Manager
description:

**About the company**

**Utopia** is an ultra-luxury hospitality and lifestyle brand creating a global ecosystem of properties and experiences.

We develop private villa retreats in beautiful locations around the world, each with high-end service. **Utopia** also offers a wider ecosystem of leisure experiences and services available both to those staying on property and to external visitors.

For hospitality professionals, it means collaborating with a brand where service is personal, attentive, and built around each guest’s stay.

We’re a young, ambitious team with high standards and a hands-on approach. We value strong ideas, practical thinking, attention to detail, and people who are ready to take ownership of their part of each project. If you’re interested in architecture, design, hospitality, or guest experience, we invite you to explore opportunities with **Utopia.**

**About the role**

We are looking for a hands-on Global Permitting & Approvals Manager to lead permitting and regulatory approvals across our international development portfolio.

You will research local requirements, translate them into clear technical tasks for project teams, coordinate AORs and local consultants, and drive approval processes through to completion.

* Coordinate application submissions, authority comments and final approvals.
* Identify critical risks, resolve blockers and protect construction milestones.
* Implement standardized permitting processes and portfolio-wide reporting.

* Hands-on construction permitting experience in at least two countries and three project locations.

* Experience of permitting in at least 2 of selected locations: Spain, South Africa, Brazil, Costa Rica, the Dominican Republic, the UAE

* Strong ownership, analytical thinking and process-building capabilities.

* Spanish and/or Portuguese.

title: Brand Manager (crafts)| DTC E-commerce | 100% Remote EU
description:
At Foxelli, we’re building more than e-commerce brands - we’re building a tribe of thoughtful humans: AI enthusiasts, curious builders, and ambitious minds who care about doing meaningful work together. Ten years in, our D2C brands reach millions and generate over $20M annually. Our focus stays simple: create products customers love and a team that actually enjoys building them.

If you love to learn, experiment, think boldly, make decisions, and build things that matter -you’ll feel at home with us..

**The role**

We're hiring a Brand Manager to own This Month's Craft end to end, with churn as your main KPI. This Month's Craft is a monthly craft subscription box with two tracks: Creative (relaxing, artistic crafts) and DIY (practical, skill-building crafts).

Your biggest lever on churn is the box: finding, testing, and approving crafts that subscribers love and actually finish. You'll also analyse who we acquire, how the cancellation flow and failed-payment recovery perform, and work closely with customer service and analyze customer feedback. Just as important: you dig into why things happen and check whether each change actually worked. We need your product judgement and your ownership.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Find, test and approve the crafts.** Own the box pipeline for both tracks. Scout craft ideas, order samples, make every kit yourself, and approve or reject it.
* **Own kit quality.** Every kit must be finishable at its stated level: clear instructions, the right tools and materials, nothing missing, packaging that survives shipping. Catch problems before a box ships, not in the reviews.
* **Plan the box calendar.** Balance variety, seasonality and difficulty across Creative and DIY, within the cost-per-box target.
* **Learn from subscribers.** Read and summarize reviews, CS tickets, community posts and cancellation reasons every month, and use them to shape the boxes.
* **Own churn.** It's your main KPI. Understand what drives it by box, channel and track, and act on it.

description:

Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale.

**This is a builder's role, not a traditional executive management position.**

* Establish and lead the Platform Engineering organisation from the ground up.
* Design and implement scalable, reliable platform services supporting our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.
* Define the architecture and engineering standards used across the organisation.
* Establish clear ownership boundaries and effective collaboration with product engineering teams.

* Demonstrated experience building and scaling engineering teams, rather than exclusively managing established organisations.
* A strong track record of delivering and operating production platforms within a technology product company.

* Deep, hands-on production experience with Kubernetes.
* Strong infrastructure-as-code experience, particularly Terraform or Terragrunt.
* Proven experience implementing GitOps and CI/CD pipelines using Argo CD or comparable technologies.
* Strong AWS expertise and practical experience designing cloud-portable architectures.
* Experience with Azure or Google Cloud is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated experience with self-hosted or on-premises enterprise software deployments.
* Practical experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and data residency requirements.

description:

We are Quadcode, a fintech company excelling in financial brokerage activities and delivering advanced financial products to our global clientele. Our flagship product, an internal trading platform, is offered as a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution to other brokers.

We’re looking for a product-oriented **Senior iOS Engineer** to join our **iOS team**.

You will contribute to our flagship trading platform, used by millions of users worldwide.

The project focuses on a major redesign, improving the application architecture, delivering an adaptive UI across different screen sizes and device families, and developing new business features to further enhance the product.

In this role, you’ll work on application architecture, platform-level solutions, and key user-facing features. You’ll have the opportunity to influence the technical direction of our iOS application, improve existing solutions, and contribute directly to its product evolution.

Our team includes 3 iOS Developers, 3 QA Engineers, and a Team Leader.

We follow Agile and Scrum methodologies with 2-week sprints and daily meetings at 11:00 EET/EEST.

We also follow an AI-first approach, actively integrating AI tools into our daily engineering workflows, including code development, code reviews, debugging, and problem-solving.

### **Project Description**

* Programming Language: All code is written exclusively in Swift. There are only a few classes written in Objective-C, which are necessary for interoperability with C++ code.

* User Interface: Legacy code uses Storyboards and NIB files, while new code is written programmatically. One of the current priorities is redesigning the application and delivering an adaptive UI across different screen sizes and device families.

* Data Storage: CoreData is used for data management. Experience with multithreading is required.

* Unit Tests: The Nimble framework is used for unit testing.

* UI Tests: Cucumber is used for user interface testing. The team is also transitioning towards native Swift-based test automation.

* Compatibility: The minimum supported iOS version is 15.

* Build System: Tuist is used for dependency management and project building.

* C++ Integration: Occasionally, reading and integrating C++ code is required.

* Reactive Programming: RxSwift is actively used in the project.

* Architecture: New code follows the MVVM architectural pattern with the use of Coordinators.

* Modularity: The project uses a multi-module architecture with more than 40 modules, and the number of modules is constantly increasing.

* Legacy Code: The project includes legacy code that needs to be maintained and improved. It is important to understand existing implementations, refactor them when necessary, and introduce changes safely without disrupting existing functionality.

* AI Integration: AI tools are actively integrated into everyday development workflows, supporting code development, code reviews, debugging, and technical problem-solving.

### **Tasks**

* Develop and maintain our iOS application, including implementing new business features and improving existing functionality.
* Contribute to the redesign and modernization of the iOS product, including adaptive UI implementation across different screen sizes and device families.
* Design and improve application architecture and platform-level solutions within a multi-module environment.
* Integrate RESTful APIs, handle network requests, and implement WebSocket and other socket-based connections.
* Work with CoreData, multithreading, and asynchronous operations to ensure application performance and stability.
* Maintain, refactor, and improve legacy code while ensuring compatibility with existing functionality.
* Develop and maintain unit and UI tests to ensure application quality and reliability.
* Troubleshoot and debug technical issues, identify performance bottlenecks, and implement appropriate solutions.
* Participate in code reviews and collaborate with designers, product managers, QA Engineers, and other developers throughout the development lifecycle.
* Actively use AI tools to improve development workflows, code quality, and engineering efficiency.

### **Requirements**

* Deep knowledge of Swift and experience writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
* Strong understanding of the iOS SDK, including UIKit, CoreData, and CoreAnimation.
* Experience with Auto Layout and Xcode Interface Builder.
* Experience integrating RESTful APIs, working with network requests, handling server responses, and processing JSON data.
* Experience working with WebSocket and other socket protocols, including establishing and maintaining persistent connections with a server.
* Experience maintaining, refactoring, and improving legacy code without disrupting existing functionality.
* Experience writing unit and UI tests. Knowledge of testing tools and frameworks such as XCTest and Quick/Nimble.
* Deep understanding of OOP principles and their practical application in iOS development.
* Experience applying architectural and design patterns such as MVC, MVVM, VIPER, etc.
* Experience working with modular architectures and multi-module iOS projects.
* Strong knowledge of reactive programming and practical experience with RxSwift.
* Understanding of multithreading and asynchronous programming in iOS.
* Experience working with third-party libraries and dependencies.
* Fluent in Russian and at least B1 level of English.

### **Nice to have**

* Experience developing fintech or trading applications, or working on other high-load products with a large user base.
* Basic understanding of C++ and experience integrating Swift with C++ code.

### **We offer**

* Full-time remote work (service provider contract).
* Competitive compensation (EUR).
* 20 paid days off annually.
* Corporate AI subscriptions (Claude, Gemini, GPT, etc.).
* Access to a rewards marketplace offering products and language courses, redeemable using the company’s internal currency.
* A strong team of engineers.

Our growth machine has to be able to:

At Paradox,

We believe self-help is broken: generic theory, a quick high, no real change.

We believe people deserve more. More than content. More than motivation.

They deserve a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. A small growth team running a self-learning machine can out-test, out-learn and out-grow teams a hundred times its size.

We hold ourselves to the standards of Apple, Spotify and MasterClass. While others hide their numbers, we let our results speak.

As Head of Growth, you’ll be the architect of a growth machine that learns by itself. In a classic growth team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the work, you design the system, set the bar and make the calls.

You don’t just manage a team, you get your hands dirty to identify growth levers and pull them yourself.

------------------------

### **1. Build the agents that run growth**

* The old way: a Head of Growth hires people and agencies, briefs them, and checks their work.
* At Paradox: your team is mostly agents, and you build them yourself. You write their skills, plug them into our tools (ad accounts, CRM, webinars, email, analytics) and write the evals that tell an agent what "good" means: a hook that stops the scroll, a page that converts, a test that’s worth its cost.
* You give autonomy step by step: first an agent suggests, then it acts once you approve, then it acts alone within a budget and guardrails. You move each agent up a level only when its track record earns it.
* Example: in your first month you build the agent that reviews every ad set overnight. At first it only suggests. By month three it pauses losers and moves budget by itself within limits you set, and you only see what was decided and why.

### **2. Build an acquisition engine that runs day and night**

* The old way: a media buyer checks the dashboards each morning, changes bids by hand and waits for the weekly report.
* At Paradox: you build and improve the agents that watch every ad set, page, webinar and email sequence around the clock. They spot what’s dropping, find the cause, fix it or launch a variant, and report what they did.
* You give autonomy step by step: an agent can pause an ad on its own long before it can raise a budget. You decide where each agent stops and a human takes over.
* Example: show-up rate drops on Tuesday’s webinar. Before anyone notices, an agent has found the cause (a reminder that never went out), fixed it and started testing a new reminder sequence.

### **3. Build a creative machine with taste**

* The old way: a creative team briefs an agency, waits two weeks and gets five ads.
* At Paradox: you build the agents that turn every live, interview and member story into hooks, ad cuts and shorts, that study what the best advertisers in the world are running, and that write in our voice.
* Your taste becomes the eval: you write down what makes a great hook, a great cut and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Example: one webinar becomes dozens of hook variants by the next morning. You keep the best few, and next week the agents’ first drafts are already closer to your bar.

### **4. Build measurement that checks itself**

* The old way: an analyst rebuilds the numbers in a spreadsheet at the end of the month, and nobody trusts them.
* At Paradox: you build the agents that connect every touch to cash, from ad to lead, live, sale and transformed member, and that audit the tracking after every campaign.
* No number, no test: you define the KPIs that matter (CAC, show-up, close rate, LTV, payback), and agents refuse to launch a test that isn’t wired to one.
* Example: after each live, an agent cross-checks the ad platform, the CRM and our analytics, finds where they disagree and fixes the leak before the next live.

### **5. Make the machine better every week, and keep the soul**

* The old way: lessons live in people’s heads and leave with them.
* At Paradox: every result goes back into the company brain, and agents read it before proposing anything. The machine never learns the same lesson twice.
* You measure the machine itself: tests per week, time from idea to live, the share of the work done without a human, and how many agents moved up an autonomy level this month. You push those numbers up.
* And always: no fake scarcity, no fake claims, real stories told with consent. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

**How you’ll know you’re AI-native:** you spend your time building agents, writing evals and making calls, not doing the work by hand. Most experiments are generated and shipped by agents. The output grows every month while the headcount doesn’t.

**You’ll own these KPIs:** LTV / CAC ratio, funnel conversion rate by stage, experiments launched per week.

**Desired outcomes:** conversion rates 2x better than baseline, growth experimentation that runs continuously, a predictable growth engine.

**Tools you’ll master:** GA4, Optibase, Vidalytics, Clarity, Hotjar, Amplitude, Figma, Looker Studio, VWO, Optimizely, Claude Code, and whatever helps you see what others miss.

**THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE**
---------------------------------

**Experience :**

* You have ideally a minimum of 3 years of experience in Conversion Rate Optimization, Growth Experimentation, or Performance Marketing, ideally within SaaS, e-commerce, or digital product environments.
* You have a track record of designing, implementing, and scaling A/B and multivariate tests that have generated measurable improvements in revenue, user activation, or conversion.
* You’ve built with AI and agents yourself: Claude Code, automations, APIs, evals, creative pipelines. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

**You are :**

* A Conversion Architect, skilled at diagnosing funnel bottlenecks and translating data into structured experimentation roadmaps that deliver measurable business outcomes.
* A Behavioral Strategist, fascinated by what drives human action, able to mix cognitive psychology, UX, and persuasion frameworks to design experiences that convert because they resonate.
* A Data-driven Creator, fluent in GA4, Hotjar, AB Tasty, VWO, Amplitude, not just running tests, but connecting insights to revenue, retention, and lifetime value.

**Traits :**

* Loop thinker: you see every channel as a loop that can learn, and you can’t stop yourself from closing it.
* Taste: you know a great hook in two seconds, and you’d rather ship one great ad than ten average ones.
* Numbers-honest: you say when a test failed. You care about real revenue, not vanity metrics.
* Builder, not manager: you’d rather build the system than coordinate an agency.
* Growth over ego: you love hard feedback, you read, study and learn fast.
* Cross-disciplinary: you move from psychology to spreadsheet to creative brief to code.
* Analytical: you turn a vague problem into a clear hypothesis, a metric and an experiment.

**Language**

French: Native / Bilingual

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

**IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU**
---------------------------

If you need clarity before chaos — wrong place.

If you prefer balance over intensity — wrong season.

If you build to deliver, not to elevate — wrong mission.

If you want to optimize without getting your hands dirty in landing pages, copy, or design — wrong role.

If you want to manage agencies and budgets rather than build a machine — wrong role.

If you’re obsessed with psychology, systems and creative…

If you want to build the growth machine that learns faster than anyone else…

If you dream of using AI to bring transformation to millions of people…

**WHY JOIN US**
---------------

Build one of the first truly self-learning growth machines, and write the playbook others will copy.

Grow something that genuinely changes lives, with the proof to show it.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.

**Growth & Ambition**

* > Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

**Competitive Salary**

But you don’t just want a competitive paycheck, you also want…

**Impact & Meaning**

* > Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people
* > Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something!

We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.

But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve…

**Freedom & Well Being**

* > A company culture based on autonomy & accountability
* > Flexible working hours (but very hard working)
* > A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want
* > Standing desks paid by the company if you live far from our offices
* > Work on Mac, for us it counts :)
* > 350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself (for your gym, or dance class or whatever make you feel great)

-> 150€ of books or education - At Paradox, we are learner lovers and we want to support you in that

-> Access to Athena - our Paradox AI Coach supporting you on anything personal or professional, we want you to live your best life

**HOW TO APPLY**
----------------

To complete the recruitment process, each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this : do not apply

If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us

**HIRING PROCESS**
------------------

That job description resonated with you?

Here is your tailor made hiring process

A 6 to 8 minutes application survey (with a short video assignment)

A 30mn video call with Timy, HR, to deep dive into your career path and ambitions

A 1h video call, to discuss how you’d fit into Paradox’s Growth team

A 1h culture-fit video call, to assess alignment with our values and mindset

A 1h final video call with David, CEO, to discuss the growth vision and the next milestones to build

Reference check to understand how you operate across environments and help set you up for a smooth onboarding

Welcome aboard!

**About our hiring process**

Our recruitment process is tailored to do our best to avoid that you or us realize that we’re not a perfect fit. Every step serves a purpose and will allow us to get to know you better as much as it’ll help you understand more where you’ll be stepping in.

We also want you to have time to ask all of your questions regarding the mission, the long-term vision of your team and the company, our values, with the relevant interlocutor in front of you.

If you’re not joining to tweak landing pages.

If you’re here to engineer behavioral change at scale, for millions.

Welcome to Paradox.

Let’s build the Operating System for Greatness.

title: Web Experience Manager (Technical Implementation & CRO) - Contractor
Head of Rider Experience MX
description:
Barcelona, Spain

Full-time

Operations

  

**Who we are**
--------------

Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

### **Job Description**

Rider support shapes both riders’ experience and our operating costs, and every change to it affects delivery time, redispatching and rider fraud. Over the next 12 to 18 months you will define what rider support looks like at Glovo: the channel strategy and the support flows that improve the rider experience while keeping those operational metrics in balance. You will adapt it to each market and to new regulations and rider model changes, so the rider experience and the business are optimised at the same time.

**THE JOURNEY**

* Define the rider support channel strategy: which channels for which contact reasons, in which markets.
* Design and optimise support flows that raise rider satisfaction and contact resolution and lower contact ratio.
* Balance the support experience against delivery time, redispatching and rider fraud, and tackle rider fraud together with Operations, Legal and Product.
* Adapt rider support and operations to market differences, new regulations and changes in rider models, working with Legal and local Ops so the business stays compliant.
* Plan and run the rider experience program roadmap against the Masterplan metrics, and align the MX teams, Supply Ops, Logistics, RTO, GX, local Ops, Product and Legal around shared goals.
* Define the KPIs, track them, and turn the data into insight that drives prioritisation and automation opportunities, working with Product teams.
* Lead and coach a team of five (two Project Managers, one Help Center Specialist, one Business Analyst and one Ops Analyst), building their skills and retention.

### **Qualifications**

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE**

Must have

* +8 years of experience in project management, Operations or other functions with execution and critical thinking
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and stakeholders, and driving change.
* Strong Data skills. Strong judgement to balance competing metrics such as experience against cost and operational impact: you define and track them and turn analysis into business insight
* Demonstrated experience in process optimisation, support automation, and self-service flow design at scale.
* Experience leading and coaching people.
* Ownership, adaptability, empathy, bias for action, and the ability to collaborate and influence.
* Proficiency in English.

Nice to have

* Experience in customer support or rider operations, including channel strategy.
* Experience working with Legal or in a regulated environment, such as rider or gig-platform regulation.
* Experience working with Product teams.
* Spanish.

### **Additional Information**

At Glovo, your success is defined by both results and behaviors. We hire for excellence in craft and for the Leadership Principles that shape how we think, decide, and collaborate. What you achieve matters and how you achieve it defines us. Together, they move the business forward and deliver great experiences. **Learn more about our Leadership Principles** **here****.**

Here at Glovo, we thrive on diversity, we believe it enhances our teams, products, and culture. We know that the best ideas come from a mashup of brilliant diverse minds. This is why we are committed to providing equal opportunities to talent from all backgrounds – all genders, racial/diverse backgrounds, abilities, ages, sexual orientations and all other unique characteristics that make you YOU. We will encourage you to bring your authentic self to work, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels heard.

Feel free to note your pronouns in your application (e.g., she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

**So, ready to take the wheel and make this the ride of your life?**  
  
Delve into our culture by taking a peek at our Instagram and check out our LinkedIn and website!

title: PRODUCT MANAGER – REWARDED OFFERS
description:
##### **WHO WE ARE**

At **Macadam**, we've built an app that rewards people for walking. With over **15 million users worldwide**, we help people turn daily steps into positive habits that improve health and wellbeing.

Our product sits at the intersection of **gamification, lifestyle and wellbeing**, with a colourful, playful, character-driven universe rooted in mobile gaming.

##### **THE ROLE**

Users earn Macadam's coins by walking, and also by doing things our partners pay for: playing games in offerwall, taking surveys, shopping through cashback, completing brand challenges. These rewarded offers are one of our largest revenue streams, and the work is only getting bigger.

We're creating a dedicated Rewarded Offers squad and looking for its first Product Manager. You will sit in a small, autonomous team: you, a senior full-stack developer, and support from a designer and a data analyst. You report to our Head of Product, and will partner closely with the Revenue team in charge of partner negotiation. You own the problem and the outcome: more users earning through offers every day, with a healthy margin. You frame it, decide what matters, ship with the team, then read the numbers and make the call. And where the change is small, you build it yourself.

This is a role for someone with a "product builder" mindset, looking to take strong ownership and to deliver high impact.

***This role is based in Barcelona. We're looking for candidates who are already living in the city or ready to relocate.***

##### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Own the squad's metrics: the share of daily users who complete an offer, revenue and margin per earning user, for offerwall, survey and affiliation.
* Own the roadmap: frame the problem, prioritise hypotheses, write product specs, run A/B tests, read results, and decide next steps.
* Integrate new providers with your developer, help rank offers by what they actually earn, and keep the rewards economy healthy.
* Work with the Revenue team and our partners (offerwall and survey providers, affiliate networks) to turn market opportunities into product changes, with care for fraud and compliance.
* Build end-to-end with AI: deliver product features, from initial design and prototyping to production, when the technical environment allows.
* Grow with the squad: the scope widens as the team does, with the option of more developers over time.

##### **WHAT YOU'LL BRING**

* 2–4 years in product management (or a close role, such as growth, product analyst or product owner with features you shipped end to end), ideally on a consumer mobile app.
* Solid data and problem-solving mindset: you can pull a funnel, define a metric, run an A/B test and tell when a result doesn't hold up. SQL or a BI tool (Metabase, Mixpanel, Amplitude or similar) is a plus.
* Experience working side by side with developers on trade-offs and scope.
* Advanced AI proficiency & technical fluency: a habit of working with AI tools to conduct user research and competitive analysis, and to set up automated workflows that accelerate product discovery and execution.
* Design and user experience sensitivity.
* Autonomy and judgement: you propose the plan and don't wait for one.
* Clear written English. French or Spanish is a strong plus.

##### **NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience with offerwalls, surveys, affiliate, cashback, or marketplaces.
* Background in gaming, gamified or rewards products.
* Familiarity with partner integrations (APIs, postbacks, attribution), fraud and reward integrity, and technical understanding.
* Interest in behavioural design.

##### **WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU**

* Real ownership of a revenue-critical area, reaching 15+ million users.
* Direct work with a senior full-stack developer, and the chance to build your own squad.
* Growth, learning and exposure in an international team.
* Offices in the heart of **Barcelona**.
* Hybrid working culture with international flexibility.
* Meal voucher.
* Wellness allowance (Wellhub).
* Private healthcare (Alan).
* 4 extra Macadam holiday days.
* Friday team lunch.
* Company events and offsites.

##### **WHY MACADAM?**

We don't just talk about change, we walk it. Our principles:

***Make it happen***: take ownership, drive outcomes that matter.

***Build together, win together***: support and challenge each other to go further.

***Trust the data***: decide clearly, act confidently, measure what counts.

***Build for people***: design with empathy, simplicity, real humans in mind.

***Think bigger***: set the bar high, push boundaries, imagine better ways.

Want to see what we're about? Check out our website, Linkedin, Notion and Instagram page.

*Macadam is an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive team.*

###### **Come walk with us. Join the movement and become a part of something meaningful!**

title: Project Manager - Sourcing Excellence W/M/X - Permanent
description:
Pionnier des ventes événementielles en ligne depuis 2001 et acteur incontournable du e-commerce en Europe, Veepee collabore avec plus de 7 000 marques pour proposer des produits à forte décote, disponibles sur une durée limitée. Présent dans de nombreux univers parmi lesquels la mode, la maison, le vin, le voyage, ou encore la beauté ... Veepee a réalisé en 2024 un chiffre d’affaires de 3,3 milliards d’euros TTC et compte 5 000 collaborateurs répartis dans 10 pays.

### **JOB DESCRIPTION**

As the Project Manager for Sourcing Excellence, you will play a central role in transforming our Sourcing journey across Europe. We are looking for someone eager to leverage AI potential for innovation—someone who loves experimenting with AI tools and actively sharing that knowledge across the sourcing team. Reporting directly to the Head of Commercial Strategy, you will take full ownership of shaping, defining, and executing innovative initiatives to improve the sourcing journey — driving solutions across all retail sectors, European Sales Analysts, and Key Account Managers by Q4 2027.

Your core focus will be delivering measurable business value: driving efficiency across the Sourcing journey by streamlining data preparation, designing scalable target processes, and empowering our commercial teams to focus on high-value analysis and negotiation.

### **TASKS**

### **1. Project Vision, Governance & Delivery**

* Develop the strategic vision for the project by synthesizing commercial team feedback and organizational goals, driving innovation through the integration of advanced AI capabilities.
* Serve as the Project Lead within our delivery framework, taking ownership of business requirements, proof-of-concept validation, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
* Maintain a clear, consolidated project roadmap with defined milestones, owners, and timelines.
* Facilitate effective project governance with core working teams and executive sponsors.
* Build and manage a Key User Community to gather structured feedback, validate user testing against defined quality thresholds, and prioritize the backlog.

### **2. Business Requirements & Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Drive alignment across key business stakeholders, including Sales Analysts, Key Account Managers, Sales Production, Logistics, Finance, and Data Science.
* Draft clear, comprehensive, and detailed Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) encompassing functional scope, business rules, acceptance criteria, and edge cases.
* Build robust business cases for new program modules, clearly defining user impact, operational options, cost structures, and anticipated ROI, creating POCs with AI to validate & improve the business case.

### **3. Process Design, Optimization & Value Tracking**

* Map and optimize the end-to-end Sourcing journey across its core steps.
* Own and maintain the business value model—tracking weighted time savings per sale across tasks, user profiles, and business units.
* Focus on true process redesign: identifying opportunities to eliminate or automate redundant tasks rather than simply accelerating existing manual steps.
* Publish regular performance dashboards tracking adoption rates, realized value against plan, and module quality standards.

### **4. Change Management, Rollout & Adoption**

* + Design and execute tailored rollout and change management strategies (communications, training materials, and sequencing) across European sectors and countries.
  + Define and formalize the ongoing operational support model and SLA structure prior to go-live.
  + Monitor user adoption post-launch, actively identifying and closing gaps between feature eligibility and actual usage.
  + Ensure comprehensive documentation of all processes and activation criteria to ensure long-term operational excellence.

### **MUST HAVE skills**

* **Experience:** Minimum 5 years of professional experience in a commercial, sourcing, operations, or management consulting environment, with demonstrated expertise in project management and process design. Experience delivering internal-facing tech/data products is highly valued.
* **Project & Stakeholder Management:** Proven track record of managing complex cross-departmental projects through structured planning and collaborative leadership.
* **AI Proficiency & Innovation:** Stay up-to-date with AI developments, leverage AI to its full potential, and actively apply AI capabilities to drive transformation and project success.
* **Business Analysis & Requirements:** Strong capability in writing detailed, actionable business requirements for technical development teams.
* **Commercial Skills**
* **Data & Business Literacy:** Proficient in building, defending, and tracking business value models and performance metrics.
* **Tech Familiarity:** Comfortable working with tech & data products, understanding their practical business applications and performance constraints.
* **Change Management:** Excellent communication and influence skills, with experience managing change and animating key user communities.
* **Languages:** Business fluency in English is required; international work experience is a plus.
* **Certifications:** Lean/Six Sigma or Agile certifications are a bonus.

### **✅ BENEFITS**

Variable bonus
  
Hybrid work model with the possibility to smartworking 2 days a week
  
Online language learning Platform
  
Intensive workday on Friday
  
Health Insurance
  
Holidays: 27 days

### **❓ TEAM, WHO WE ARE ?**

You will join the Sourcing Excellence team—a dedicated, collaborative group focused on shaping the methodologies, tools, and processes supporting over 400 local sourcing professionals across Europe.

Our Team Values:

* Grow Together: We succeed as a team, supporting each other's professional growth.
* Transparency: Open communication and freedom of expression are encouraged.
* Empathy & Humility: We stay grounded and customer-focused in helping our sourcing teams.
* Continuous Improvement: We step out of our comfort zones, welcome constructive feedback, and embrace continuous learning.
* Excellence: We bring structure and rigor to everything we build.

* **️RECRUITMENT PROCESS**

* 1️⃣ Interview with HR Manager
* 2️⃣ Interview with Head of Methodology & Strategy
* 3️⃣ Interview with Head of Sourcing Excellence
* 4️⃣ Optional: Interview with 1 or 2 future colleagues within the Methodology & Strategy Team

All our positions are open to people with health conditions or impairments.

We are convinced that it is up to you to define the way you work, to develop yourself and to progress. At Veepee we guarantee that you can just be yourself! For the service of diversity and inclusion, Veepee is committed to reviewing all applications received on an equal basis.

  

COMPANY

For more information about our ecosystem : https://careers.veepee.com/en/home-page-en/

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Paid Social Media Buyer (Meta Ads)
description:
#### **Introduction**

At **COCUNAT**, we're a digital-first beauty brand with ambitious international growth plans. Performance marketing is one of our key growth drivers, where **data, creativity and continuous experimentation** come together to deliver results.  
We're looking for a **Paid Social Media Buyer** who goes beyond managing campaigns. Working closely with our **Head of Acquisition**, you'll help drive profitable new customer growth across Europe, the US and LATAM, identifying opportunities, optimising performance and scaling what works.  
If you love turning data into growth and challenging the way things are done, we'd love to meet you!

#### **Your responsibilities**

You'll take ownership of day-to-day Paid Social performance, combining hands-on execution, analytical thinking and a strong focus on business results.  
**Paid Social Performance & Growth**

  

* Plan, launch and optimise **Meta Ads campaigns** to drive profitable customer acquisition across international markets.
* Manage and scale advertising budgets efficiently, controlling **CAC, maximising ROAS and driving new customer revenue**.
* Execute full-funnel acquisition strategies, testing different audiences, products and campaign approaches.
* Collaborate with the Head of Acquisition on budget planning, forecasting and performance priorities.

**Creative Performance & Experimentation**  

* Drive continuous **A/B testing** of creatives, messaging, audiences and campaign strategies to improve results.
* Analyse creative performance, identify winning concepts and translate insights into actionable recommendations for the Creative Strategy and Design teams.
* Monitor competitors, market trends and emerging advertising opportunities to identify new growth opportunities.

**Analytics, AI & Collaboration**  

* Monitor key acquisition KPIs, develop performance reports and turn data into clear optimisation actions.
* Leverage **AI, automation and Meta's evolving advertising tools** to improve efficiency, analysis and campaign performance.
* Work closely with **Creative, CRO, IT, Influencer Marketing and Social Media** teams to strengthen acquisition results.

#### **Your profile**

* **5+ years of hands-on experience in Paid Social** within eCommerce, with strong expertise in **Meta Ads Manager**.
* Proven experience scaling acquisition campaigns and managing budgets with a focus on **CAC, ROAS and profitability**.
* Experience in international eCommerce environments, preferably in **beauty or fashion**.
* Experience working directly with end-client brands is essential.
* Strong analytical skills, including performance reporting, budgeting and forecasting.
* Creative and experimental mindset, with the ability to turn data into actionable insights.
* Curious about **AI, automation and digital marketing innovation**, with a proactive, results-driven approach and strong collaboration skills.
* **Fluent in Spanish and English.**

#### **Why us?**

Benefits

* **Flexibility that makes a difference.** At COCUNAT, we believe in flexibility and work-life balance. You’ll have flexible start times and the possibility to work from home one day a week.
* **Your health matters.** Excellent private health insurance.
* **COCUNAT lover?** Enjoy exclusive discounts on COCUNAT products.
* **It’s the little things.** Coffee and chocolate are always available at the office.
* **Truly Pet-Friendly.** A casual, pet-friendly office where you can bring your furry friend every day.
* **An international team in Barcelona.** Work in an international environment from our office in Sant Gervasi, Barcelona.

Values ❤️  

* **People First:** We believe that putting people first helps us work better and achieve stronger results.
* **Diversity:** We foster an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome, valued and free to be themselves.
* **Dynamism:** We’re a startup in constant motion, with a fast-paced and agile environment where there’s always a new challenge ahead.
* **Continuous Innovation:** We love challenging the status quo, testing new ideas and constantly looking for better ways to do things. Curiosity, creativity and the drive to keep evolving are part of our everyday life.

title: Head of Client Services
description:

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!  
  
Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let's discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever's mission.

As Head of Client Services, you'll lead our global partner-facing teams, making sure every partner on the platform gets the right level of support to grow with us.

Our relationship management teams are organised into tier-based pods, providing varied levels of service to our partners. You'll manage these teams and own the post-sales activities and processes, including retention, growth, operational support, and the quality of service they receive every day.

You'll report to the Head of Partner Management and work closely with the Partner Management and Operational Support teams to align processes, tooling and ways of working across the group, while protecting what makes the partner experience special.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead, coach, and line-manage our partner-facing teams. Ensure the team is a high-performing, partner-obsessed Client Services function.
* Own partner retention and growth across the managed book, with clear targets for ticket sales, churn and partner health.
* Design and run our tiered service model – decide what level of service, support, and coverage each partner tier will receive.
* Ensure partner-facing and operational teams work as one, with clear ownership of each partner relationship, smooth handoffs, and collaboration across support teams.
* Use data to guide decisions – build reports and forecasts on partner performance, partner health, service levels and team KPIs, and present insights to internal leadership.
* Handle senior partner escalations and key negotiations, and act as executive sponsor for our largest partners.
* Work cross-functionally with Sales and Business Development, Product, Finance, Event Operations, Customer Support and Marketing to resolve partner issues and feed partner insight into our roadmap.
* Partner with internal teams to align processes, tooling (including Zendesk) and operating model across the group.
* Own team structure, capacity, and headcount planning within budget, and build clear career paths for your teams.
* Champion our story with partners and across the industry.

**Who You Are**

* 10+ years of experience in a partner-facing role.
* Extensive experience leading post-sales and partner-facing teams, e.g. Account Management, Customer Success and Partner Success.
* Demonstrated track record of managing managers within complex, globally distributed teams.
* A leader of leaders who builds trust and helps people grow.
* Data-driven, commercially minded, analytical and results-focused.
* A track record of driving partner retention and revenue growth across a large, tiered client portfolio.
* Confident presenting to senior stakeholders and negotiating with partners.
* Experience building service models, SLAs and KPIs, and running teams with data and CRM/helpdesk tools (e.g. Salesforce, Zendesk).
* A stellar communicator with a professional attitude.
* Happy to travel between our global offices.

**Bonus**

* Experience operating within complex B2B environments, digital platforms, or multi-sided marketplaces.
* Experience in the ticketing industry.
* Fluency in one of the following languages: French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish.

**Why you'll love it here**

* Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.
* Stock options.
* Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader.
* 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences.
* Gympass membership.
* Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth.
* Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!

description:

**Location:** Valencia or Madrid, Spain (hybrid model)

**Reporting to:** Head of Events

**What You’ll Be Doing...**

* Produce every event in the calendar end to end: brief, timeline, suppliers, build, on-site delivery and teardown, across Spain, the US, Italy and the Netherlands.
* Coordinate the production of Fun Business Days, the industry congress we run in Valencia: 3,000 attendees, 4 stages, 40 stands and 50 speakers, with a production agency by your side.
* Run several productions in parallel, in different cities, and hold every one of them to the same standard.
* Negotiate and manage suppliers, venues, agencies and freelancers, and hold them to the brief.
* Keep every event on date and on budget, and flag variance before it happens.
* Own the detail that decides whether an attendee has a good time: signage, flow, timings, hospitality and contingency. From a 3,000-person congress to a dinner for 8.
* Measure every event: log every contact and every meeting in HubSpot, and report cost per attendee and cost per qualified meeting.
* Brief Design and Audiovisual early, book the team’s travel and accommodation ahead of time, and keep the supplier map, the production playbook and the project board up to date.
* After every event, propose what to repeat, what to change and what to drop, with the numbers in front of you.
* Use AI tools to speed up the repeatable parts of every production (supplier comparisons, run of show, attendee communications, post-event reports), with sound judgment on what needs human review.

**What we need from you...**

* 5+ years producing events, including at least 2 on multi-supplier productions.
* Experience on the production side of industry conferences, live events or festivals.
* You have run several productions at once, at least one outside your home city.
* Budget, agency and production supplier management.
* On site through build and show, including long days and the occasional weekend.
* Professional Spanish and C1 English.
* Hands-on use of a project management tool and a CRM at contact and meeting level (HubSpot or similar).
* Organisation, calm when something breaks during build, and direct communication with suppliers and internal teams.
* You answer for the date and for the budget, and you raise what is going to go wrong before it does.
* Degree in Events Management, Marketing, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**We Value...**

* B2B marketing experience and an understanding of how an event turns into pipeline.
* Production and floorplan tools.
* A supplier network in Valencia, Madrid or Miami.
* Italian.
* Having produced outside Spain.
* Using AI tools to automate production tasks.

**What We Offer...**

* Salary based on candidate's skills and experience.
* Annual bonuses for those who significantly contribute to Fourvenues' success.
* A vision and team that will inspire you to excel and reach the next level in your career development.
* Continuous training we want you to stay at the forefront of technology and grow your skills through regular internal training.
* MacBook laptop and high-resolution monitors to maximize your potential.
* Hybrid work model (3+2): three days in the office and two from home if that’s where you feel most productive although we're confident that the environment and the team will make you enjoy being at the office more than you’d expect.
* Flexible working hours. Organize your workday between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM, as long as you meet scheduled commitments.
* Private health insurance to promote your peace of mind and well-being.
* Optional flexible benefits plan, such as dining, childcare, transportation, and discounts with major brands.
* Extra vacation days for special occasions like birthdays, holidays, or unique events.

**About Fourvenues**

At Fourvenues, we are revolutionising a $100+ billion global market, powering nightclubs, festivals, beach clubs and promoters around the world. This growth has led to our recognition as the 3rd fastest-growing company in Spain in 2026, reflecting the strength of our model and the impact we are generating in the industry.

Our vision is clear: to become the operating system of the industry, with a strong financial component and a vertical SaaS (vSaaS) model that empowers our clients to achieve their goals. Their success is ours.

In just three years, we’ve multiplied our revenue by 20x, and we’re only getting started. Our goal is to grow by at least 100% annually, fostering an environment where commitment, high standards, and constant curiosity are non-negotiable. Here, excellence isn’t optional; it’s the standard.

In the last two years, Fourvenues has secured €11 million in funding from top-tier U.S. investors, including Base10 Partners (Notion, Figma, Instacart) and FJ Labs (Stripe, Airbnb, Rappi). This investment fuels our ambitious growth strategy and strengthens our commitment to expanding in the U.S. with a cutting-edge, high-performance product.

At Fourvenues, we scale aggressively while maintaining disciplined unit economics and a long-term vision. We are not just building fast, we are building sustainably, ensuring that every step forward is backed by solid fundamentals. Our goal is to become the leading platform in the nightlife industry while creating a company that lasts.

We have the privilege of collaborating with renowned brands such as Pacha, BRESH, Cova Santa, BCM, Magic Room HK, Blackworks, Sonorama Medellin, Opium, and Gossip Doha. And we’re continuously signing new partnerships every month, presenting challenges that push us to deliver outstanding service.

title: Creative (Hybrid) - Design Studios
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

You are a curious, versatile creative who is developing genuine range across disciplines and creative practices. You take craft seriously and bring energy and rigour to everything you touch. As a Creative (Hybrid) at BCG Design Studios, you sit at the intersection of multiple creative practices, working with directors, designers, consultants, and clients to shape work that is both beautiful and effective. Versatility is your superpower.

You are building hands-on creative ability across more than one discipline. You are developing an understanding of how different creative practices connect — and how to flex between them depending on what a project needs. You are growing more comfortable across multiple creative formats and contexts. You are driven by creative curiosity, thrive on collaboration, and are genuinely interested in where culture, business, and design are heading next.

You are developing your cross-disciplinary instincts. You are curious about how different creative practices connect and influence each other, and you are beginning to see how your work fits into a larger creative whole. You know that frameworks are the starting point. The willingness to learn what a project actually needs — and the craft to deliver your part of it with care — is what makes you valuable here.

You work alongside clients and BCG case teams, supported by senior creatives. You participate in creative conversations, contribute to translating briefs into compelling work, and are developing a point of view that spans more than one creative practice. You execute across projects end-to-end, bringing your skills to the right moments under the direction of more experienced team members. Your growing breadth is your differentiator. The quality of your craft is your responsibility.

Day to day, you will:

* Contribute to creative projects from first brief to final delivery, executing with care and quality across the disciplines and touchpoints you are responsible for.
* Work with briefs and strategic direction to produce clear, compelling creative across multiple formats — developing your instinct for which approach fits a given moment.
* Participate in client-facing creative work. Attend workshops, support the presentation of ideas, absorb feedback with curiosity, and apply it to your work quickly and thoughtfully.
* Contribute across creative practices with growing confidence, bringing genuine craft wherever the work demands it — and being willing to stretch beyond your primary comfort zone.
* Work with AI as a skilled collaborator. Use it to explore ideas, accelerate production, and pressure-test decisions. Keep human creativity and craft at the centre of everything that goes out the door.
* Contribute to a high creative standard. Share your perspective when it adds value, engage constructively in feedback, and actively learn from the senior creatives and different disciplines around you.
* Stay ahead of where design, culture, and communication are going. Bring fresh perspective into the studio and into client conversations — not just within your own practice, but across the creative landscape.
* Stay curious about the full shape of a project. Begin to connect the dots between what different practitioners are solving and what the work ultimately needs to achieve.

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* Reading a brief carefully and asking the right questions when something is unclear.
* Moving between creative disciplines with growing confidence. You are building a clear sense of what good looks like across different formats and contexts.
* Participating in the presentation of creative work, speaking clearly about the decisions behind it and taking feedback constructively.
* Supporting a project across disciplines with reliability and care. You do your piece well and stay attuned to how it fits into the wider whole.
* Using AI to speed up the right parts of a creative process without letting it flatten your thinking.
* Moving between strategic altitude and hands-on craft without losing your footing. Equally effective in a brief-setting conversation and a design review.
* Contributing your point of view with confidence, even early in your career. Good ideas can come from anywhere.
* Staying calm and focused when briefs are open or timelines are tight. You figure out what you can do and do it well.

What You'll Bring

* A degree in design, creative arts, communication, or a related field. Equivalent experience that demonstrates the same depth of creative thinking and craft is equally welcome.
* 2 to 4 years working in a creative agency, brand consultancy, in-house studio, or professional services environment, with a portfolio that demonstrates craft, curiosity, and early signs of range across creative disciplines.
* Developing ability across more than one creative practice, and an eagerness to grow that range further over time.
* Some exposure to client or stakeholder-facing work, and a willingness to develop that confidence further in a supported environment.
* A portfolio that demonstrates strong craft and early creative range — showing that you care about quality and are curious enough to work across more than one format or discipline.
* Practical fluency with relevant creative tools across multiple disciplines, and comfort picking up new tools as the work demands.
* An open and curious approach to AI tools, and a growing sense of where they help and where human judgment and craft matter more.
* Excellent English language skills; additional languages are an advantage and may be particularly valued in certain locations.

Who You'll Work With

As part of Design Studios, you will collaborate with global designers and colleagues across BCG to bring design expertise and capabilities to clients as well as internal teams. GDS comprises a diverse group of talented design professionals across video, content, digital design, and more—all working collaboratively to deliver the most advanced design solutions.

Additional info

We are Design Studios, an in-house creative agency comprised of cutting-edge professionals creating premium designs. We are a global, multidisciplinary team of design strategists, creative leaders, and digital experts. We craft powerful design stories for BCG to deliver inspiring solutions to our clients’ challenges. As part of BCG, Design Studios partners with consultants and clients to shape our brand by elevating our work through the power of design. We offer guidance and orientation through a strategic and audience-centric approach, and apply design, technology, and media solutions to take BCG’s achievements to the next level.

As bold design leaders, we are fresh, punchy, and playful, while committed to delivering premium business excellence. We recognize how to transform complex ideas into compelling visual experiences, and how to activate new commercial opportunities at the intersection of business and design. We value innovation, co-creation, inspiration, and the business impact that design achieves. We believe in the art of the possible and in applying creative solutions to business challenges. We believe we can advance the world by conquering its complexity through a universal human language—design.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Program Coordinator, IE Impact
description:
Overview:

Are you interested in joining a dynamic and international team of professionals to transform education? IE University's **Education & Student Experience** is looking for a **Program Coordinator** to join its team!

**IE IMPACT** is IE University’s undergraduate core studies learning journey, totaling 21 ECTS, and required of all IEU students. IE University’s four core courses consist of one in the **Humanities**, one in **Technology,** the **Entrepreneurial Mindset & Practice** course and the **IE Challenge** course**.** The IE Impact Learning Journey aims to equip students with the knowledge, mindsets and skills needed to be innovative problem-solvers who lead positive change. The entire learning journey centers the value of diversity and a commitment to sustainability (within the broad understanding of the SDGs). The IE Impact program is IE University’s largest academic feat thanks to its scale, transversal composition and mission. The IE Impact team is responsible for its successful operational execution.

The **Program Coordinato**r is a great opportunity for current IEU staff who are assistants and seek a promotion (with the support of their current supervisors). It is also a great opportunity for young professionals who seek to form part of an international team and develop themselves further in an academic institution. It is also a great opportunity for others who perhaps have been out of the workforce for a period and are eager to contribute to our team their maturity and eagerness to work outside of the home.

The **program coordinator** role is highly administrative and requires a lot of time seated at a computer responding to student and faculty email inquiries and occasional in-person drop-ins, which makes up approximately 85-90% of the work.

The **program coordinator** role is also asked to balance administrative tasks with creative work, contributing to “beyond-the-classroom" activities for students that serve to reinforce IE Impact learning objectives, as well as contributing to the organization of training activities for faculty.

The **program coordinator** role engages with many different and transversal stakeholders across the entire university (staff, students, faculty, guests) and such interactions require professionalism, intercultural skills, maturity and empathy.

The **Program Coordinator** role reports ultimately to the IE Impact Executive Director. For daily operations, the program coordinator works under the supervision and with the support of the IE Impact Sr. Associate Director. The Program Coordinator also works in close coordination with and to support the IE Impact Academic Directors (each IE Impact course is led by at least one Academic Director and/or Academic Coordinators).

To foster positive change.

* Cultivate the humanistic approach.
* Empower your entrepreneurial spirit
* Cherish the diversity of people, mind, and experience
* Drive innovation with a proactive mindset
