title: Senior Business Innovation Consultant
description:
Reports to: Lead Business Innovation Strategist / Design Strategy Director/VP

**About Mormedi**

We are a global boutique, strategic design and innovation consultancy. We help our clients create products, services, and experiences that delight customers and that fuel growth. By blending strategy, creativity, technology and business insight to design and deliver the most meaningful solutions.

**Our Mission: To help businesses navigate change confidently.**

We accomplish our mission by:

* Developing practical, human-centred solutions that drive growth, sustainability, and transformative impact;
* Making strategy and visions of the future tangible as a way to gain and maintain momentum;
* Establishing partnerships across industries for non-traditional approaches and better connected ecosystems;
* Creating strategies that help our clients lead the future with purpose.

**Our Values**

* Long-term thinking: We are passionate about finding the most profound, lasting opportunity in each innovation challenge, looking and testing from multiple angles.
* Meaningful experiences: We strive for positive impact in people's everyday lives by inviting diverse human perspectives and creating relevant and meaningful experiences.
* Systemic elegance: We believe that design can make a real difference when approached with a holistic, inclusive and sustainable mindset.
* Maker mentality: We can't help but make the abstract practical through visualization, models and prototypes to drive alignment and speed up progress.

**About the role**

Role overview

As a Senior in our Business Innovation practice, you will work at the intersection of human-centred design, business planning, financial modelling, and venture validation. You will autonomously lead project workstreams—from uncovering customer insights and framing new venture hypotheses to building robust business cases, operating models, and market launch roadmaps—guiding junior team members and collaborating directly with clients to deliver high-impact strategic deliverables on time and on budget.

This role is for you if

You want to take full ownership of business innovation streams that reshape how clients compete, from early exploration to commercially viable go-to-market solutions. You thrive in collaborative studio environments, enjoy building financial models from scratch, facilitating executive co-creation workshops, mentoring emerging consultants, and defending business viability directly with C-suite stakeholders.

What you will own

* Autonomous execution and content leadership over complete strategic workstreams, several smaller projects, or major work packages within large client programs, taking ownership of content excellence, business case viability, and project profitability.
* High-level strategic storytelling, translating abstract user insights, market dynamics, and unit economics into compelling presentation decks and executive arguments.
* Definition of business models, operating models, and financial feasibility frameworks in multidisciplinary projects led by Strategic Design, Industrial Design, and UX/UI.
* Guiding, supporting, and mentoring Staff, Junior strategists, and Interns on business design methodologies, financial modelling, workshop preparation, and deliverable quality.
* Facilitation of co-creation workshops, client working sessions, and executive presentations.
* Support in commercial opportunities: helping define project scope, estimating effort, and drafting strategic POV materials for pitch proposals.
* Participation in creating thought leadership content (articles, case studies, whitepapers) and industry presentations to strengthen market positioning.
* Contribution to growing the Business Innovation practice, evolving proprietary business design toolkits, and scaling client accounts.
* Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration & Studio Community: Collaborate closely with Strategic Design, Industrial Design, and UX/UI teams to ensure commercial viability and business models inform physical and digital design execution, actively fostering a cohesive Mormedi studio culture and cross-discipline teamwork.
* Quality & Environmental Leadership (ISO 9001 & ISO 14001): Responsible for upholding Quality and Environmental Management System standards within assigned streams, driving continuous process efficiency, and embedding sustainable business practices and circular economy principles into deliverables.

**How success is measured**

**Project Delivery (~80%):** Delivery quality, project timeline/budget compliance, client satisfaction (CSAT 4-5), financial rigor, and mentoring impact.

**Commercial & Marketing Support (~20%):** Support in proposal preparation, organic account opportunity identification, content creation, and methodology enhancements.

**What you bring**

**Senior Strategic & Business Expertise –** Minimum 6 years of professional experience in Business Innovation, Strategy Consulting, Venture Building, or Strategic Design, with a strong portfolio showcasing complex innovation and business model engagements delivered for diverse industries.

**Financial Modeling & Business Craft –** Demonstrated ability to build, manage, and interpret complex financial models from scratch to support unit economics, revenue forecasting, scenario analysis, and strategic decision-making.

**Methodology Mastery –** Deep knowledge of human-centered innovation, business model canvas, operating model design, customer journey mapping, and qualitative research methods.

**Executive Storytelling & Facilitation –** Exceptional ability to structure complex arguments into clear, visually compelling presentations (PowerPoint/Miro) and facilitate board-level working sessions.

**Project Stream Leadership –** Proven ability to organize project streams, prioritize tasks across multiple projects, and keep project profitability and margin targets in mind.

**AI Literacy & Responsible AI –** Fluency in applying Generative AI tools (LLMs, research synthesis engines, automation platforms) to business modeling, market research, and scenario planning while ensuring compliance with the EU AI Act, client IP protection, and data privacy.

**Software & Tools**

**Executive & Financial Suite:** Microsoft Office (Advanced Excel for financial modeling, P&L projections, and planning; PowerPoint for executive storytelling; Word).

**Collaboration & Workshop Platforms:** High proficiency in collaboration platforms such as Miro.

**Generative AI Platforms:** LLMs and agentic workflow tools applied to market scanning, trend analysis, and research synthesis under strict confidentiality rules.

**Visual Suite (Nice to have):** Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop overview).

**Languages:** High professional proficiency in English and Spanish; a third language is appreciated.

**Qualifications**

An appropriate Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Innovation Management, or a related field, with a proven interest in design thinking.

Willingness to travel for client meetings, field research, and workshops.

Valid work permit for Spain/Europe.

A valid driving license (minimum 2 years of seniority) is appreciated.

##### **About VSI**

VSI is a leading localisation company providing dubbing, subtitling, voice-over, and digital media services to the entertainment and corporate industries. Headquartered in London’s West End, with offices worldwide, VSI partners with some of the world’s leading global brands and content producers.

##### **About the role**

As Dubbing Production Supervisor, you will lead the dubbing project management team at our Spanish facility. You will make sure our international clients' projects are delivered efficiently and on time. You will work with colleagues across VSI's global network to bring high-quality Castilian and Catalan dubbed content to audiences.

This role suits someone who enjoys dubbing, likes coordinating several projects at once and is happy working with creative teams. You will find practical solutions in a dynamic environment. You will work closely with clients, suppliers, project managers, casting and production coordinators, the technical team and the Head of Account Management.

##### **What will you do**

* Oversee dubbing projects from the initial brief through planning, scheduling, budgeting, delivery, invoicing and post-project review.
* Deliver projects on time, within budget and to VSI's quality standards.
* Select and coordinate the internal teams for each project, including project managers, casting and production coordinators and technical colleagues.
* Work with clients throughout production on the creative brief, approach and approvals.
* Review internal workflows and client-specific requirements, and update client and department guidelines to reflect best practice.
* Communicate clearly and proactively with clients, suppliers and colleagues, arrange production meetings, and give practical advice on complex projects and ad hoc issues, escalating where appropriate.
* Monitor each project's progress weekly to keep it on budget and in line with profitability targets, spotting risks and opportunities to improve delivery, account performance and processes.
* Prepare accurate project updates and reports for the Head of Account Management.
* Support the Head of Account Management with quotes by providing operational input, timelines and cost information.
* Collect all required documentation from talent and staff, such as non-disclosure agreements, agreements of rights and freelancer agreements, and make sure everyone involved follows Health and Safety and Security guidelines.
* Keep project data complete, timely and accurate in our internal systems, including processing purchase orders for supplier and client invoices on time.
* Manage project administration and other operational tasks as needed.
* Look after the security and maintenance of the building, escalate issues to the relevant teams and the Head of Account Management, and make sure the studio is securely locked each day.
* Take on other reasonable tasks that support

##### **What we are looking for**

* Placeholder Bullet Point
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Previous project management experience in localisation, media or a similar fast-paced production environment.
* A good understanding of dubbing workflows.
* A collaborative approach and the ability to coordinate multimedia requirements across production teams while keeping work consistent.
* Excellent organisation and the ability to prioritise when deadlines overlap.
* A proactive, solutions-focused mindset with sound problem-solving skills.
* Flexibility when requirements or priorities change at short notice.
* Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to client service.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and Power BI reporting, with good general technology skills and the ability to support the testing and adoption of new systems.
* Availability and willingness to travel regularly between our Barcelona and Madrid facilities.

##### **It would be helpful if you have**

* Experience with OOONA or a similar project management platform.

##### **Why join VSI**

At VSI, you will join a passionate, highly driven team helping entertainment travel the world. You will have the opportunity to work on high-profile global content, collaborate with talented colleagues and make a visible contribution in a creative, international and fast-moving environment.

We support people to grow their careers alongside experienced colleagues and some of the best talent in the localisation industry.

title: Director of Human Resources — Arquetipo Studio
description:
### **Build what Europe must own**

Building the companies behind Europe’s strategic sovereignty.

Our mission is to originate, operate and capitalise the European companies and technologies our sovereignty depends on.

We are a venture builder focused on dual-use deep tech. Every company we launch is born inside the studio, with its own team, capital and method, and goes to market ready to compete.

We work across three missions:

* **Spectrum Dominance.** Capabilities to operate in, protect and manage data across contested environments.
* **Sovereign Compute.** Secure, certifiable European silicon, ready for post-quantum cryptography.
* **Trusted Autonomy.** High-integrity mission autonomy for uncrewed systems.

Build with us.

### **The role**

We are looking for Arquetipo’s first Head of Human Resources. You won’t inherit a department: you’ll design from scratch how a venture builder attracts, organises, develops and retains Europe’s scarcest talent.

You will report directly to the COO. Your scope won’t be a single company but a system: the studio and each of the ventures born from it, each at its own stage of maturity.

This role isn’t for everyone. If you’re looking for a position with established processes, a large team and a low profile, this isn’t it. If you want your work to show in a continent’s technological capability, read on.

### **What you’ll do**

#### **Talent for critical missions**

* Design and execute the strategy for attracting technical and executive talent to the studio and its ventures.
* Run the recruitment policy, ensuring our talent is aligned with our goals and values.
* Build our own channels with universities, research centres and the wider tech ecosystem, and turn Arquetipo’s mission into an employer brand that attracts people who want to build, not just work.

#### **Organising a venture builder**

* Define the HR management model, tools and ways of working.
* Prepare each venture for independence: its own structure, policies and people team at the moment of spin-out.
* Coordinate employment management across a multi-entity, multi-site environment spanning Madrid, Málaga, Bilbao and our ventures’ locations.

#### **Culture and accountability**

* Translate our values into observable behaviours and real criteria for hiring, evaluation, promotion and exit.
* Design a performance system with clear objectives, identified owners, continuous feedback and consistent consequences.
* Establish a development programme for studio and venture leaders so they lead by example.

#### **Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with employment law and with the specific requirements of the sectors we operate in.
* Drive and oversee the company’s ethics and compliance programme as it relates to people.

#### **What we expect at 90 days**

* Hiring for critical positions under way.
* HR management procedures up and running.
* A standard hiring process, with explicit values assessment, operating across all open positions.
* A proposed compensation & benefits framework.

#### **What we expect at 12 months**

* Critical positions in the hiring plan filled on time.
* An accountability-based performance system in place across the studio and the ventures.
* An HR management model and people playbook that let us launch a new venture in weeks, not months.
* People metrics (turnover, time-to-hire, quality of hire, engagement) presented and defended quarterly before the leadership team.

### **What you need: technical skills**

#### **Essential**

* 5+ years of experience in Human Resources.
* Experience building an HR function from scratch or leading rapid growth in a technology, industrial or engineering company.
* Proven experience hiring scarce technical profiles: hardware, embedded software, critical systems or R&D.
* Strong command of Spanish employment law.
* Experience designing compensation & benefits policies.
* Analytical judgement: you make decisions based on data.
* Professional English (C1 or above).
* Availability to work on-site in Madrid and to travel.
* Eligibility to obtain a personal security clearance.

#### **Nice to have**

* Experience in defence, aerospace, semiconductors, space or other regulated sectors.
* Experience in venture builders, startup studios, groups with multiple portfolio companies or corporate innovation units.
* Postgraduate studies in People Management, Industrial Relations, Organisational Psychology or a related field.

### **What you need: values and ways of working**

Technical skills get you through the door. These decide whether you stay.

* **Accountability.** When something fails in your area, you don’t look for explanations elsewhere. And you build systems so the rest of the team can do the same.
* **You lead by example.** You never ask anyone to do what you wouldn’t do yourself. If you demand transparency or rigour, you’re the first to show it.
* **The mission guides your decisions.** You understand why technological sovereignty matters and turn it into concrete people decisions, even uncomfortable ones.
* **You’re part of the business, not a support function.** You understand the mission, the product, the cash plan and the technical challenges of each venture.
* **You combine closeness with high standards.** You care for people without lowering the bar. You have difficult conversations respectfully, on time and without beating around the bush.
* **Your decisions are guided by our values.** They are the criteria you act on.
* **You do first, then delegate.** At this stage you’ll write policies, run interviews and review contracts yourself. The team will come when the system and growth justify it.
* **Confidentiality.** You’ll handle sensitive information about programmes, partners and people. Discretion is part of the job, not an extra.

### **What we offer**

* The opportunity to design, from the ground up, the organisation of a venture builder that is building strategic capabilities for Europe.
* A seat on the leadership team, with direct influence over which companies we launch and with whom.
* Competitive compensation.
* Working alongside top-tier engineers, researchers and entrepreneurs in semiconductors, autonomy and artificial intelligence.

### **Our process**

* **Interview with the hiring manager** on mission, purpose and leadership style.
* **Interviews with studio and venture leaders**, including people who will work with you every day.
* **References and offer.** We’ll ask for references from people who have seen you lead, not only from those who have supervised you.

We’re not looking for the perfect CV. We’re looking for the person who best understands why we do what we do and who is willing to answer for how we do it.

* Help us build a stronger creative culture and raise the ambition of the work across the agency.

* 4-6 years of experience in a creative, PR, social or integrated agency. Your exact background matters less than the quality of your thinking, writing and ideas.
* Excellent spoken and written Spanish and strong level of English.
* A real command of words combined with visual sensitivity and the ability to think beyond copy.

description:
**Job Purpose:**

The core of this role will be to manage communications for a global manufacturing site including site communication plans, activities, channels and messages that align with GSK and GSC’s (Global Supply Chain) business priorities. You will work closely with the global Communications and Government Affairs team (CGA) aligned to GSK’s Global Supply Chain as well as with the site head and site leadership team.

The successful candidate will be skilled at developing communications which are insight-driven, engaging and delivered in a timely, digestible way for maximum impact, that are inclusive and accessible to all employees and aligned to GSK brand and voice. You will have experience with internal communications and channel management. You will be comfortable coaching leaders on their communications skills and supporting external-, change- and issues communication.

In this role you will:

* Develop and execute the annual site communications plan to help drive employee engagement and align staff around site-, GSC- and GSK strategy and priorities.
* Manage the site’s communication channels in the day-2-day. This includes organising all-site town halls, managing newsletters and digital channels and maintaining the site’s intranet pages up to date.
* Support broader CGA priorities as needed and ensure relevant company news is shared and adapted for local use at the site. Highlight the site's contribution to company priorities by taking part in global engagement campaigns and sharing impactful stories about how the site makes a difference. Create high-impact content to support local site priorities and – operations.
* Use relevant metrics to measure impact and generate insights to drive improvements. This includes conducting feedback surveys, obtaining qualitative feedback through focus groups, measuring view- and engagement rates of digital channels and monitoring progress regularly.
* Embrace technologies and AI tools to increase creativity and impact of communication activities.
* Co-deliver communications trainings in partnership with the global CGA team and advise site head and -leaders on their communication skills.
* Develop change communication plans in collaboration with the global CGA team and execute them to support major site transformations, accelerate adoption to organisational changes and new ways of working.
* Build the site’s external reputation by pro-actively suggesting LinkedIn stories for site leaders as well as local community engagement activities. Collaborate with the LOC on media opportunities and connection with government officials. Develop site-specific communication material such as a narrative and related

assets like video, photography and fact sheets that can be used both for external and internal engagement purposes.

* Help protect the site's local reputation through effective crisis communications.
* Support the site's culture activation and employee engagement plans in collaboration with relevant site leaders, - functions and ERGs.

**Core Capabilities:**

* Strategic internal communication skills: able to design and deliver communication plans that effectively support business priorities and help drive employee engagement.
* Excellent writing and storytelling skills: able to create engaging, high-impact content.
* Effective channel management: capable of managing different types of communication channels (online/offline, virtual/in-person) autonomously.
* Stakeholder management and influencing skills: Well-connected into the broader communications network. Recognised as a reference for advice on effective communications by site leadership, CGA peers and LOC. Able to actively listen and translate global messages so that they resonate locally.
* Effective use of data and insights: familiar with how to measure impact of communication channels and activities to continuously improve.
* Able to apply brand standards: effectively translate the company’s tone of voice to fit site communications. Develop communication materials that comply with the company’s visual identity.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in communications or equivalent
* Minimum 3 years of experience working in a communications role
* Strong project management skills with ability to work under pressure and effectively prioritize work
* Excellent cultural awareness
* Ability to deal with sensitive issues confidentially
* Ability to get things done

**Preferred Qualifications**:

  

The following characteristics are a plus:

* Experience working in a manufacturing/industrial environment
* As part of a global company, ability to speak and write in English professionally
* Experience with external communication, change communication and crisis communications
* Experience with training and coaching leaders on their communication skills

**Skills**

Content Development, Corporate Copywriting, Data Analytics, Digital Fluency, Reputation Management, Risk Management, Stakeholder Management, Storytelling, Strategic Planning

title: Manager Video Creative Development
description:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.

**Job Description**
===================

Location:

Madrid, ES

**Visión general**

  

Los equipos de vídeo digital global de Condé Nast crean contenido de vídeo de primera calidad que generan más de 1.000 millones de visualizaciones al mes a nivel global, con más de 4.000 episodios al año entre unscripted, documentales, comerciales y relacionados con eventos.

  

El objetivo de este rol Manager Video Creative Development, que reporta al Head of Video Programming & Development (Spain) y estará ubicado en nuestras oficinas de Madrid, es **desarrollar, desde el punto de vista creativo, la presencia audiovisual de las marcas de Condé Nast en español** **VOGUE, GQ, Architectural Digest y Condé Nast Traveler** , mediante contenido de vídeo original, en serie o one shots, para plataformas digitales globales (O&O, Youtube, Tiktok, Facebook, Instagram…) con foco en máxima calidad, escalable y replicable en plataformas y mercados: series icónicas que trascienden plataformas y mercados, que multiplican el impacto de momentos culturales locales y globales, conectan a las marcas de Condé Nast con las audiencias más interesantes y crean oportunidades de integración publicitaria para las marcas más importantes del mercado.

  

**Responsabilidades**

  

* Desarrollar nuevas IP de vídeo y podcast según los objetivos y prioridades editoriales y comerciales de las marcas de Condé Nast, que sean replicables y adaptables en distintos mercados y plataformas.
* Generar tanto ideas sobre la base de series preexistentes como nuevos pilotos, en serie o one shots, con el máximo nivel de calidad en narrativa y estilo visual. Trabajar con los equipos de optimización y redes sociales para maximizar el rendimiento de cada idea en todas las plataformas.
* Dirigir in situ episodios y one-shots, definiendo el lenguaje visual de las marcas y trabajando con el equipo de producción para liderar a los equipos técnicos y artísticos.
* Dirigir y participar en sesiones de brainstorming con equipos locales e internacionales. Crear storyboards, moodboards, referencias visuales, guiones y tratamientos. Definir claramente los playbooks de las series que desarrolle para que otros equipos puedan ejecutarlas.
* Realizar la supervisión creativa y editorial de episodios producidos sin su intervención directa en la producción y el rodaje.
* Colaborar con los equipos creativos comerciales en el desarrollo y ejecución de ideas que incluyan integraciones publicitarias; con los equipos de producción locales y globales en el establecimiento de modos de trabajo que optimicen los recursos de las marcas; y con los equipos editoriales en el desarrollo de ideas alineadas con los objetivos de cada marca.
* Colaborar con los equipos editoriales, de social media y programación en la definición de la presencia en vídeo de cada revista, proponiendo ideas, personajes, y oportunidades.
Mostrar, en general, una cultura de profesionalidad, atención al detalle, adaptabilidad y orientación al resultado, y participar en la expansión de la cultura y conocimiento audiovisual entre todos los equipos de la compañía.  

  

**Requisitos**

  

* Más de 4 años de experiencia en el espacio audiovisual en rol creativo y de realización.

title: KTT 2026-03 Highly Skilled Specialist Technician for the Bioassay Laboratory
description:
**Highly Skilled Specialist Technician for the Bioassay Laboratory (Ref: KTT 2026-03)**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Institute of Chemical Research of Catalonia (ICIQ) is seeking a Highly Skilled Specialist Technician for the Bioassay Laboratory to conduct *in vitro* ADME-Tox assays and coordinate biological evaluation of compounds within the institute. The successful candidate will contribute to the expansion of ICIQ’s activities in chemical biology, molecular medicine, and drug discovery, supporting the validation of biologically active compounds and fostering collaborations with internal and external research partners. This position will play a key role in establishing and managing biological assay platforms, providing scientific guidance to research groups, and strengthening the institute’s translational research activities at the interface between chemistry and biology.

The position is funded by the ‘Severo Ochoa’ Centres of Excellence programme, reference CEX2024-001469-S, funded by MICIU/AEI/10.13039/501100011033.

ICIQ is looking for a Highly Skilled Specialist Technician for the Bioassay Laboratory to lead the development and implementation of a Bioassay Laboratory in order to be able to perform *in vitro* ADME-Tox profiling of chemical entities within the institute, including: determination of activity against biological targets; screening of potential targets; metabolic stability; assess cytotoxicity, mutagenicity, permeability; etc. The position will support ICIQ’s strategic growth in chemical biology, molecular medicine and drug discovery by establishing, coordinating and overseeing biological evaluation activities for research projects across the institute. The Bioassay Laboratory will form part of the Knowledge and Technology Transfer and Industrial Projects Department, and the selected candidate will work closely with ICIQ research groups and external collaborators. The Highly Skilled Specialist Technician for the Bioassay Laboratory will design and manage biological assay workflows, contribute to the evaluation of biologically active compounds, set up a laboratory space, and define need of equipment and consumables required for the daily operations of the Laboratory, and provide scientific and technical expertise at the interface between chemistry and biology. The selected candidate should be skilled to be able to synthesise, isolate and characterise chemical compounds, when needed. The role will also play a key part in identifying new opportunities, establishing strategic collaborations, and supporting the translation of research outcomes towards biomedical and industrial applications. The position will contribute to the consolidation of biological evaluation capabilities at ICIQ and help strengthen the institute’s activities in emerging areas of chemical biology, molecular medicine and translational research.

**Responsibilities**

* Ensure that the requirements to set up a Bioassay Laboratory are fulfilled: purchase of equipment, consumables and reagents.
* Ensure the space dedicated to the Bioassay Laboratory is adequate and up to date of all safety and quality requirements
* Set up protocols to conduct ADME-Tox experiments, including: determination of activity against biological targets; screening of potential targets; metabolic stability; assess cytotoxicity, mutagenicity, permeability, etc.
* Conduct experimental work to provide ADME-Tox results
* Synthesis, characterisation and isolation of compounds to assess their ADME-Tox properties
* Explore public and private funding sources

**Requirements**

* Ph.D. in life sciences discipline: Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, or equivalent
* Experience in working in biological assays
* Experience in the preparation, isolation and characterisation of chemical compounds
* Good knowledge of English (written and spoken)

**Valued qualities**

* Good communication skills
* Strong commitment for scientific excellence
* Motivated, creative, and problem-solving individual capable of working independently as well as in a team
* Previous experience in working in medicinal chemistry programs
* Previous experience in working with animal models

**We offer**

* A full-time contract linked to the project CEX2024-001469-S
* Incorporation: February 2027
* An international and dynamic environment within a multidisciplinary team
* Annual salary split into 12 monthly payments.
* Remuneration aligned with the company’s salary policy, within the PTTAGE1 – PTTAGE5 band (32.960 – 41.200 EUR), based on the candidate’s qualifications and experience.
* Flexible 37.5 hours working week
* Free parking available at our facilities.
* Continuous training plan to support your professional development.
* Good connection to public transportation networks.
* Facilities with spacious areas, abundant natural light, and a functional, well‑designed environment aimed at enhancing people’s wellbeing.

**OTM-R principles in the selection processes**

ICIQ follows the principles of Open, Transparent and Merit-based Recruitment (OTM-R) and the Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers as established by the European Commission.

ICIQ follows in its selection process a gender equality opportunity policy and a non-discrimination policy on the basis of age, ethnic or social origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation, language and disability.

ICIQis committed to promoting a work-life balance for its employees and, as such, offers flexible working hours.

The Selection Committee for this process is composed of:

* **Fernando Bravo**; ICIQ’s KTT Manager
* **Elisabet Vilella**, Subdirector IRB CatSud (external member)
* **Marga Nadal**; Director of IDIBGI (external member)

A Human Resources Unit representative will participate in the interviews to ensure procedural correctness and compliance with OTM R principles, without forming part of the Selection Committee.

The evaluation committee will perform the assessment ensuring the absence of conflict of interest with any of the candidates, and will sign a Declaration of Absence of Conflict of Interest (DACI) to that end. In case a conflict of interest arises, the evaluator will be substituted by a different evaluator with similar expertise.

The interview will last approximately 30 minutes and will be conducted in English. During the first 10-15 minutes, you will be asked to provide a short presentation about your background.

**Selection Process**

ICIQ’s selection process usually entails the following phases:

* **Pre-selection:** The pre-selection process will be based on qualifications and expertise as reflected on the candidates’ CVs. This phase is merit-based.
* **Interview:** Preselected candidates will be interviewed by the Hiring Manager of the position and the appointed Selection Committee.
* **Offer Letter:** Once the successful candidate is selected, the People Unit will extend a Job Offer, specifying the start day, salary and overall job conditions.

title: R&D Director – Ecosystem & Commerce
description:
**Location:** Spain (preferred), MEA (Lebanon subject to local employment requirements)

If you apply, please include your CV.

  

We are looking for an **R&D Director – Ecosystem & Commerce** to join the Cargo Business Unit leadership team.

Together with the Director of Product Management – Ecosystem & Commerce, this role builds, runs and scales the businesses that surround Cargospot, connect it and monetise it. Product defines what we build and why; this role owns how it is built, run and scaled.
  
  
It is also CHAMP’s lead role for AI-native engineering: making MCP and agentic access a core capability of our products, and making AI a standard part of how every CHAMP team designs, builds, tests and ships software.

**Mission**

Build and lead the Ecosystem & Commerce R&D organisation and own the technology end to end, from architecture and cloud to delivery and operations, for four lines of business:

* **Joint Business & Interline Middleware —** the leading and largest interline and joint-business system for air cargo;
* **Cargospot Pay —** a new line of business with the ambition to become the number one payment provider in air cargo;
* **MCP & Agentic Layer —** the AI-native access layer that lets customers, partners and their AI agents use Cargospot products;
* **Booking Portals & APIs —** the digital channels and APIs through which the market quotes, books, tracks and pays with Cargospot airlines.
  

In parallel, lead the adoption of AI across CHAMP’s software development lifecycle.

**Why This Role**

* **Build, not inherit —** Build a new R&D organisation and platform around four growth businesses, with the mandate to set its architecture, standards and culture.
* **Global scale from day one —** Work from an installed base of over 200 airlines and GSAs and some 5,600 forwarders and GHAs, with real data and real transaction volumes from day one.
* **Shape AI at CHAMP —** Lead MCP, agentic products and AI-assisted engineering for the whole company, not just one team.
* **Stability and visibility —** A profitable company within the SITA Group, a seat on the Cargo Business Unit leadership team and direct exposure to EXCO.

##### **Responsibilities :**

*R&D Organisation and Leadership*

* Build and lead the Ecosystem & Commerce R&D organisation: engineering managers, tech leads, architects, developers, QA and SRE/cloud engineers, across locations and time zones.
* Define team topology, roles, career paths for leadership and senior IC tracks, and a strong hiring bar; lead senior engineering hiring and talent development.
* Build an ownership-driven, high-velocity engineering culture with strict quality standards; define and support the staff retention plan aligned with CHAMP objectives.
  

*Delivery of the Ecosystem & Commerce Portfolio*

* Own engineering delivery for joint-business and interline middleware, Cargospot Pay, the MCP and agentic layer, and booking portals and APIs, against the roadmap set with the Director of Product Management – Ecosystem & Commerce.
* Plan capacity, sequence releases and keep committed dates credible; make trade-offs, risks and dependencies visible early.
* Productise integration: standard connectors, reusable patterns and API standards that reduce the time and cost of every new airline, partner and integration.
* Support the COO’s delivery organisation with technical leadership on implementations, and pre-sales and RFP/RFI responses with architecture and technical answers.
  

*Architecture, Cloud and Technology Ownership*

* Own the overall architecture and technology roadmap for the Ecosystem & Commerce portfolio: integration layer, event-driven and API-first design, data model and platform services, aligned with Neo and the Director of Engineering & Platform.
* Own the cloud estate for this area: infrastructure, environments, cost management (FinOps), scalability and multi-region deployment.
* Own production reliability and operations: SRE practices, observability, incident management, availability and performance targets, and disaster recovery.
* Ensure security and compliance by design, including identity and access, data protection and, for Cargospot Pay, payment-industry requirements such as PCI DSS.
* Lead build, partner or buy assessments and the technical side of strategic partnerships, including payment providers and integration partners.
  

  

*MCP and Agentic Layer*

* Architect and build the MCP and agentic layer around Cargospot products, so customers’, partners’ and CHAMP’s own AI agents can securely discover, consume and transact through our APIs.
* Define the standards for agent access: authentication and authorisation, guardrails, auditability, rate limiting and usage metering.
* Build shared AI services that other CHAMP product lines can reuse.
  

*AI in the SDLC across CHAMP*

* Lead and promote AI-assisted engineering across CHAMP: tools, skills and plugins for coding, code review, testing, triage and documentation.
* Define the governance that keeps AI-assisted delivery fast and safe: automated quality guardrails, test coverage, review policies and secure use of AI tools.
* Measure the impact with clear engineering metrics such as DORA, release reliability and capacity, and share practices and results with all R&D teams.
  

*Engineering Excellence*

* Own CI/CD, test automation, release management and engineering standards for the portfolio.
* Make R&D measurable: capacity, flow, quality and delivery metrics visible to product, BU leadership and EXCO.
  

*Working with Other Departments*

* Work as one team with the Director of Product Management – Ecosystem & Commerce: product defines, R&D builds and runs.
* Work closely with the Director of Engineering & Platform on shared platform services, architecture and cloud.
* Work closely with the COO’s delivery and support organisation on implementation, hypercare and support.
* Work closely with Security, Infrastructure and the CCO organisation on compliance, partnerships and customer commitments.
  

  
  
  

##### **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities :**

* Proven leadership of distributed R&D organisations of 20+ engineers across several teams, countries and time zones, including managers and tech leads.
* Deep experience with integration platforms and APIs: microservices, event-driven architecture, API standards and high-volume B2B integrations.
* Strong cloud-native engineering background: public cloud, containers, CI/CD, observability, SRE and cost management.
* Hands-on leadership of AI-assisted engineering and agentic architecture, including MCP server integration and AI tooling in the SDLC.
* Experience with payments or fintech platforms, digital booking or e-commerce channels is a strong plus.
* Air cargo, freight or logistics domain knowledge is a strong plus.

description:
**Job Description**  
  
**Fitch Ratings is currently seeking a Senior Analyst or Associate Director, Fis - Spanish Banks based out of our Madrid office.**  
  
As one of the world's top three credit ratings agencies, Fitch Ratings plays a critical role in global capital markets by providing supplementary credit analysis, ratings, research, and commentary to financial market participants. For over 100 years, Fitch Ratings has been creating value for global markets through its rigorous analysis and deep expertise, which have resulted in a variety of market leading tools, methodologies, indices, research, and analytical products. Fitch Ratings is part of Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries, which also includes Fitch Solutions. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst.
  
  
At Fitch Ratings, credit analysts play a pivotal role in moving markets, as quality credit analysis is the lifeblood of our organization. With a legacy of over a century, our unique approach to credit ratings offers unmatched opportunities for professional growth. Embracing a "challenger mindset," you'll join a team dedicated to innovating service to our clients. Our people-driven analysis thrives on collaboration across all levels and locations, surpassing traditional financial modeling. Lastly, as part of our global community, you'll find inspiration, challenge, and support, with ample opportunities for visibility and influence in the global financial marketplace.
  
  
Want to learn more about a career as a credit analyst at Fitch Ratings? Visit: https://careers.fitch.group/content/Credit-Analysts/
  
  
**About the Team**  
  
The Fitch Ratings Financial Institutions Group has actively built the agency into the global leader in bank credit rating coverage. Our experienced analysts provide comprehensive, timely and transparent coverage of major institutions around the world, as well as unparalleled coverage of smaller companies. Our analysts offer a diversity of talent and backgrounds, with experience in regulatory oversight, counterparty analysis, auditing, investment banking, buy-side investing and more.

* Monitoring a portfolio of issuer ratings, including the preparation of rating committee materials

* Participation in the publication of sector-specific research and commentary, including preparation of peer data, country snapshots and sector background information
* Assist as needed in the coverage of other banks in the portfolio; including working with other team members to prepare committee materials, peer tables or analytical tools, reviewing annual and interim accounts and completing ad-hoc data requests

**You May be a Good Fit if:**

* Proven analytical experience (ideally between 4 and 6 years), ideally in credit- or audit-related fields, gained from working at a commercial/investment bank, accountancy firm, buy-side firm, regulatory authority, rating agency, or similar.
* Background in either financial institutions or corporate credit analysis. Experience in bank analysis and banking regulation is desirable.
* Excellent demonstrable written and verbal communication skills in Spanish (native level) and English are essential.
* Ability to work independently as well as being a good team player.
* Ability to cope with time pressure and work to deadlines.
* Strong writing and communication skills as well as strong command of financial statement analysis.
* Proficient in Excel
* A drive for innovation and appetite to find smart ways to implement AI into daily analytical tasks.

This position will involve occasional travel, primarily within Europe.
  
  
**What Would Make You Stand Out:**

* Knowledge of another European language such as Portuguese is desired but not essential.
* University degree level, preferably with professional qualifications (such as CFA).

* **Hybrid Work Environment:** 3 days a week in office required

* **Promoting Health & Wellbeing:** Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing
* **Supportive Parenting Policies:** Family-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
* **Inclusive Work Environment** : A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe
* **Dedication to Giving Back:** Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community

At Fitch, AI is embedded in how we work every day-supporting smarter decision-making, streamlining workflows, and enabling new ways to create value for our business and clients. Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day-to-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We're looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI-enabled environment-or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. We value professionals who embrace technology as part of continuous learning and who are committed to using it thoughtfully to enhance how work gets done.
  
  
Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch's credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interest or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Expected annualized salary for the role will be between EUR 55,000 to 68,000 (analyst level) and EUR 70,000 - 80,000 (senior analyst level) per annum. To grow GCN en Español as a leading destination for Spanish-speaking cycling fans around the world.

This means growing our audience, views and subscribers, while continually developing the breadth, quality and appeal of our content. We aim to inform, entertain and inspire cyclists through original, relevant and engaging video content covering all aspects of the sport and cycling culture.

**Success outcomes (within the fixed-term contract)**
-----------------------------------------------------

By the end of the contract, the successful candidate will have:

* Successfully integrated into the GCN en Español team and established a strong rapport with the existing presenters and production team.
* Confidently presented and contributed to a variety of the channel's regular content and social formats.
* Researched, developed and pitched original ideas that have been progressed into engaging video content.
* Demonstrated the ability to independently research, script and present content to a consistently high standard.
* Contributed to the growth and engagement of the GCN en Español audience through compelling, relevant and entertaining content.
* Represented the channel professionally at cycling events, races and industry activities where required.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Presenting and content creation**

* Be one of the key faces and voices of GCN en Español, representing the channel on camera and across its various platforms.
* Present a wide range of content, including cycling news, technical features, product reviews, challenges, entertainment, interviews and practical advice.
* Bring energy, personality, humour and authenticity to presentations, helping to create an engaging relationship with our audience.
* Research, develop and pitch original content ideas that reflect the interests of our Spanish-speaking cycling audience.
* Write scripts, prepare presentations and work with producers and other team members to plan and deliver content.
* Take ownership of individual video projects where appropriate, from initial idea and research through to filming and delivery.
* Actively engage with the GCN en Español audience across social media platforms, helping to build a strong and loyal cycling community.

### **Cycling knowledge and technical content**

* Present informative and engaging technical content, including bike and component reviews, product comparisons, testing and explanations of new cycling technology.
* Present practical how-to content covering bike maintenance, riding techniques, training, fitness and cycling skills.
* Demonstrate products and techniques both in the studio and out on location, providing viewers with useful, accessible and credible advice.
* Use personal cycling knowledge and experience to provide insight, context and credibility to the content.
* Keep up to date with developments in the cycling industry, new products, trends and innovations.

### **Racing and industry coverage**

* Research and present cycling news, race reports and analysis, particularly around major professional stage races and one-day events.
* Present technical and feature content from professional cycling races and other industry events.
* Use industry contacts to arrange and conduct interviews with professional riders, teams, mechanics and other key figures in cycling.
* Help bring the stories, personalities and developments from the professional peloton to life for our audience.
* Attend race events and other locations as required to produce relevant and engaging content.

### **Teamwork and channel development**

* Work closely with International Content Creators, Production team and other presenters to ensure content aligns with the channel's objectives and overall GCN strategy.
* Collaborate with other GCN channels and the wider Play Sports Network team where opportunities arise.
* Contribute positively to the creative culture of the team, sharing ideas and supporting the development of new formats and content opportunities.
* Assist other members of the GCN team as and when required.

### **Commercial Content and Partner Relationships**

* Present branded and sponsored content for GCN en Español, working with commercial partners to deliver engaging video content that meets agreed campaign objectives.
* Work collaboratively with the commercial, production and editorial teams to develop creative ideas and concepts for partner-led content.
* Confidently integrate brand messaging, products and key campaign messages into video content in a natural, engaging and authentic way.
* Present product demonstrations, reviews, sponsored features and other commercial formats while maintaining the tone, personality and credibility of GCN.
* Build positive working relationships with commercial partners and represent GCN professionally during filming, events and other partner-facing activities.
* Understand the importance of delivering content that meets both audience expectations and commercial commitments.

**Skills, experience and attributes**
-------------------------------------

**Essential:**

* An elite-level road cyclist, comfortable demonstrating riding techniques and participating in cycling challenges and features.
* Good knowledge of, and contacts within, professional road cycling and the cycling industry, with knowledge of its equipment and technology.
* Passionate about cycling, with understanding of its overall culture and audience.
* Native/fluent Spanish speaker with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Good ability in spoken and written English to communicate effectively with the wider Play Sports Network team, the majority of which are based in the UK.
* Confident and engaging on camera, with the ability to communicate information clearly and naturally.
* Creative, curious and able to generate interesting and original content ideas.
* Research, scriptwriting and storytelling skills.
* Flexible, organised and able to work effectively in a fast-paced production environment.
* A positive team player who can also work well independently and take ownership of projects.

**Desirable:**

* Previous experience presenting video or digital content.
* Experience in journalism, broadcasting, video production or content creation.
* Experience presenting technical cycling content, product reviews or race coverage.

title: Senior Analyst/ Associate Director, FIs - Spanish banks, Madrid
description:
Requisition ID: 50969

Business Unit: Fitch Ratings

Category: Credit Analysis & Research

Location:
Madrid, M, ES

Date Posted: Nov 13, 2026

**Fitch Ratings is currently seeking a Senior Analyst or Associate Director, Fis – Spanish Banks based out of our Madrid office.**

  

As one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, Fitch Ratings plays a critical role in global capital markets by providing supplementary credit analysis, ratings, research, and commentary to financial market participants. For over 100 years, Fitch Ratings has been creating value for global markets through its rigorous analysis and deep expertise, which have resulted in a variety of market leading tools, methodologies, indices, research, and analytical products. Fitch Ratings is part of Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries, which also includes Fitch Solutions. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst.

  

At Fitch Ratings, credit analysts play a pivotal role in moving markets, as quality credit analysis is the lifeblood of our organization. With a legacy of over a century, our unique approach to credit ratings offers unmatched opportunities for professional growth. Embracing a “challenger mindset,” you'll join a team dedicated to innovating service to our clients. Our people-driven analysis thrives on collaboration across all levels and locations, surpassing traditional financial modeling. Lastly, as part of our global community, you'll find inspiration, challenge, and support, with ample opportunities for visibility and influence in the global financial marketplace.

  

Want to learn more about a career as a credit analyst at Fitch Ratings? Visit: https://careers.fitch.group/content/Credit-Analysts/

  

**About the Team**

  

The Fitch Ratings Financial Institutions Group has actively built the agency into the global leader in bank credit rating coverage. Our experienced analysts provide comprehensive, timely and transparent coverage of major institutions around the world, as well as unparalleled coverage of smaller companies. Our analysts offer a diversity of talent and backgrounds, with experience in regulatory oversight, counterparty analysis, auditing, investment banking, buy-side investing and more.

  

**How You’ll Make an Impact:**

* Monitoring a portfolio of issuer ratings, including the preparation of rating committee materials
* Analysis of financial institutions sector and individual banks data, update of financial excel-based tools and charts
* Writing and publishing of comprehensive rating reports on individual issuers
* Participation in credit rating committees for banks in the allocated region and other countries
* Regular interaction with contacts at issuers and with issuers’ senior management at rating meetings
* Participation in the publication of sector-specific research and commentary, including preparation of peer data, country snapshots and sector background information
* Assist as needed in the coverage of other banks in the portfolio; including working with other team members to prepare committee materials, peer tables or analytical tools, reviewing annual and interim accounts and completing ad-hoc data requests

  

**You May be a Good Fit if:**

* Proven analytical experience (ideally between 4 and 6 years), ideally in credit- or audit-related fields, gained from working at a commercial/investment bank, accountancy firm, buy-side firm, regulatory authority, rating agency, or similar.
* Background in either financial institutions or corporate credit analysis. Experience in bank analysis and banking regulation is desirable.
* Excellent demonstrable written and verbal communication skills in Spanish (native level) and English are essential.
* Ability to work independently as well as being a good team player.
* Ability to cope with time pressure and work to deadlines.
* Strong writing and communication skills as well as strong command of financial statement analysis.
* Proficient in Excel
* A drive for innovation and appetite to find smart ways to implement AI into daily analytical tasks.

This position will involve occasional travel, primarily within Europe.

  

**What Would Make You Stand Out:**

* Knowledge of another European language such as Portuguese is desired but not essential.
* University degree level, preferably with professional qualifications (such as CFA).

  

**Why Choose Fitch:**

* **Hybrid Work Environment:** 3 days a week in office required
* **A Culture of Learning & Mobility:** Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity
* **Investing in Your Future:** Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals
* **Promoting Health & Wellbeing:** Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing
* **Supportive Parenting Policies:** Family-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
* **Inclusive Work Environment**: A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe
* **Dedication to Giving Back:** Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community

  

At Fitch, AI is embedded in how we work every day—supporting smarter decision-making, streamlining workflows, and enabling new ways to create value for our business and clients. Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day-to-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We’re looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI-enabled environment—or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. We value professionals who embrace technology as part of continuous learning and who are committed to using it thoughtfully to enhance how work gets done.

  

Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch’s credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interest or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will be asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work.

  

Fitch is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We evaluatequalified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law.

  

Expected annualized salary for the role will be between EUR 65,000 to 75,000 (analyst level) and EUR 67,500 – 85,000 (senior analyst level) per annum. Actual salaries will be determined on an individualized basis and may vary based on factors including but not limited to education, training, experience, past performance, and other job-related factors. Base pay is one part of Fitch’s total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, discretionary bonuses, long-term incentives, and other benefits such as pension, health and life insurance sponsored by Fitch.

  

**Disclaimer on Benefits Information**

  

In accordance with the requirements of the EU Pay Transparency Directive, the benefits described in this job advertisement represent a general overview and do not constitute the full list of benefits available for this position. Comprehensive and final details regarding compensation and benefits will be provided to candidates at the offer stage.

description:
**Company Description**

At Syngenta Crop Protection, we're pioneering solutions that safeguard global food security while championing sustainable agriculture. As a world market leader headquartered in Switzerland, we empower farmers with innovative crop protection technologies that defend against nature's toughest challenges. We unite advanced science with digital solutions to develop intelligent crop protection that maximizes yields while minimizing environmental impact. Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest.

 **Job Description**

**Location: any country within Geographical Area South**

**Country/Cluster Scope: GA South**

**Work Level: 5A**

The Transformation Lead serves as the transformation orchestration lead for implementing the Re-Imagine Europe programme within the Geographic Area (GA), with primary focus on Crop Protection. The role goes beyond project planning and reporting: it acts as the integrator that connects strategy, operating model design, change execution, capability building, new ways of working and business adoption across countries, functions and field-facing teams.

Working in close partnership with the GA Head, country leaders, HR, Finance, Communications, functional leads and the European programme team, the role translates the European master plan into an integrated GA transformation roadmap. It coordinates dependencies across workstreams, ensures that structural changes are implemented coherently, and drives adoption of future commercial ways of working, including new role interfaces, field force routines, customer segmentation, digital tools, AI-enabled productivity solutions and data-enabled performance management.

This is a high-visibility transformation leadership role requiring strong PMO discipline, change leadership, stakeholder influence, commercial understanding, digital curiosity and the ability to mobilise teams without direct authority. Success will be measured not only by delivery against milestones, but by business readiness, adoption of new behaviours, clarity of accountabilities, continuity of commercial execution and measurable progress toward the intended Re-Imagine business outcomes.

**Accountabilities**

* Integrated Transformation Roadmap: Translate the European programme master plan into an integrated GA transformation roadmap covering organisation design, people transition, capability building, change calendar, communications, commercial readiness, tools deployment and adoption milestones.
* Transformation Orchestration: Coordinate execution across countries, workstreams and functions, ensuring that HR, Finance, Legal, Communications, Commercial Excellence, IT/Digital, Sales, Marketing Activation and Technical teams move against one coherent plan and that dependencies are actively managed.
* Change Adoption & New Ways of Working: Design and facilitate the adoption approach for the new GA operating model, including role interfaces, governance routines, decision rights, RACI/DACI clarification, field force engagement, commercial calendar alignment and reinforcement of new behaviours after go-live.
* Field Force & Commercial Engagement: Engage sales, technical, marketing activation and customer-facing teams to ensure that the transformation lands pragmatically in the field, protects business continuity, supports customer impact and enables teams to adopt future commercial practices with confidence.
* Digital, Data & AI Enablement: Coordinate local readiness and adoption of enabling tools such as CRM/SFDC improvements, customer dashboards, AI-enabled sales support, data quality routines, automation and other Future of Commercial use cases, ensuring that technology deployment is linked to business value and user adoption.
* Business Readiness, Risk & Impact Tracking: Monitor transformation progress, readiness indicators, adoption metrics, risks, issues and business impact, including implications for P&L delivery, field productivity, customer coverage, capability gaps and timing risks against the commercial calendar.
* Stakeholder Mobilisation & Governance: Prepare and facilitate transformation governance forums, leadership checkpoints, country working sessions and cross-functional problem-solving meetings; ensure clear decisions, follow-up actions, ownership and escalation where needed.
* Transformation Documentation: Maintain the integrated roadmap, decision log, action tracker, risks and issues register, readiness dashboard, stakeholder map, change calendar and key handover materials required to secure continuity before, during and after go-live.

  
**Qualifications**

**Knowledge, experience & capabilities**

***Critical knowledge***

* University degree
* Fluent in English, both written and verbal; knowledge of the local language(s) of the GA an advantage.
* Experience in management programs, transformation PMO, change delivery or business transformation in a multi-country context.
* Solid understanding of PMO disciplines, transformation governance, change management principles, adoption planning, risk management and benefits tracking.
* Familiarity with agricultural or commercial business context, Future of Commercial concepts, CRM/data-enabled commercial execution and AI/digital productivity tools; Crop Protection experience an advantage.

***Critical experience***

* >5 years’ experience leading complex projects, transformation programs or PMO activities across multiple countries, functions or business units.
* Working in or with a multi-country, multi-functional team.
* Proven experience supporting organizational change, capability building, stakeholder mobilization, process redesign, digital adoption or commercial transformation.

***Critical technical, professional and personal capabilities***

* Strong transformation PMO discipline: able to structure complex programs, manage interdependencies, maintain momentum and convert ambiguity into clear execution plans.
* Ability to coordinate across multiple countries, functions and workstreams while maintaining one integrated view of priorities, risks, milestones and adoption status.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, including the capacity to connect people readiness, tool deployment, process change, customer impact and P&L implications.
* Excellent facilitation, communication and influencing skills; able to engage senior leaders, country teams and field-facing colleagues in a credible and pragmatic way.
* Comfortable with digital, data and AI-enabled ways of working; able to translate tools into practical use cases, adoption routines and measurable business value.

***Critical success factors & key challenges***

* Shifting the role from project tracking to true transformation orchestration, ensuring that structure, people, process, tools and behaviors move together.
* Creating strong engagement with country leaders and field force teams so the new operating model is understood, adopted and translated into day-to-day commercial routines.
* Ensuring that Future of Commercial, AI, CRM, customer segmentation and other digital enablers are not treated as parallel initiatives but embedded into the GA transformation plan and adoption agenda.
* Managing the tension between European consistency and local market realities while protecting commercial continuity, customer impact and readiness for go-live.

  
**Additional Information**

The job holder must be able to demonstrate a reasonable prioritisation of where job is physically performed and show flexibility to serve strong business need where required.

Employee may, as part of his/her role and maybe through multifunctional teams, participate in the creation and design of innovative solutions. In this context, Employee may contribute to inventions, designs, other work product, including know-how, copyrights, software, innovations, solutions, and other intellectual assets.

We’re a woman-founded and woman-led firm with a team that reflects a broad range of lived experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. At Teal, we value our people above all else and choose to work with partners and clients who share those values.

**Associate Director of Digital Strategy**
==========================================

Base salary $120,000–$140,000

**Put your digital strategy skills to work for causes worth fighting for.**

The organizations we work with are taking on some of the biggest issues of our time. They need people to pay attention, get involved, and give. We help make that happen.

Teal is a full-service creative agency partnering with nonprofits and mission-driven organizations to build brands, create websites, and turn digital engagement into action. We care deeply about the causes we serve. We ask hard questions, push the thinking, and sweat the details because our clients need work that delivers.

We’re looking for an Associate Director of Digital Strategy who brings that same conviction to their work. Someone who can earn a client’s trust, make a strong strategic call, and get into the platforms when a campaign needs attention. If you care about progressive causes and have the digital chops to help them move forward, we’d love to meet you.

**Why this role matters**
=========================

You’ll lead strategy for a portfolio of complex digital marketing engagements, helping clients connect their ambitions to clear priorities and measurable results. That means understanding their audiences, making smart choices about where to invest, and bringing paid media, email, social, SMS, web, content, SEO, and analytics together around shared goals.

You’ll report to our Senior Director of Digital Strategy and provide senior leadership on client accounts and projects. You’ll also mentor teammates and help grow Teal’s digital marketing practice through proposals, pitches, and stronger client partnerships.

**What you’ll do**
==================

* **Lead the strategy and own the follow-through**. Guide discovery, digital audits, audience research, and planning for complex engagements. Turn what you learn into practical roadmaps with clear goals, responsibilities, and measures of success.
* **Be the partner clients count on**. Build relationships with senior stakeholders, lead workshops and tough conversations, and help teams make decisions. Bring a clear point of view, listen closely, and respectfully challenge assumptions when a better approach will serve the mission.
* **Connect the channels**. Develop integrated strategies that grow audiences, deepen engagement, support advocacy, and raise money. Make recommendations that fit each client’s goals, budget, and capacity.
* **Make the numbers useful**. Establish KPIs, benchmarks, and measurement plans. Translate data and audience insights into clear recommendations, explain the story behind performance, and ensure approved optimizations make it into the work.
* **Stay close to execution**. Move comfortably between the big picture and the details. Review a campaign, troubleshoot a platform issue, or help execute when the work calls for it. We’re a small, agile team, and this role needs someone who is ready to jump in.
* **Make the creative stronger**. Partner with creative leads on campaign concepts, messaging, and ongoing communications. Give useful feedback and make sure the work reflects the client’s brand, reaches the right people, and supports the strategy.
* **Keep delivery on track**. Work with project managers, creatives, developers, and channel specialists to manage scopes, budgets, timelines, and quality. Spot risks early, recommend solutions, and keep clients and teammates informed before a problem becomes a surprise.
* **Help good partnerships grow**. Identify opportunities to expand client relationships where additional services would advance their goals. Work with the Senior Director and business development team on proposals, scopes, pitches, and prospect conversations.
* **Raise the team’s game**. Mentor colleagues, share what’s working across accounts, and improve the tools and frameworks behind our work. Support recruiting and onboarding as needed, and bring useful developments in digital marketing back to the team.
* **Balance great work with a healthy practice**. Meet the role’s billable utilization expectations while making room for approved business development and practice-building priorities. Understand how your decisions affect client outcomes and agency performance.

**What you bring**
==================

* A track record of leading complex, integrated digital marketing engagements, ideally for nonprofits, advocacy organizations, foundations, or other organizations working toward positive change.
* Broad knowledge of paid media, email, social, SMS, web, content strategy, SEO, and analytics, with deep hands-on expertise in at least one area. You can connect the disciplines and work confidently within the platforms you know best.
* The confidence and judgment to advise senior clients, facilitate productive conversations, and build agreement among people with competing priorities.
* Strong analytical instincts. You can connect performance data, audience behavior, and qualitative research to a recommendation people can act on.
* Clear, persuasive writing and presentation skills. You can explain what you recommend, why it matters, and how you’ll know it worked.
* Experience leading work across disciplines and helping colleagues grow, whether or not they report to you. You give clear direction, welcome feedback, and follow through.
* Sound agency judgment around scope, budgets, utilization, and competing priorities. You know when to dig deeper, when to make the call, and when to raise a concern.
* A real connection to the work. **You’re energized by progressive, mission-driven clients** and take their trust, resources, and results seriously.

**What we offer**
=================

Work you can care about. Colleagues who care about the craft. And benefits that support a full life beyond your next deadline.

Base salary of $120,000–$140,000. Where you land depends on your experience and skills.

Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage begin the first of the month after you join.

**Health coverage that puts you first**
---------------------------------------

* $0 premiums for employee-only coverage on our high-deductible health plan, plus an employer contribution to your Health Savings Account. Your HSA is yours to keep and use for eligible health expenses now or later.
* A generous contribution toward family coverage, plus a choice of medical plans, including $1,000-deductible and $0-deductible options. We contribute toward premiums on every plan.

**Dental and vision covered**

**Additional support at no cost to you**

**Time to recharge**

**Investing in your future**
