title: Head of New Verticals Business Planning and Performance
description:
**Our Global Structure**

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

**The Team**

Deliveroo is on a mission to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders.

Our Grocery & Retail team manages Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail businesses. We work closely with our partners and cross-functional teams to drive growth, strengthen the customer proposition and improve business performance.

As the scale and complexity of Grocery & Retail continues to grow, the Strategy & Performance function plays a central role in setting market strategy, leading business planning, embedding strong performance management and ensuring we continue to improve the customer experience.

**The Role**

The Head of Strategy & Performance, New Verticals - Middle East is responsible for setting the strategic direction of Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail business and ensuring we translate that strategy into measurable growth and performance.

This is a high-impact leadership role with significant exposure to senior local and global stakeholders, sitting at the centre of some of the most important decisions shaping the future of Grocery & Retail in the Middle East. You will work closely with the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team across strategy, business planning, performance, customer value proposition and high-priority cross-functional initiatives.

You will lead two core functions: Strategy & Performance and Category Management, setting their direction, building strong teams and bringing together data, customer insight and commercial context to determine where we should focus, what needs to change and how we deliver against our ambitions. Through Category Management, you will shape the customer proposition across key levers including conversion, selection, catalogue quality, pricing, promotions and merchandising, ensuring priorities translate into tangible improvements across the customer journey.

The role combines big-picture strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will need to be equally comfortable defining long-term priorities, diagnosing why the business is performing the way it is, influencing senior stakeholders and getting into the details to unblock complex initiatives.

You will directly manage the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager, with the wider Category Management team also sitting within your organisation.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* **Own Grocery & Retail strategy and planning:** Set the strategic direction for Grocery and non-food Retail, lead annual and quarterly planning, identify and size the biggest growth opportunities, and partner closely with Finance to translate strategic priorities into financial plans, business cases and clear targets.
* **Drive business performance:** Own the overall performance framework for Grocery & Retail, ensuring leadership understands what is driving performance and where action is required. Set the direction for WBRs, MBRs and performance diagnostics, and build a strong culture of accountability and follow-through.
* **Shape the customer proposition and Category Management agenda:** Own the overarching CVP strategy and set the direction for Category Management across key levers including selection, availability, pricing, promotions, merchandising, catalogue quality and conversion. Ensure priorities are grounded in customer behaviour, commercial performance and competitor insights.
* **Lead high-impact strategic initiatives:** Take ownership of complex, cross-functional opportunities and problems that do not naturally sit within one team, from initial diagnosis and strategic direction through to alignment, delivery and handover into BAU.
* **Lead and develop high-performing teams:** Lead the Strategy & Performance and Category Management functions, directly managing the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager. Set clear priorities, coach and develop the team, and build the capabilities, tools and operating models needed for both functions to scale effectively.
* **Influence senior stakeholders and shape decisions:** Act as a strategic partner to the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team, representing Grocery & Retail in key local and central discussions and shaping decisions on the business's most important strategic priorities.

**Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in Strategy & Operations, strategy, consulting, investment banking, commercial, growth or business operations, ideally in a high-growth technology, marketplace or startup environment; experience in on-demand delivery, Grocery, Retail or digital category management is a strong advantage.
* Strong commercial and analytical judgement, with the ability to understand business performance, diagnose root causes and make clear recommendations grounded in data and commercial context.
* Strong ability to structure ambiguity, taking broad or loosely defined business problems, framing the problem clearly, identifying the right questions and translating them into a practical strategy and execution plan.
* Strong influencer and relationship builder, able to bring senior and cross-functional stakeholders on the journey, communicate in a way that resonates with different audiences and drive alignment without relying on formal authority.
* Proven end-to-end execution capability, including mobilising the right teams and resources, securing investment or headcount where needed, removing blockers and driving complex initiatives through to measurable outcomes.
* Proven people leadership experience, with the ability to set clear direction, develop high-performing teams, coach managers and build the capabilities and ways of working needed for teams to scale effectively.
* Strong data literacy and comfort using analytical and AI tools to accelerate analysis, problem-solving and decision-making; experience with tools such as Looker, Cursor, Claude or similar is an advantage.

**Benefits and Diversity**

* Annual Holiday Leave
* Annual flight allowance
* Free Deliveroo Plus - Free delivery and access to special offers
* Enhanced Maternity & Paternity benefits
* End of year parties & regular social events
* An extremely fun team to work alongside!

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business, and we prioritize their welfare. We offer many great benefits in areas including health insurance, family, financial coverage, community, convenience, growth opportunities, time away, and relocation.

We believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgment when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion, or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing start-ups around.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**  
  
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Director of AI Experience Design
description:
**About OpenLoop**
------------------

OpenLoop was co-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go-to-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states.

We are the digital health infrastructure powering modern medicine. Healthcare and non-healthcare brands use our white-label platform to launch, scale and run virtual and hybrid care without the operational complexity. We bring together one of the largest telehealth clinician networks in the country, nationwide payer coverage, integrated pharmacy and lab partners, EHR connectivity, 24/7 patient support and full revenue cycle management. Our partners put their brand on the front end, and everything behind it runs on us. We serve more than 3 million patients a year and power over 1 million visits a month.

**About the Role**
------------------

As **Director of AI Experience Design** at OpenLoop Health, you'll lead design across everything we build: patient and client-facing experiences, our White-Label platform and Launchpad, AI agents and copilots, and the operational platforms our teams use every day.

You'll set a multi-year design vision, grow and lead the team, and own the system our products are built on. That system won't only guide human designers. It becomes the contract AI follows, precise enough that AI tools can build UI that meets our bar. You'll also help designers, engineers, and PMs use AI effectively and at scale, so the team can do more without lowering the bar on quality.

You'll treat design like a business: own the outcomes, make focused bets, and iterate based on customer truth and data. This is a hands-on leadership role at the intersection of strategy and execution.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Set the design vision and strategy across patient, client, and internal products, and turn bold ideas into outcomes patients, clients, and the business can measure.
* Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of designers. Establish clear career paths, strong critique, and a culture with a high bar for craft.
* Own the design system as the source of truth, not a side artifact. That covers tokens, components, information hierarchy, and interaction principles, with theming across the many client brands our White-Label platform supports.
* Make the system AI-ready. Ship standards as code (tokens, patterns, and components wired into the engineering pipeline) so the correct, accessible, compliant pattern is the default for people and AI coding agents alike.
* Measure the system like a product, using adoption in code, pattern reuse, override rates, and first-pass quality, and retire patterns the data shows are failing.
* Help the Product & Tech org use AI effectively and at scale, with the workflows, tools, and standards that let the team ship more without sacrificing quality.
* Set the standard for how AI shows up in our products, across voice, chat, and autonomous agents. That covers trust patterns like transparency, citations, confidence, error recovery, escalation, and human handoff in a regulated healthcare setting.
* Ground decisions in research. Run discovery and usability testing with patients, clinicians, and clients, and prototype in code with real data to validate ideas before they scale.
* Audit existing and acquired surfaces, such as Hey Revia and Season Health, and drive convergence toward a single coherent experience.
* Partner with Product and Engineering leaders on problem definition, roadmap, and scoping.
* Own design KPIs and instrument the experience to quantify impact. Represent Design in executive forums with clear narratives, tradeoffs, and results.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 10+ years in product design, with 3+ years leading teams directly. B2B or B2B2C SaaS experience preferred.
* A portfolio showing end-to-end systems thinking, exceptional craft, and shipped work at scale across web and mobile.
* A track record of designing and shipping AI-powered or agentic experiences in production, and of changing how teams and AI tools actually build.
* Proven ability to recruit, develop, and retain great design talent.
* Inspired by products where systematic design creates clarity, and you know what separates great product experiences from good ones.
* Meticulous and opinionated, able to hold the line on standards while moving fast.
* Comfortable being both hands-on (Figma, tokens, specs, prototyping in code with tools like Claude Code) and strategic (principles, governance, cross-team alignment).
* A strong command of accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and of designing for trust in high-stakes settings.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, able to align executives around crisp narratives and metrics.
* Healthcare or other regulated-industry experience is a plus.

**Our Benefits**
----------------

In addition, for salaried positions you would also be eligible for:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision plans
* Flexible Spending/Health Savings Accounts
* Flexible PTO
* 401(k) + Company Match
* Life Insurance, Pet insurance, and more

**Our Company**
---------------

We have a relatively flat organizational structure here at OpenLoop. Everyone is encouraged to bring ideas to the table and make things happen. This fits in well with our core values of Autonomy, Competence and Belonging, as we want everyone to feel empowered and supported to do their best work.

Sound like a good fit? We’d love to meet you.

title: Senior Director, Data Center Design & Engineering – AI Data Centers
description:
CleanSpark (Nasdaq: CLSK), is a market-leading data center developer with a proven track record of success. We control a portfolio of more than 1.8 GW of power, land, and data centers across the United States powered by globally competitive energy prices. Sitting at the intersection of Bitcoin, energy, operational excellence, and capital stewardship, we optimize our infrastructure to deliver superior returns to our shareholders. Monetizing low-cost, high reliability energy by producing a global emerging critical resource – compute – positions us to prosper in an ever-changing world.

Visit our website at **www.cleanspark.com**.

**Job Overview**

The Senior Director, Data Center Design & Engineering – AI Data Centers serves as CleanSpark’s owner-side engineering authority, setting standards and technical direction for power, cooling, resilience, and facility performance from design through commissioning and operational handover. This role partners across teams to deliver reliable, buildable facilities and strengthen CleanSpark’s in-house engineering capabilities.

Reporting to the VP, Projects, the Senior Director provides technical leadership to the Director, Data Center Design, who manages external consultants and design deliverables. The Senior Director owns engineering standards, system architecture, and technical decisions, partnering with project and construction leadership on matters affecting cost, schedule, or contractual commitments.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Own and maintain CleanSpark’s AI data center engineering standards, Basis of Design (BoD), and design criteria across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, controls, telecom, and site infrastructure disciplines
* Define and approve system architecture for medium-voltage and low-voltage electrical distribution, generation and backup power, UPS, and mechanical cooling (air and liquid) for high-density AI/HPC loads, including redundancy and resilience targets (e.g., N, N+1, 2N) and associated trade-offs
* Lead engineering interfaces with utilities and substation owners: load studies, interconnection requirements, substation and switchyard design, protection and coordination, metering, and energization sequencing in support of path-to-power planning
* Provide technical direction to the Director, Data Center Design and external design consultants; review and approve technical studies, calculations, single-line diagrams, equipment selections, and design deliverables at each stage gate
* Lead constructability, value engineering, and design-for-schedule reviews with Construction and Pre-Construction; resolve technical issues, RFIs, and design conflicts that exceed consultant or project-team authority
* Own the owner-side commissioning program: define commissioning scope and levels, approve commissioning agents and test scripts, witness integrated systems testing, and sign off on energization and turnover readiness
* Lead operational readiness from an engineering standpoint: handover documentation, as-builts, O&M requirements, spare parts and maintainability criteria, and alignment of design intent with Operations’ requirements
* Evaluate and recommend equipment vendors, long-lead procurement specifications, and standard equipment platforms; support procurement with technical bid evaluations and scopes of work
* Assess engineering risk across the portfolio; identify design, power, cooling, and integration risks early and drive mitigation into standards and project plans
* Support tenant and customer technical requirements, including design review responses, change evaluations, and technical representation in customer and partner forums
* Drive standardization and repeatability across sites so designs scale across the portfolio with predictable cost, schedule, and performance
* Build and mentor the in-house engineering team; define roles, technical competencies, and development paths as the organization grows
* Provide clear technical recommendations and updates to project and executive leadership

This role requires professionalism, respect, strong communication, and the ability to work well with others in a team-oriented, inclusive environment.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline
* 15+ years of progressive experience in the design and engineering of data center, mission-critical, or large-scale power and industrial facilities, including at least 5 years in a senior technical leadership role
* Deep working knowledge of data center electrical infrastructure (MV/LV distribution, generation, UPS, protection and coordination) and mechanical infrastructure (chilled water, air and liquid cooling, heat rejection) for high-density compute
* Demonstrated experience defining redundancy and resilience topologies and translating availability targets into design criteria
* Hands-on experience with utility interconnection, substation design, and energization planning for large loads
* Experience leading commissioning (Levels 1–5 / integrated systems testing) and facility turnover on mission-critical projects
* Proven ability to lead engineering consultants, contractors, and internal technical staff, and to make and defend technical decisions with executives, customers, and partners
* Strong constructability judgment and experience partnering with construction teams through design, procurement, and field execution
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional Engineer (PE) license strongly preferred
* Experience with AI, HPC, or hyperscale data center design, including liquid-cooled and high-density rack deployments
* Owner-side experience with a hyperscaler, colocation provider, or large infrastructure developer
* Experience developing and governing engineering standards or Basis of Design programs across multiple sites
* Familiarity with Uptime Institute Tier concepts, ASHRAE TC 9.9 guidelines, NEC/NFPA 70 and NFPA 70E, IEEE power system standards, and applicable energy codes
* Master’s degree in engineering or an MBA
* Experience in a fast-growth owner organization building in-house technical capability

This position may involve duties that require operation of a company vehicle or travel between job sites. As such, candidates must be insurable under CleanSpark's vehicle insurance policy.

CleanSpark is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

The Senior Director, Sourcing & Procurement will own the end-to-end sourcing, contracting, and commercial
  
management strategy for General Contractor (GC), Architecture/Engineering (AE) design consultant, Substation EPC, and Commissioning (Cx) agent services supporting the company's U.S. hyperscale and AI-infrastructure data center construction program. This role is the primary procurement authority across the pre-construction, GC selection, sub trade selection, substation EPC, and commissioning phases of new-build and expansion projects, partnering closely with Construction, Engineering, Development, Legal, and Finance to secure capacity, control cost and schedule risk, and drive consistent, defensible contracting outcomes across a fast-growing portfolio of data center campuses.

  
  

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

  

Sourcing & Contracting Strategy

Substation EPC

* 10+ years of progressive procurement, construction management, or supply chain leadership experience in hyperscale or mission-critical data center construction; prior experience at a hyperscaler, colocation provider, or major GC/EPC firm strongly preferred.

Deep working knowledge of GMP, lump sum, CMAR, Design-Build, and Progressive Design-Build contracting models, and of OFCI/CFCI/ODCI scope structuring.

Governance & Compliance is the core of Vanta. It covers the frameworks, controls, policies, audits, and org structures that thousands of companies use to run their security programs. title: Director of Growth
description:
**About Supergut**  
  
Supergut is a fast-growing wellness brand on a mission to help people feel better and get more from their health, starting with the gut. We believe gut health plays a foundational role in how people feel and function every day, and that better nutrition should be simple, credible, and built for real life. We are building a modern wellness brand at the intersection of science, everyday nutrition, and consumer health, with a growing presence across digital commerce and national retail. As we enter our next stage of growth, we are looking for a Director of Growth to help scale the business thoughtfully, efficiently, and sustainably.  
  
**The Role**  
  
We are looking for a strategic, data-driven, highly commercial growth leader to own the growth engine for Supergut, spanning customer acquisition, ecommerce performance, conversion, lifecycle, retention, customer experience, and retail media.  
  
This person will be responsible for turning consumer demand into profitable, sustainable growth. You will lead paid media strategy and performance across Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging channels while owning the broader DTC customer journey from first click through repeat purchase.  
  
You will partner closely with Brand, Creative, Channel leads, and other cross-functional leaders to turn company priorities into high-performing customer experiences and measurable commercial outcomes.  
This is a high-impact, hands-on leadership role that blends performance marketing, ecommerce, lifecycle, analytics, retail media, and commercial strategy. You should be equally comfortable setting the growth strategy, interrogating performance data, managing agencies and partners, coaching your team, and jumping directly into the work when needed.  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own DTC revenue growth and performance against plan, spanning paid acquisition, ecommerce, conversion, lifecycle, retention, and customer value.
* Develop and scale a holistic growth strategy, forecast and investment plan that balances revenue growth with CAC efficiency, LTV, contribution margin, and profitability.
* Lead paid media across Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging channels, managing agency partners and investment decisions.
* Own the ecommerce and CRO roadmap, setting the strategy and leading the team responsible for optimization for Supergut.com, including site optimization, testing, merchandising, offers, subscription, and conversion.
* Lead lifecycle, retention and customer experience, including oversight of the team responsible for email/SMS, DTC CRO and Customer Service, ensuring customer insights inform growth decisions.
* Partner with Brand and Creative to develop, test, and scale high-performing creative, landing pages, offers, and customer journeys.
* Lead retail media strategy and performance in partnership with Retail Sales, while building strong measurement, forecasting, and reporting across the growth function.
* You'll also stay close to emerging growth opportunities, creator-led acquisition, affiliate commerce, and new digital channels, with a bias toward disciplined testing and scalable economics.

**What You Bring**

* 7+ years of experience in growth, ecommerce, acquisition, or performance marketing at a high-growth DTC or omnichannel consumer brand.
* Demonstrated track record of driving rapid, efficient growth.
* Experience owning or materially influencing DTC revenue and performance.
* Experience managing paid media budgets across Meta, Google, and other acquisition channels.
* Current, hands-on understanding of Meta and Google accounts, platform mechanics, and the metrics behind performance.
* Strong experience with Shopify, GA4, attribution tools, and ecommerce analytics.
* Strong command of CAC, payback, LTV, contribution margin, AOV, retention, and subscription economics.
* Experience improving retention, subscription, or lifecycle performance.
* Experience building and managing CRO and experimentation roadmaps.
* Deep understanding of how creative drives performance, with experience briefing, testing, and iterating ads and landing pages.
* Demonstrated experience with TikTok as a growth channel, including paid media, creator-led acquisition, and platform-native creative testing.
* Experience with retail media networks or retailer-specific performance media.
* Experience using AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve marketing and operating efficiency.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn data into clear strategy and recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop a lean team, set clear priorities, and build scalable processes as the business grows.
* Ability to zoom out on strategy and dive directly into execution when the work calls for it.
* Collaborative, entrepreneurial, low-ego mindset suited to a lean, high-growth organization.
* A track record of scaling a business without relying on headcount growth as the first answer.

**Nice to Have**

* Supplement, wellness, functional nutrition, beauty, or broader CPG experience.
* Experience helping a business scale through a comparable stage of growth.
* Experience with Walmart Connect, Target Roundel, Instacart, or other retail media networks.

**How We’ll Measure Success**

* DTC revenue grows efficiently and sustainably, with acquisition, conversion, retention, and customer value improving against the revenue plan.
* Growth investment decisions are grounded in strong measurement, contribution economics, and clear business impact.
* Paid media, creative testing, lifecycle, and CRO operate with a disciplined test-and-learn cadence that produces actionable insights.
* Retail media, TikTok, CX, and cross-functional growth initiatives deliver measurable commercial impact.

**Why You’ll Love Working at Supergut**

* 100% remote-first team with flexible work hours.
* Mission-driven company making a real difference in people’s health.
* Collaborative, fast-moving environment with room to innovate.
* Competitive compensation, medical, dental, and vision benefits, matching 401K and monthly wellness stipend
* The chance to help grow a purpose-led brand from the ground up.

**Compensation**  
The base salary for this role is expected to fall between $160,000 and $180,000, depending on experience and qualifications. This role is also eligible for a 20% target bonus and an equity award.  
  
Supergut is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or any other dimension of diversity.

title: Executive Director
description:
#### ***Thank you for your interest in joining Free Our Vote as our new Executive Director!***

**Location**: Remote

**Compensation**: $150,000 - $170,000

**Reports to**: Board of Directors

**Position**: Full-Time

**About Free Our Vote**
-----------------------

Free Our Vote uses data, technology, and rigorous research to expand access to voting rights, record relief, and economic opportunities for people with criminal records.We partner with nonprofit organizations, legal aid providers, government agencies, and researchers to identify people eligible for relief and make that relief easier to access. Our work combines court-data infrastructure, eligibility analysis, practical technology, and causal evaluation to help partners reach more people and understand what works.Originally focused on voting rights restoration, we have expanded into expungement and are developing applications in occupational licensing and other areas of economic opportunity. We are preparing a broader organizational brand and strategic plan that reflect this growing scope.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We seek an Executive Director to lead Free Our Vote through its next stage of development. The Executive Director will work with the board and staff to sharpen organizational strategy, strengthen operations, expand financial support, and communicate the value of our work to a broader audience.

This is a hands-on leadership opportunity in a small organization with substantial technical and research expertise and an established network of partners. The Executive Director will have responsibility for day-to-day management and execution of the board-approved strategy, supported by engaged founders and board members who contribute expertise, relationships, and strategic guidance.

The successful candidate will bring sound judgment, strong communication skills, and experience helping organizations navigate change. They will translate ambitious ideas into focused plans, support staff through implementation, and build the relationships and resources needed to sustain the work.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **Strategy and organizational change**

* Lead the development and implementation of organizational strategy in partnership with the board and staff.
* Guide the organization through its rebrand and evolving program scope, building a clear shared understanding of its mission and priorities
* Translate strategic decisions into realistic operating plans, budgets, responsibilities, and measures of progress.
* Assess new opportunities against mission, evidence, capacity, and financial sustainability.
* Lead organizational changes with clear communication, staff involvement, and accountability.

### **Staff leadership and operations**

* Manage and support staff, establish clear expectations, and create an environment of collaboration and strong execution.
* Own day-to-day decisions and ensure programs and partner commitments receive appropriate resources and oversight.
* Strengthen the processes needed for effective planning, financial management, and organizational administration.
* Work with the board and finance team to develop budgets and monitor financial performance.
* Keep the board informed about progress, emerging risks, and decisions requiring its involvement.

### **Fundraising and revenue development**

* Develop and execute a revenue strategy that combines philanthropic support with earned revenue from partner contracts.
* Cultivate relationships with foundations, individual donors, and other institutional supporters.
* Lead funding proposals, solicitations, stewardship, and renewals, drawing on staff and board expertise.
* Support the development and renewal of contracts that advance the organization's mission.
* Communicate a compelling case for investment in the organization's programs, research, and shared infrastructure.

### **Communications and public representation**

* Serve as an effective public representative with funders, partners, policymakers, the media, and other audiences.
* Lead communications and marketing strategy, including messaging for the organizational rebrand.
* Explain complex legal, technical, and research topics in accessible and compelling language.
* Represent the organization through strong writing, public speaking, and media engagement.
* Work with staff to share findings and practical lessons accurately and make them useful to partners and the broader field.

### **Partnerships and impact**

* Maintain and deepen relationships with nonprofit organizations, legal aid providers, government agencies, and researchers.
* Identify opportunities for collaboration that expand access to relief and economic opportunity.
* Work closely with technical and research staff to align organizational commitments with delivery capacity.
* Maintain a focus on measurable outcomes, rigorous evaluation, and learning from results.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Experience leading a nonprofit, social enterprise, program, or substantial organizational function, with responsibility for people, budgets, and results.
* Demonstrated ability to guide teams through organizational change, strategic shifts, or significant operational improvements.
* A record of securing financial support through fundraising, institutional partnerships, or related revenue development.
* Excellent writing and public-speaking skills, with the ability to represent an organization credibly to varied audiences.
* Experience developing or leading communications, marketing, or public-engagement efforts.
* Strong operational judgment and the ability to establish priorities and follow through in a small, evolving organization.
* Ability to work effectively with a board and engaged founders while exercising independent leadership.

### **Preferred experience**

* Experience with nonprofit technology, research organizations, or organizations combining philanthropic and earned revenue.

title: Director of High Volume Talent Acquisition
description:
**Job Description**

**A bit about this role:**

Devoted is scaling fast. As we grow to serve close to 1 million members with about 4,000 employees in the US and internationally, our frontline teams are at the heart of how we care for every member like family.

Reporting to the VP of Talent Acquisition, you’ll lead a function that owns both the strategy and execution of high-volume hiring: about 1,200 to 1,500 frontline hires a year. That includes Member Service Guides (inbound, outbound, and digital) and frontline clinical roles like medical assistants, care coordinators and navigators, and community health workers. You’ll lead an in-house recruiting team and our RPO partner, and you’ll own hitting the plan, often with limited ramp time.
  
  
Our hiring plan can change week to week, so we need someone who can mobilize to action without waiting for perfect information, and answer a shifting forecast with “okay, what do we need?” instead of “why did this happen?”, and keeps their sense of humor along the way.

If you’ve built a hiring engine at the scale of a national retailer, restaurant brand, or on-demand platform and want to bring it to a mission that matters, we’d love to meet you.

**Required skills and experience:**

* 12 to 15 years of talent acquisition experience, including significant time leading high-volume recruiting teams and recruiting leaders
* A proven track record of hitting high-volume hiring plans (1,000+ hires a year) with limited ramp time, in consumer, retail, contact center, or healthcare environments
* Strong analytical skills: you run the function by the numbers, including funnel conversion, show rates, time to fill, cost per hire, and early retention
* Strong experience in both manual and automated tracking systems (e.g., ATS reporting alongside Google Sheets/Excel) to monitor training class cohorts, daily pacing, and funnel conversion in real time
* Experience managing an RPO or recruiting vendors alongside an in-house team, with clear service levels and accountability
* Executive presence and the ability to partner with senior operations and clinical leaders on workforce plans, forecasts, and tradeoffs

**Desired skills and experience:**

* Hands-on experience with Workday ATS (strongly preferred), including managing high-volume requisitions, candidate workflows, and offer/onboarding approvals
* International high-volume hiring experience, including work with employer-of-record or in-country partners
* Frontline healthcare hiring experience and hands-on use of high-volume tools like assessments, automated scheduling, conversational AI, and BrightHire
* Experience operationalizing and troubleshooting AI-driven screening and video interviewing workflows (such as BrightHire) at scale, balancing automation speed with a responsive, human candidate experience

**Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:**

* **Own the plan:** Deliver 1,200 to 1,500 frontline hires a year on time, aligned to training class starts and launch dates.
* **Build the engine:** Design a scalable hiring model, from sourcing and assessments to hiring events and automated scheduling, that moves candidates from apply to start fast.
* **Lead the team:** Build, coach, and develop in-house recruiting leaders and recruiters, and grow future leaders from within.
* **Manage the RPO:** Hold our RPO partner accountable for daily delivery, quality, and candidate experience, partnering with TA Operations on service levels.
* **Run on data:** Forecast with operations and clinical leaders, track funnel and quality metrics, and fix bottlenecks quickly.
* **Protect quality:** Balance speed with hiring quality, 90-day retention, compliance, and a candidate experience that reflects how we treat our members.
* **Manage cohort readiness & pre-start workflows:** Oversee end-to-end offer, compliance, and background workflows to protect class fill rates—navigating multi-language (English/Spanish) pipelines, internal transfers, and strict training start-date deadlines for the broader team.
* **Build structured hiring enablement:** Partner with operations and clinical leaders to design standardized interview guides, scoring rubrics, and role matrices—and translate operational workflows into structured inputs for AI interviewing and screening tools.
* **Drive interviewer calibration:** Build and run interviewer trainings across recruiting and hiring teams to ensure consistent, high-bar candidate evaluation.
* **Scale for what’s next:** Help build hiring for new products and international expansion, including seasonal surges around Medicare enrollment.

**Salary Range:** $182,000 - $220,000 year plus bonus and equity

Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.

Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. title: Director of Brand Design
description:
**About Cardiff**

Cardiff lends to small businesses. Since 2004 we've funded more than $12 billion across the country, to businesses in logistics, healthcare, construction, professional services, and plenty in between. We're building our own underwriting technology, and we still answer the phone; our customers need capital fast, and they want a straight answer from a person who can actually help.

**Location:** San Diego, CA or Remote (U.S.)

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Department:** Product and Design/Marketing

**Reports to:** CMO

**Why This Role Matters**

Our customers are small business owners who need capital quickly and clearly. Every screen, form, and message they see shapes whether they trust us enough to apply, finish, and come back. As Director of Brand Design, you'll set the standard for how Cardiff looks, feels, and works across our product, our brand, and every customer touchpoint, and you'll build the team and design system that keep that standard high as we grow.

**What You'll Own**

  

* Set the design vision and strategy for Cardiff's customer-facing products, internal tools, and brand, in partnership with Engineering, Marketing, and leadership
* Lead end-to-end product design for the borrower journey, from first visit and application through underwriting, funding, and repeat borrowing
* Design internal tools for our underwriting, funding, sales, and servicing teams so they can move faster with fewer errors
* Build and maintain a scalable design system in Figma, with documented components, patterns, and accessibility standards that engineering can ship from directly
* Own brand and visual identity across web, paid media, email, direct mail, and sales materials, partnering closely with Marketing on campaign creative
* Ground design decisions in evidence through customer research, usability testing, funnel analytics, and split testing, with clear metrics tied to conversion and customer experience
* Ensure designs meet accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA) and the disclosure and compliance requirements of a regulated lending business
* Hire, lead, and develop the design team, running a predictable cadence of critique, delivery, and accountability
* Use AI tools throughout the design process, from research synthesis to prototyping, and help the team do the same

**What We're Looking For**

* **Experience:** 8+ years of product design experience, with at least 3 years leading designers and owning design outcomes for a digital product at a growth-stage company. Experience in fintech, lending, or financial services is a strong plus.
* **Product Design Craft:** A portfolio that shows strong interaction design, visual design, and information architecture on complex, multi-step flows such as applications, onboarding, or dashboards.
* **Design Systems:** Hands-on experience building and scaling a design system, and working closely with engineers to implement it in code.
* **Tools:** Expert-level Figma skills, fluency with prototyping and AI-assisted design tools, and a working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and how front-end code gets built.
* **Research and Data:** Comfort running user research and usability tests, and reading product analytics to find friction and measure the impact of design changes.
* **Leadership Style:** Hands-on, execution-focused leader with strong cross-functional communication skills; able to give clear feedback, make decisions with incomplete information, and explain design choices to non-designers. **Must have experience managing at least 4 direct reports.**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Industry Perspective:** Experience designing for small business owners, B2B customers, or regulated, high-trust products such as lending, payments, or banking.
* **Conversion Design:** A track record of improving funnel conversion, application completion, or activation through measured design changes.
* **Brand Leadership:** Experience leading a brand refresh or building a visual identity system that works across product and marketing channels.
* **Content Design:** Skill at writing and shaping clear product copy, especially for financial terms, disclosures, and error states.
* **Organizational Scale:** Experience building a design function at an early or growth-stage company, including hiring, career leveling, and managing freelance and agency partners.

**This Role May Not Be a Fit If You**

* Want a strategy or advisory seat rather than hands-on ownership of the work that ships
* Have been out of the tools long enough that you'd need someone else to build the file or the prototype
* Prefer structured corporate environments with clear lanes and layers between you and the business
* Solve problems offline and come back with polished results, instead of sharing work early and communicating while you work
* Use AI tools to assist your old workflow, rather than having rebuilt your workflow around them

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Base salary range: $195,000+
* Performance bonus of up to 20% of base, tied to delivery and business outcomes
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Flexible PTO and observed holidays
* Remote-first, with support for your home-office setup
* Direct access to leadership and to the problems that matter

Cardiff, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Senior Director of Retail, North America
description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

Oura is seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Director of Retail, North America to lead the growth and commercial performance of Oura’s retail business across the region.This individual will provide leadership, direction, and resource stewardship to the North America retail sales function while owning relationships with some of Oura’s largest and most strategic retail partners. The Senior Director will shape joint business plans, lead complex negotiations, and ensure the organization delivers against ambitious revenue, market-share, profitability, and customer experience goals.As a senior commercial leader, the Senior Director will align retail objectives with Oura’s broader business strategy; influence executive stakeholders internally and externally; identify opportunities to expand distribution, productivity, and market share; and build the operating discipline required to deliver consistent results. This role will also lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing retail organization while partnering closely with marketing, product, finance, operations, supply chain, customer experience, and e-commerce teams.The ideal candidate brings extensive experience leading retail businesses in consumer electronics, connected devices, health technology, or a related category; a demonstrated track record of growing strategic accounts; strong executive presence; exceptional negotiation skills; and the ability to inspire teams through clear direction, accountability, and collaboration.

### **What You Will Do:**

**Retail Sales Strategy and Business Leadership:**

* Define and execute the North America retail strategy, translating Oura’s company priorities into clear channel, account, and team objectives.
* Lead annual and multi-year planning across select retailer portfolio, including sales strategy, forecasting, budgeting, assortment, distribution, and investment priorities.
* Identify and capitalize on market opportunities to drive revenue growth, market share, customer acquisition, and long-term brand strength.
* Establish the operating cadence, performance standards, and decision-making processes required to deliver retail goals at scale.
* Serve as a senior voice for retail in cross-functional and executive planning forums, ensuring retail considerations are incorporated early into product launches, innovation, and go-to-market decisions.

* Build trusted, multi-level relationships with retailer executives and decision-makers across merchandising, marketing, operations, finance, and e-commerce.
* Lead high-stakes negotiations covering commercial terms, pricing, promotions, assortment, placement, merchandising, marketing support, and operational commitments.
* Develop account strategies that balance near-term performance with long-term partnership value, sustainable economics, and customer experience.
* Represent Oura with credibility and influence in executive customer meetings, business reviews, industry forums, and strategic negotiations.

**Sales Performance Management:**

* Set and achieve revenue, margin, distribution, sell-through, inventory, and market-share targets across North America retail.
* Monitor business performance, diagnose trends and risks, and adjust strategies quickly to deliver against commitments.
* Evaluate and optimize retail investments, including MDF/CO-OP, conditional and unconditional rebates, merchandising, promotions, and administrative support.
* Create clear performance narratives and recommendations for senior leadership, using financial, market, category, and customer insights to guide decisions.
* Partner with finance and operations to improve forecasting accuracy, inventory health, profitability, and commercial discipline.

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing retail sales organization with clear roles, priorities, goals, and accountability.
* Build a strong leadership bench by coaching managers and senior individual contributors and creating meaningful opportunities for growth.
* Set a high bar for executive communication, customer leadership, analytical rigor, and follow-through.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, inclusion, ownership, and continuous improvement across the retail team and broader organization.
* Support recruiting, onboarding, performance management, succession planning, and organizational design as the business scales.

* Align internal stakeholders around retailer-specific priorities and resolve complex issues with urgency and sound judgment.
* Ensure account plans translate into strong field execution, compelling in-store and online experiences, and consistent delivery against retailer commitments.

**Market Insights and Executive Communication:**

* Maintain a deep understanding of the North American retail landscape, consumer behavior, competitive dynamics, category trends, and retailer strategies.
* Translate market and customer insights into actionable commercial strategies and clear recommendations.
* Provide regular executive updates on retail performance, account health, market conditions, opportunities, risks, and required decisions.
* Represent Oura’s brand, values, and commercial ambition with confidence and professionalism in every external interaction.

This is a remote role based in the US.

### **What you'll bring**

* Proven track record of growing revenue, market share, distribution, and profitability across major North American retailers.
* Experience leading complex negotiations and long-term business planning with senior retail executives.

title: Director, Communications | Full-Time | Remote
description:

title: Director, Logistics
description:
Finding the right place to grow your career isn't (over) easy, so we're here to help by sharing a few reasons why the grass is greener at Vital Farms. We think you'll appreciate our focus on Conscious Capitalism, which drives business decisions that benefit all our stakeholders (leading to even better business results). You might be drawn to our innovative approach and refusal to settle for the "way things have always been done." Or you could find it exciting to grow your skills while working for an industry-leading brand. Whether you're into our values, our brand, or our egg-cellent puns, we hope you'll join our Crew and help us change the world 108 square feet at a time!

At Vital Farms, we're proud of the diverse communities we serve and the stakeholders who help bring our purpose to life. We're committed to fostering an inclusive and collaborative environment where every crew member feels valued. We see this as one of our greatest strengths - and your role is key to helping us build on it.

**Your Role:**

This position reports to the Vice President, Supply Chain.

You know that great logistics is more than moving product from one place to another. It is how we protect quality, deliver for our customers, support our farmers and crew, and grow responsibly. You bring a strong mix of strategy and operational leadership, and you are just as comfortable setting the direction for the network as you are working through a transportation disruption, a provider performance issue, or a difficult cost and service trade-off.

At Vital Farms, you will lead our end-to-end logistics network across inbound farm transportation, outbound customer transportation, warehousing, cold storage, and distribution. You will build the systems, partner relationships, operating rhythms, and team capabilities needed to deliver reliable service, preserve cold-chain integrity, manage cost, and scale with the business.

**What You'll Do:**

You will own the logistics strategy and lead the team and external partners responsible for moving and storing finished goods safely, reliably, and efficiently across the Vital Farms network.

**Lead the logistics strategy and network**

* Set and execute a logistics strategy that supports Vital Farms' growth, customer commitments, stakeholder model, and evolving supply chain operating model.
* Own short- and long-range capacity planning across transportation, cold storage, warehousing, and distribution; identify constraints early and build practical contingency plans.
* Evaluate network design, lane strategy, storage footprint, and operating models to improve service, resilience, scalability, and total delivered cost.
* Translate logistics performance, risks, trade-offs, and required decisions into clear recommendations for Supply Chain and company leadership.

**Own inbound and outbound transportation performance**

* Oversee inbound transportation from farms and suppliers and outbound transportation to customers and distribution points.
* Lead governance for dedicated fleet and managed transportation partners, including routing, appointment scheduling, load building and optimization, tendering, carrier performance, freight claims, and special requests.
* Use on-time pickup, on-time delivery, customer scorecards, freight performance, and exception data to set expectations, drive accountability, and improve service.
* Serve as the senior escalation point for transportation disruptions, balancing immediate recovery with root-cause correction and prevention.

**Lead warehousing, distribution, and 3PL partnerships**

* Maintain overall accountability for receiving, storage, inventory handling, order fulfillment, and shipping of finished goods across the network.
* Manage and strengthen relationships with third-party transportation, distribution, and warehousing providers through clear governance, contracts, performance reviews, KPIs, and corrective action plans.
* Partner with site, Quality, and distribution leaders to maintain food safety, cold-chain integrity, inventory accuracy, pallet and load quality, and consistent shipment standards.
* Support new facility and distribution-capability readiness, including operating requirements, systems integration, launch planning, and transition into sustainable operations.

**Build financial and operational discipline**

* Develop and own logistics budgets and forecasts, including transportation, warehousing, distribution, accessorial, claims, and related operating costs.
* Identify cost drivers and loss areas, build fact-based recommendations, and deliver sustainable savings without compromising food safety, quality, crew safety, or customer service.
* Establish a practical KPI and operating-review cadence that creates one shared view of service, inventory flow, capacity, cost, risks, and actions.
* Partner with Finance and Supply Chain peers on forecasts, accruals, variance reviews, customer pickup economics, and business cases for logistics investments.

**Advance systems, data, and continuous improvement**

* Improve the integration and effective use of D365, transportation management systems, warehouse management systems, 3PL platforms, automation, and reporting tools.
* Connect operational data across internal and partner systems so teams can identify issues quickly and translate insights into action.
* Lead continuous improvement across transportation and distribution, including standard work, exception management, claims, inventory handoffs, customer feedback loops, and escalation paths.
* Partner with IT, Operations Development, and external providers to improve system reliability, visibility, controls, and readiness for future growth.

**Lead the team and cross-functional partnerships**

* Lead, coach, and develop the Logistics team with clear roles, priorities, decision rights, and accountability for results.
* Build strong working relationships across Farm Support, Operations, Supply Chain Planning, Customer Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, IT, and commercial teams.
* Create a culture of urgency, ownership, constructive challenge, learning, and recognition while modeling Vital Farms' values.
* Build team capability and succession depth across transportation operations, analytics, systems, partner management, and network leadership.

**What You Bring to the Table:**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* You have 10+ years of progressive experience in logistics, transportation, warehousing, or distribution, preferably in food, beverage, CPG, or another temperature-sensitive environment.
* You have led a complex, multi-node logistics network and managed third-party transportation and warehousing providers.
* You understand transportation markets, carrier and fleet operations, warehousing and distribution, cold-chain requirements, and relevant regulatory considerations.
* You can manage budgets, analyze cost and service trade-offs, and deliver measurable operational and financial improvements.
* You have experience with ERP and supply chain execution technology, such as D365 or a comparable ERP, TMS, WMS, warehouse automation, and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* You use data and sound judgment to turn operational details and ambiguity into clear decisions and action plans.
* You communicate clearly, influence across functions, negotiate effectively, and lead through external partners as well as direct teams.
* You are a proven people leader who coaches, develops talent, and creates clear accountability.
* You are available to travel approximately 20-30% based on business needs, provider reviews, facility support, and network initiatives.
* Bonus points if you have launched or scaled logistics capabilities, facilities, automation, or major system integrations.
* You're no hero – You know the power of teamwork and celebrate the work of others before your own.
* You give a sh\*t – You believe in acting like an owner and making Vital Farms a place to be proud of.
* You raise the standards – You know growth can be hard, but you strive to improve yourself and others each day.
* You can walk in someone else's boots – You seek to understand other's viewpoints and think that you get to better answers by sitting on the same side of the table.
* You don't walk on eggshells – You're not afraid to leave the bullsh\*t behind and have honest conversations.
* We recognize that talent comes in many forms. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. You may have strengths we haven't yet considered!

**What We Bring to the Table:**

* A fast-paced, energetic, remote environment with passionate people who are leading a movement to bring ethically produced food to the table.
* Competitive pay and benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, and Paid Parental Leave, just to name a few).
* Generous retirement contributions: 401(k) + 3% Contribution from Day 1.
* Free eggs, along with friends and family discounts.
* Fun team SWAG that will make you the talk of the town.
* Professional development opportunities and an amazing team dedicated to your growth.

At Vital Farms, compensation decisions are dependent upon a variety of factors, which may include, but are not limited to, skill level, experience, education, training, market demands, and business needs. A reasonable estimate of the current starting annual base salary for this position is **$170,000 - $190,000**. Please keep in mind that hiring at the maximum end of the range would not be typical in order to allow for potential continued future salary growth.

**Who We Are:**

Vital Farms, a Certified B Corporation, offers a range of ethically produced foods nationwide. Started on a single farm in Austin, Texas, in 2007, Vital Farms became a national consumer brand that works with 600 family farms and is the leading U.S. brand of pasture-raised eggs by retail dollar sales. Vital Farms' products, including shell eggs, butter, hard-boiled eggs, and liquid whole eggs, are sold in over 24,000 stores nationwide.

title: Director of Planning | Poppy & Peonies
description:
Bloom is a full-service workplace design consultancy, proudly supporting Poppy & Peonies in their search for a Director of Brand & Social to join their dynamic team. As Talent Advisors, we serve as the bridge between our Bloom Partner and you throughout the recruitment process. At Bloom, we don’t rely on automated tools to sift through applications—every resume is carefully reviewed by a real person to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. If selected, you’ll join Poppy & Peonies directly as a valued member of their team. We’re excited to consider your application! Please note that applications will be accepted throughout the holiday season. Thank you for your patience and interest in this opportunity!

  

Hi, I’m Natalie Dusome, Founder and CEO of Poppy & Peonies, a fun and energetic brand that believes styles and function should co-exist. We’re passionate about creating practical pieces that help make life a little easier and lighten the load, literally.

Building Poppy & Peonies has been a wild adventure. The journey began when my daughter Poppy was born and my accessories no longer worked with my new life as a mom, I needed bags with pockets and organization that looked cool and had functionality. I couldn’t find it, so I decided to create it, and in 2015 Poppy & Peonies was born.

We’ve come a long way in five years – from filling orders in my basement to appearing on Dragons’ Den, and now, expanding into new product categories and collaborating with some exciting influencers and brands. I’d be lying if I said it’s been nothing but smooth sailing, but thanks to our incredible community, we’ve never felt more loved and supported!

We believe in our responsibility to care for our environment and we are passionate about preserving the health and welfare of our planet, and the animals that live on it. All of our bags are made from high-quality vegan leather, and our entire product line is vegan, cruelty-free, and PETA-approved. We ship our products plastic-free and we use a combination of recycled, compostable, and biodegradable materials to mitigate shipping waste, and we are constantly looking for new ways to make our products and supply chain more sustainable to reduce our carbon footprint.

**About the Role**

The Director of Planning will lead the integrated Demand Planning, Supply Planning, and Inventory Planning functions at Poppy & Peonies.

This role is responsible for translating commercial plans into actionable inventory and purchasing strategies, ensuring the right products are available in the right quantities, at the right locations, and at the right time.

Working closely with Merchandising, Product Development, Marketing, Finance, Sourcing, and Operations, the Director will establish a disciplined Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process that balances revenue growth, product availability, inventory productivity, and cash flow.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and financial acumen with hands-on planning experience in a fast-paced consumer products environment. They are comfortable working at both strategic and operational levels, building scalable processes while actively managing forecasts, inventory, and purchasing decisions.

### **The Opportunity**

**Demand Planning & Forecasting**

* Own the end-to-end demand forecasting process across all product categories, sales channels, and markets.
* Develop and maintain rolling demand forecasts at the SKU, category, channel, and distribution center levels.
* Partner with Merchandising, Marketing, and eCommerce to incorporate product launches, promotional activities, seasonality, marketing investments, and business growth assumptions into forecasts.
* Lead forecast reviews, analyze actual performance against projections, identify demand trends, and continuously improve forecast accuracy.
* Develop forecasting methodologies for new product introductions, core replenishment products, and seasonal collections.
* Identify demand risks and opportunities early and recommend actions to optimize sales and inventory performance.

**Supply Planning & Purchasing**

* Translate demand forecasts into actionable supply and purchasing plans, considering inventory on hand, open purchase orders, production lead times, transportation lead times, and safety stock requirements.
* Own the inventory purchasing plan and recommend purchase order quantities, timing, and replenishment strategies.
* Partner with Global Sourcing and suppliers to align production capacity, lead times, and delivery schedules with business requirements.
* Support new product launches by ensuring purchase orders and inventory availability align with launch milestones.
* Proactively identify supply constraints, potential shortages, and excess inventory risks, developing mitigation plans in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
* Balance product availability with inventory investment and working capital objectives.

**Inventory Planning & Optimization**

* Develop and execute inventory strategies across multiple distribution centers in Canada and the US.
* Establish and manage inventory targets, safety stock policies, and SKU classifications based on demand patterns, product lifecycle, and business priorities.
* Monitor weeks of supply (WOS), inventory turns, stock availability, and aging inventory.
* Recommend inventory allocation and replenishment strategies across markets and distribution centers.
* Identify slow-moving and excess inventory and work with Merchandising and Marketing on appropriate actions.
* Optimize inventory positioning to improve service levels while minimizing carrying costs, transfers, and markdown exposure.

**Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)**

* Design, implement, and lead a structured monthly S&OP process, integrating commercial demand, supply capabilities, inventory investment, and financial objectives.
* Facilitate cross-functional planning discussions and drive alignment on a single, consensus-based operating plan.
* Partner with Finance to reconcile sales forecasts, inventory purchases, open-to-buy (OTB) plans, and financial targets.
* Provide leadership with clear visibility into demand and supply risks, inventory requirements, and key business trade-offs.
* Develop scenario planning capabilities to support business decisions related to growth, promotions, product launches, and supply disruptions.
* Establish clear planning cadences, accountability, and decision-making processes.

**Product Launch & Lifecycle Planning**

* Partner with Product Development, Merchandising, and Sourcing to support seasonal assortment planning and new product introductions.
* Develop initial demand forecasts and inventory buy recommendations for new collections based on historical performance, comparable products, and commercial assumptions.
* Align purchasing decisions with product development milestones, supplier lead times, and launch dates.
* Monitor launch performance and recommend inventory reallocation, replenishment, or exit strategies.
* Manage inventory planning throughout the product lifecycle, including introduction, growth, replenishment, and end-of-life.

**Planning Systems, Analytics & Process Improvement**

* Build scalable planning processes, reporting tools, and performance dashboards.
* Improve data quality, forecasting methodologies, and planning visibility across functions.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual planning activities and improve decision-making through systems and analytics.
* Develop standardized planning metrics, reporting cadences, and exception-management processes.
* Partner with Finance, Operations, and Technology to strengthen planning tools and data integration.

**Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Lead, coach, and develop the Planning team, establishing clear responsibilities, performance expectations, and development plans.
* Build a collaborative, accountable, and data-driven planning culture.
* Serve as the primary planning partner to Merchandising, Marketing, Finance, Product Development, Global Sourcing, and Operations.
* Communicate complex planning information clearly and translate analysis into practical business recommendations.
* Drive cross-functional alignment and ensure timely decisions to support business priorities.

### **What You Bring to the Table**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, Operations, or a related field.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in demand planning, supply planning, inventory management, or integrated business planning.
* 5+ years of experience leading planning teams or functions.
* Demonstrated experience managing end-to-end planning in a consumer products, retail, fashion, accessories, or eCommerce environment.
* Strong understanding of demand forecasting, inventory optimization, replenishment planning, and open-to-buy management.
* Experience establishing or leading S&OP processes.
* Advanced analytical skills, including strong Excel and financial modeling capabilities.
* Experience working with ERP, inventory management, and demand planning systems.
* Strong communication, influencing, and cross-functional leadership skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with changing priorities.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a direct-to-consumer (DTC) business with frequent seasonal product launches.
* Experience managing inventory across multiple countries, distribution centers, and sales channels.
* Knowledge of international sourcing, manufacturing lead times, and ocean freight logistics.
* Experience with Shopify, WMS, and business intelligence or planning tools.

### **The recruitment process**

* Video screen with Talent Advisor from Bloom
* Video Interview with Yongyi, COO
* Video Interview with Nat Bates, VP of Finance
* Video Interview with Nat Dusome, CEO and Founder
* Reference checks
* Offer

Applications will be accepted through the end of November. Candidates can expect to hear from us regarding next steps by November 30th 2026.

### **Location**

* We’re seeking an exceptional candidate based in the US or Canada who values the flexibility of remote work while embracing the excitement of in-person experiences.
* There will be occasional domestic and/or international travel for photoshoots, events, and team retreats.

### **Salary and Total Rewards**

* $1,000 annual allowance towards Poppy & Peonies product

We encourage you to share your desired compensation early in the interview process, but we also understand that as you learn more about the role and the full benefits package, your expectations might evolve. **Our Commitment to you.**

Please inform us if you require any accommodation, and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs. Requests for any accessibility-related assistance can be made to sarah@buildwithbloom.com.

However, we do not use AI to source, assess, screen, or interview candidates.
