title: Senior Director, E-Commerce
description:
Position Title: Senior Director, E-Commerce

Manager: VP of Marketing, Digital & Creative

Location: Remote - LA, NYC, San Francisco

**ABOUT CREDO**

Credo, a trusted voice in an under-regulated beauty industry and a recognized pioneer in clean beauty retail, is looking for a full-time Senior Director, E-Commerce. Powered by a deep commitment to healthy beauty, we challenge conventional ingredient standards and believe that consumers should not have to sacrifice wellness for high performance.

Credo Beauty has stood for beauty with the highest standard since 2014. The Credo Standard® leads the way in efficacy, safety and sustainability. It isn’t a marketing claim; it’s an institution.

Credo is also where innovative brands launch and loyalty follows. Ilia, Kosas and Westman Atelier each entered the market through Credo and grew from here.

And the runway is big: 11 million potential customers shop online with no Credo store near them. For most of them, the site and the app will be their first experience of Credo.

**POSITION PURPOSE**

Digital is 60% of Credo’s business: 48% on Credobeauty.com and 12% on an app we only launched in 2025. We’re looking for the strategist who decides where it goes next.

You’ll set the vision for how Credo grows online, make the big calls on platform, investment and customer experience, and build the plan, partners and team to get there. This isn’t a role for keeping the lights on. It’s for someone who sees where beauty retail is heading and gets us there first.

As head of E-Commerce, you’re the CEO of Credobeauty.com and the Credo app. You own the digital strategy and the P&L behind it, and you’re the voice of digital in leadership conversations. You’ll lead a team and a bench of agency and tech partners, with real autonomy to decide what we build, what we buy and what we stop doing.

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES**

As Head of E-Commerce, you’re the CEO of Credobeauty.com and the Credo app. You own the digital strategy and the P&L behind it, and you’re the voice of digital in leadership conversations. You’ll lead a team and a bench of agency and tech partners, with real autonomy to decide what we build, what we buy and what we stop doing.

**Deliver a 3-year growth plan**

Define where Credo’s digital business goes over the next three years: revenue, margin, and investment strategy on how the site, the app and our stores work together, and where we place our bets.

**Own growth and the P&L**

Own the revenue plan and the investment behind it, from acquisition through retention, and make the trade-offs that grow the business profitably.

**Build the next-generation experience**

Make Credobeauty.com and the app the best place to discover beauty: fast, personal, accessible, and as trustworthy as the Credo Standard itself.

**Grow the app into its own channel**

Take the app from launch to a full channel with its own strategy, audience and targets.

**Architect the stack**

Decide which platforms we build on and which partners we bet on, and lead us through a year of major replatforming.

**Turn data into direction**

Build the measurement that shows where we win and lose customers, and use it to steer the business, not just report on it.

**Build the team**

Lead and grow a high-performing team, and set the bar for how digital partners with Marketing, Merchandising, Stores, CX and IT.

**Offer and Promotions**

Work cross functionally with the team on offers and promotions, event mechanics, gift with purchases and pricing to drive digital results.

**PRIMARY RELATIONSHIPS**

Team: 1 direct report (Site Merchandising & E-Commerce Ops Manager) and open to build a team.

**SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

You’re a strategist who builds. You’ve taken a digital business to its next stage, you see around corners, and you can turn a vision into a plan leadership believes in and a team can execute. You know Shopify Plus and the tech behind it well enough to make the big calls, and you know which details matter.

* 8–10+ years in e-commerce, including owning the strategy and P&L for a multi-million-dollar DTC or multi-brand retail business.

* A track record of leading a digital business through a major inflection point: a replatform, a new channel or a step change in scale.

* Deep Shopify Plus expertise and the judgment to architect a modern commerce stack.

* Strong commercial instincts: forecasting, investment allocation and the full-funnel economics of acquisition and retention.

* A data-driven mindset, with GA4 and Triple Whale fluency and a habit of turning numbers into decisions.

* Experience leading teams and agency partners, and influencing at the leadership level.

**Bonus points:**

* Beauty or multi-brand retail experience.

* Mobile app, loyalty or omnichannel programs you’ve built and scaled.

* You already use AI tools like Claude to think faster, analyze data and find efficiencies, and you can’t imagine working without them.

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT HERE**

* Real ownership. You set the direction, and you’ll see it in the numbers.

* A standard worth working for. Every product we sell meets the Credo Standard, and that bar applies to the work, too.

* A moment to shape. Digital is already 60% of the business, and the next chapter is yours to write.

* Remote, with roots. Work from anywhere in the NYC, LA or San Francisco area.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**

We offer equal employment opportunity to qualified individuals without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We strongly believe that cultivating a diverse workplace gives a company strength. The combination of unique skills, abilities, experiences and backgrounds creates an environment that produces extraordinary results.

title: Managing Director
description:
**About BOI**
-------------

BOI is the AI deployment partner that Walmart, Coca-Cola, and Mastercard call when AI needs to drive growth, not just savings. We rebuild how work gets done, starting from the outcomes each team exists to deliver: agents do the work, people own the judgment, and the capacity it frees goes to growth.

We bring together the unusually strong in frontier enterprise AI, then give them the ownership to make it happen. If you're looking for a comfortable place to hide, we're not it. If you want to build the future of enterprise AI with people who will make you better: welcome home.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

### **Build Your Book of Business**

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and the revenue, margin, and pipeline behind them, with a plan you set and report on openly.
* Build relationships with C-suite and function leaders at large enterprises and mid-caps with a growth mandate.
* Originate, shape, and close multi-workstream programs, from first conversation to signed contract.
* Grow accounts outcome by outcome, based on value delivered rather than hours sold.
* Build a point of view in the industries or functions you know best, so buyers there know to call you.

### **Set the Bar for Delivery**

* Be accountable for the quality of every engagement you lead, from problem framing through build, deployment, and measured value.
* Start from outcomes: define what a team exists to deliver, map the work behind it, and design the roles where agents do the work and people own the judgment.
* Shape solution architecture across models, clouds, and platforms, and make build, buy, or configure calls you can defend to a client CTO. We're independent of every vendor, so the answer is whatever is best for the client.
* Step into the hardest moments on your engagements yourself.

### **Shape the Firm**

* Contribute to how BOI grows in the US as part of the leadership team, bringing what you hear from clients back into what we sell.
* Turn your client work into offers, case studies, and points of view that buyers cite back to us.
* Work with our growth team and partner ecosystem (labs, cloud providers, and firms that send us work) to build demand in your areas.
* Be a visible voice for BOI through speaking, roundtables, and thought leadership.

### **Develop the Team**

* Lead and coach Directors and consultants across your engagements, and help hire the people the US team needs.
* Champion AI-first ways of working through your own daily practice. Build your own tools and workflows, and share the ones that work.
* Set high standards, give direct feedback, and give credit generously.

**What We Look For**
--------------------

We are deliberately not for everyone. We look for a specific combination of qualities:

* You bring 15+ years of experience in consulting, agency, or custom solution environments serving enterprise clients, including several years at Partner, MD, or Principal level.
* You've built a book of business. You've originated and closed large, multi-workstream programs with senior buyers, and grown accounts over multiple years.
* You've led AI or technology programs that reached production and created measurable value, and you know the distance between a demo and a deployed system.
* You use AI every day and have built your own workflows, tools, or automations. You can go deep with a client CTO and to-the-point with a CEO.
* You take ownership far beyond your role
* You're confident but grounded: you own mistakes, invite critique, share credit, and make the team better.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* You'll build your own client portfolio with the backing of a firm that already works with some of the world's leading brands.
* The work is first of its kind: rebuilding how enterprises work from the outcomes down
* What your teams design goes live in client systems within weeks, and you see the value it creates.
* We're independent of every vendor, so you work across every model and cloud, building with whatever is best and swapping it when something better ships.
* The team is creative, ambitious, supportive, and never boring.

**Benefits**
------------

A competitive package with a meaningful performance-linked component, comprehensive health benefits, 401(k), 25 days PTO, professional development support, and the opportunity to work alongside some of the world's leading AI practitioners on high-impact enterprise transformations.

BOI is an equal opportunity employer: we celebrate diversity and welcome all backgrounds and identities.

1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. **Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.** We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

Brand, Product Marketing, Communications, and Creative tell Headway’s story to everyone we serve: patients looking for care, providers building their practices, and the health plans and health systems we partner with. Our team shapes who finds us, who trusts us, and who comes back.

We're looking for a Director of Consumer Communications and Social to build and lead that function from the ground up. This is a player-coach role for someone who wants to build and run a content flywheel across earned media, organic social, and content marketing — one that raises awareness of Headway and puts us in the right conversations in culture. You’ll own Headway’s share of voice across press, LLMs, search, social, and word-of-mouth conversations. You'll lead and grow a small team, and work hand-in-hand with the rest of Communications, Brand, and Product Marketing.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* **Consumer communications and earned media.** Set the messaging and strategy that build Headway's relevance in the news cycle, with a sharp eye for the cultural conversations where we belong. Maintain strong relationships with reporters at the consumer outlets that matter, and manage our agency partner.
* **A data storytelling content flywheel.** Work with our research and analytics teams to mine data, package it in a way a consumer actually wants to read, and distribute it across earned, owned, and social channels.
* **Organic social.** Build and lead the organic social team. Set our channel strategy, decide where we show up, and develop the content that drives real engagement.
* **Content marketing.** Own the content that fuels our patient brand communications across a variety of channels including blog, YouTube, substack — and build it to be found and surfaced wherever people (and increasingly, AI tools) are looking for answers.
* **Cultural relevance.** Keep a finger on the pulse of what's happening in culture, and know how to put Headway into that conversation in a way that's true to the brand. Be comfortable taking smart risks to create a real buzz moment.

**You'd be a great fit if…**
----------------------------

* You have 10+ years in consumer communications — ideally including at least 3+ years in-house leading teams. You’ve also led or partnered closely with social or content marketing.
* You've built a consumer communications or brand function from the ground up before.
* You have deep media relations skills, real relationships with reporters at relevant consumer outlets, and experience managing an agency.
* You're a strong data storyteller who knows how to turn research and analytics into something a consumer will actually engage with.
* You've led organic social — you know how to pick the channels that matter, build content that performs, and grow real engagement, not vanity metrics.
* You're a builder and a player-coach — energized by standing up a small team and getting your hands dirty at the same time.
* You have sharp cultural instincts and the courage to take a risk to create a moment, always in a way that's additive to the brand, never off of it.
* You do not shy away from taking (calculated) risks and you are full of creative ideas for buzz moments and angles that break through noise and generate real attention.
* Bonus points if you've worked in mental health or another regulated industry.

This is a rare moment — Headway is at the inflection point where scale meets credibility, and the person who builds this function will leave a lasting mark on how behavioral health is delivered and funded in America. If that sounds like the challenge you've been waiting for, we'd love to meet you.

**Comprehensive benefits:**
---------------------------

Medical, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, 401(k) including match for 2027!, Carrot Fertility reimbursement, and paid parental, medical and caregiver leave.

We believe a team's strength is in its people, and we cannot achieve this mission without a team that reflects the diversity of this problem – across race, ethnicity, gender, sexuality, age, national origin, religion, family status, disability, military status, and experience. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please inform the recruiter when they contact you to schedule your interview.

As a privately-owned, biopharmaceutical company, Ferring pioneers and delivers life-changing therapies that help people build families and live better lives. Our independence helps us cultivate an entrepreneurial spirit and long-term perspective that enables us to achieve growth and scale, while remaining agile and true to our ‘people first’ philosophy. Built on a 70-year plus commitment to science and research, Ferring is relentless in its pursuit of science that drives powerful discoveries and therapies to help people build families, stay healthy, and stand up to the world’s oldest enemy: disease.
  
  
Director Marketing, Specialty Care has end-to-end accountability for EUFLEXXA, one of Ferring’s top brands and a mature, market-leading hyaluronic acid brand for osteoarthritis of the knee. The role leads brand strategy and execution in the US, translating commercial priorities into annual and multi-year plans, performance goals, budgets and practical deliverables. The Director stewards the brand’s differentiated value proposition in a competitive buy-and-bill market, balancing demand, access, investment and profitability.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership opportunity to own the complete brand agenda, from driving development of strategy across the cross functional team to working closely with field leadership to developing training and resources that enable optimal brand execution. Working closely with field leadership, field advisory teams and cross-functional partners, the Director leverages real time market insights and adapts to changing dynamics. Partner with Finance, Market Access and Commercial Operations to develop and execute aligned strategies that prioritize resources and deliver profitability. Success requires strong analytics, sound judgment with limited data, and the ability to move between strategic decisions and tactical delivery while incorporating feedback and monitoring results.
  
  
With Ferring, you will be joining a recognized leader, identified as one of “The World’s Most Innovative Companies” by
*Fast Company*
, and honored by
*Fortune*
with inclusion on its “Change the World List,” for addressing society’s unmet needs. Ferring US is also Great Places to Work® Certified, distinguishing it as one of the best companies to work for in the country.
  
  
Responsibilities:

* Lead brand performance and strategy presentations to the Leadership Team, translating trends, risks and opportunities into clear recommendations on priorities, investment and execution.

* Partner with Market Access leadership on access, pricing and contracting strategies and negotiations, preserving a compelling value proposition while managing price pressure and profitability.
* Lead annual and quarterly brand forecasting with Finance, analytics and commercial partners, providing direction on sales estimates, market assumptions and resource needs. Collaborate with Sales and Operations Planning and supply stakeholders to align supply forecasts with demand and support continuity.
* Partner with Training and field leadership to refine product and promotional training, and reinforce effective use in customer interactions.
* Engage customers and synthesize marketplace insights to anticipate changes and adapt plans. Ensure brand activities and materials follow applicable medical, legal, regulatory and compliance review processes.

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing or a related business discipline.
* At least 15 years of diverse commercial experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry. A broad set of experiences spanning sales operations/analytics, market access, marketing and/or sales is required.
* Demonstrated success developing and executing brand strategies, with experience managing mature, inline products and accountability for commercial performance. Experience commercializing products in buy-and-bill markets is required.

* Proven financial acumen and experience managing brand budgets, resource trade-offs and profit-conscious lifecycle decisions.

  population

**The Impact**

The Benefits: At Granicus, we offer a **comprehensive and flexible benefits package** designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance—starting from day one.

title: Director of Energy Storage Modeling and Design
description:
### **ROLE OVERVIEW**

Pivot Energy is seeking a motivated individual to join our Technical Operations team and lead the company’s Energy Storage modeling and design. The role covers market analysis, technical vendor evaluation, pricing, modeling, sizing, and design recommendations for our storage (DC-coupled with PV solar and standalone storage) project pipeline. This role combines aspects of engineering, collaboration with finance, operations, and policy teams with a goal of deploying and optimizing our storage pipeline.

The Director will be responsible for technical analysis of all solar- plus-storage (DC-coupled) and standalone energy storage market opportunities, including optimal system sizing. The Director will work with the market strategy, policy, and finance teams on revenue modeling and financial analysis, and with Estimation, Procurement, and Commercial Operations to optimize CAPEX and OPEX. The role also works regularly with project development leads and cross-team leads in Project Development Origination, Grid Interconnection, Engineering, Finance, Delivery, O&M, and Asset Management.The Director will have the opportunity to identify and vet potential areas of new energy storage business development, such as new geographies, programs, incentives, or procurements.

This is an opportunity to join a small team in a fast-growing market at an exciting and expanding company. This position offers significant growth potential at a B Corporation with operations across the USA.

### **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop and maintain MATLAB and Excel based revenue projections for solar plus storage and standalone storage projects by maintaining and / or creating new custom tools or using third-party applications
* Use internal Excel-based financial models, determine the cost and overall value of distribution-scale solar plus storage, and standalone storage projects
* Train internal personnel use energy modeling tools (MATLAB or third-party) with a goal of scaling Pivot’s ability to model storage projects and markets.
* Train, teach, guide, and collaborate with external personnel that will review our energy models, inputs, assumptions, equations, and code.
* Work with other Pivot teams on detailed modeling and design and on external quoting of storge model inputs including CAPEX and OPEX
* Support internal opportunity leads from the Commercial team to define project value and pricing terms to developer partners and for utility RFPs through market and project level modeling and design assumptions
* Work with key hardware and software vendors on technical evaluation, pipeline discussions, modeling assumptions, design, pricing, and equipment specifications to optimize project-level design
* Provide design direction including sizing and equipment selection to the Engineering team for project-level design and interconnection applications.
* Support the Market Strategy team in vetting potential new markets through quantitative analysis of sample projects
* Advance individual and team BESS knowledge through structured training, self-directed learning, and educational opportunities across Pivot.
* Build, manage and guide a small team of BESS experts consisting of engineering, analytics, modeling, and other expertise necessary to guide sound market and project decisions related to BESS.
* Support team members’ career growth by helping them think through the market drivers affecting BESS.
* Regularly document and share key insights from energy storage analysis process with relevant internal teams
* Track opportunities and analysis requests in Pivot’s CRM tools

### **REQUIRED COMPETENCIES**

Primary qualifications include demonstrated abilities to work collaboratively within a team, work collaboratively in cross team formats with other team leads, creatively solve quantitative problems, prioritize and manage a mix of short- and long-term deadlines, and professionally represent Pivot Energy externally. Experience in renewables and/or energy storage is required. The Director of Energy Storage Modeling and Design must be able to think critically and work with experienced renewables professionals to decipher the needs of a project/portfolio and find the best solutions in each scenario.

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (preferably Electrical Engineering with a focus on power system and energy system)
* Minimum 5 years of experience in the energy storage industry and storage project development
* Experience in the solar industry and solar project development
* Quantitative & qualitative problem-solving skills and strong communication skills
* Knowledge of renewable energy and project finance concepts
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple critical deadlines
* Passion for learning new things through self-directed study and structured settings
* High degree of proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel
* Willingness to work in databases such as Salesforce

### **PREFERRED COMPETENCIES**

* Master’s degree in a relevant field
* At least 10 years of experience in the renewable energy industry
* Experience in energy trading, wholesale energy markets, or other energy economics disciplines
* Experience with Ascend Analytics, Fractal or similar energy modeling software
* Ability to create and modify energy models and finance models using MATLAB or a similar tool.

$160,000 - $190,000 a year

### **COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

The base salary range for this position is $160,000-$190,000 depending on relevant experience, along with eligibility for the company’s substantial bonus plan, with a target bonus of 30% of annual salary (prorated in the first year based on start date).

  

Pivot Energy is dedicated to providing a great work experience for all employees, placing an emphasis on company culture and a focus on our people. To that end, Pivot offers an outstanding benefits package that includes:

* Excellent health/dental/vision insurance benefits with up to 100% of premiums covered by the company
* Four weeks of vacation in year 1, with increasing vacation accrual rates based on work anniversary date
* Company paid life insurance and short- & long-term disability coverage
* Generous parental leave
* 401(k) matching (after vesting period)
* Work from home stipend for new employees
* Public transit reimbursement
* PTO for volunteering in the community
* Charitable donation matching up to $500/year
* Professional development and educational reimbursements

A complete list of all the benefits Pivot offers may be provided upon request.

**Recruitment Agency Notice**:

We appreciate your interest in partnering with us; however, we are not seeking recruitment agency support for this role.

**ABOUT PIVOT**

Pivot Energy is a national renewable energy provider that develops, finances, builds, owns, and manages solar and energy storage projects that help decarbonize our nation’s electricity, increase equitable access to clean energy for local communities, and provide real cost-savings to American businesses and

families.

We are fiercely dedicated to accelerating the rapid transition taking place in the energy industry to a more decentralized and cleaner approach to power generation. We are committed to positively contributing to the local communities and people we serve with more than clean energy. We believe global warming poses an existential threat to our planet and that we have a responsibility to help mitigate the threat. Our portfolio includes projects that reduce energy burden for income-limited families, create workforce pathways for under-represented groups within the solar industry, and include robust community investment opportunities.

As a Certified B Corporation and one of **Denver’s “Best Places to Work”****,** we believe that company success is driven by a healthy environment, thriving society, and workplace where all individuals are respected. We evaluate every internal decision on environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors to determine if our actions will result in a net positive impact on the community, our employees, customers, shareholders, and the environment. Learn more in our annual ESG Report.

At Pivot, our core values guide our work internally and externally:

* Impact – We hold ourselves accountable to having a measurable impact on our people, communities, and the planet
* Balance – Put family first; work hard/have fun
* Determination – Find ways to be successful no matter how difficult the challenge
* Professionalism – Impress everyone we touch, be a team player
* Honesty – Be truthful and transparent, externally and internally
* Kindness – Create an environment where kindness, empathy, and vulnerability are embraced

**DIVERSITY, EQUITY, INCLUSION and JUSTICE STATEMENT**

At Pivot, we are proactively developing and maintaining an inclusive culture, rooted in mutual respect, that supports a workforce of different generations, races, gender identities, sexual orientations, ability statuses, religions, and cultures to work collaboratively together for greater impact. We seek to build a team that invests in relationship building, celebrates each other’s successes, and makes space for the unique contributions and working styles people bring into Pivot.

Pivot Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to increasing the diversity of its workforce. We actively work to cultivate an inclusive culture that welcomes, empowers, and enables equitable career growth for employees regardless of background.

title: Director, Product Design
description:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.

As Director of Product Design, you will lead the design organization responsible for how customers and administrators experience Menlo Security's Enterprise Secure Browser platform, from the first-run configuration dashboard experience to the policies that keep global enterprises safe. You will set the design philosophy, user and administrator dashboards quality bar, and research and accessibility standards for the entire product organization, and build the team, tooling, and operating rhythms that make excellent work the default. Partnering closely with VP-level leaders across Product, Engineering, Data, and Go-to-Market, you will make design a strategic driver of product direction and competitive differentiation in enterprise security, where clarity and trust matter as much as capability. You will also lead how the design team utilizes AI,how we leverage AI to continue to improve our user interfaces, and build shared workflows that speed up research synthesis, exploration, and quality review while keeping human judgment at the center.

**Outcomes & KPIs**
-------------------

**Key Outcome(s) Owned:**

* A consistently high-quality, accessible, and cohesive product experience across all Menlo surfaces that measurably improves customer adoption, satisfaction, and retention.
* A high-performing, well-led design organization with the systems, standards, and talent to scale with the business.

**Success Metrics / KPIs:** *(suggested; hiring manager to confirm)*

* Improvement in product usability and customer satisfaction measures (e.g., task success rates, SUS/CSAT, or NPS for key workflows) year over year.
* Accessibility conformance (e.g., WCAG 2.2 AA) across core product surfaces, tracked through defined quality gates.
* Design system adoption and consistency across product teams, along with fewer design-related defects reaching production.
* Measurable time saved or quality improved through AI-enabled design workflows adopted across the team.
* Team health and growth indicators, including engagement scores, retention of top talent, and internal promotion readiness.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Lead, grow, and coach a team of product designers and design managers, investing meaningful time in talent development, setting clear performance expectations, and making timely talent decisions.
* Define the craft philosophy, quality standards, and review processes that govern interaction design, visual design, and accessibility across the full product organization, and build the design systems and frameworks that sustain them at scale.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, and Go-to-Market leaders to shape multi-quarter and multi-year product vision, influence roadmap and investment decisions, and protect design intent through implementation.
* Establish the organization's research and accessibility practice, embedding evidence-based decision-making and company-wide accessibility standards into roadmap planning and product quality gates.
* Demonstrate design's business impact through outcome tracking and clear business cases, and represent design strategy and results at the VP and executive level.
* Design and scale AI-enabled workflows for the team, such as using AI to synthesize research and customer feedback, generate and explore early concepts, and support accessibility and consistency checks, and evaluate AI tools for fit, risk, and ROI.
* Build cross-functional forums and operating rhythms that bring the customer's perspective into how Menlo plans, prioritizes, and makes decisions.

**Functional Competencies**
---------------------------

**Required:**

* 12+ years of product design experience, including 5+ years leading design teams with managers reporting to you, ideally in B2B or enterprise SaaS.
* A portfolio showing advanced craft in UX, interaction, and visual design for complex products, and how you have raised quality standards across multiple teams.
* Experience building or scaling a design system and establishing design review and quality processes across a product organization.
* Depth in user research methods and accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG), with a track record of embedding both into product decisions.
* Proven ability to influence executive and C-suite stakeholders, connect design work to business outcomes, and shape product strategy and roadmaps.
* Hands-on fluency with AI tools in design and research workflows, with experience guiding a team's adoption of them responsibly.

**Preferred / Nice to Have:**

* Experience designing for cybersecurity, networking, or IT/security administrator audiences.
* Experience designing AI-powered or agentic product experiences.
* Experience leading content design or UX writing alongside product design.
* External presence in the design community, such as speaking, writing, or mentoring.
* Bachelor's degree in design, HCI, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Menlo Mindsets**
------------------

The Menlo Mindsets serve as our strategic operating system, directly linking our daily behaviors to the business results we need to achieve by defining exactly "how" we do our work. By establishing this clear, shared standard, they empower our most successful employees to consistently drive the innovation and accountability required for our long-term success.

* **Proactive Leadership** — I do not settle for the status quo. I take ownership, make informed decisions, and proactively communicate to drive results while empowering others to do the same.
* **Straight Talk** — I share honestly and transparently, actively seeking diverse perspectives while encouraging the same.
* **United Impact** — I break down barriers to champion cross-functional collaboration, uniting diverse strengths with clear ownership to drive exceptional, aligned outcomes.
* **What it looks like in this role:** You align with Product, Engineering, and GTM leaders on shared priorities and build the forums that make design quality a company-wide responsibility, not just the design team's.
* **Elevated Talent** — I believe talent is our differentiator, upholding a high bar for performance and leadership and continuous development.
* **What it looks like in this role:** You spend real time developing designers and design managers, set a clear bar for craft and leadership, and know and actively grow the top talent across your organization.
* **Customer-Compelled** — Customer focus is my mission. I own their experience, prevent their challenges, and act with urgency to deliver value.
* **What it looks like in this role:** You bring research and customer insight into strategic planning, and work across teams to find and remove root-cause friction in the product before customers feel it.

Follow us on LinkedIn!

**Why Menlo?**

At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: **Proactive Leadership**, **Straight Talk**, **United Impact**, **Elevated Talent**, and **Customer-Compelled**. We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it — you'll thrive here.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability**.

Any resume submitted outside of this process will be deemed the sole property of Menlo Security. In the event a candidate submitted outside of this policy is hired, no fee or payment will be paid.***

title: Director, Product Design
description:
****🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!****
Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.
  
  
As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.
  
  
We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a strategic and inspiring Director of Product Design to lead our Buyer Design team, the group responsible for shaping the end-to-end experience for millions of users navigating our platform.
  
  
As the design leader overseeing the entire buyer journey, you'll drive the strategy and execution for everything from customer acquisition, activation, to retention and re-engagement. This includes onboarding, discovery surfaces (browse, search, ranking, personalization, taxonomy), the live shopping experience, customer service, our games team, and customer service flows.
  
  
You’ll be a true player-coach, equally comfortable building and developing a high-performing design team as you are rolling up your sleeves and doing the work yourself. You’ll help shape the team, establish clear career paths, mentor designers, and create an environment where people can grow and do their best work.
  
  
As a leader, you’ll help define the design strategy and set a clear vision for what our experiences can become, partnering closely with product, engineering, research, and business teams to turn that vision into a roadmap for the team.
  
  
As a practitioner, you’ll stay close to the work. You’ll move fluidly from defining the long-term experience vision to tackling specific product and feature-level design challenges - exploring concepts, prototyping ideas, and helping bring the details to life. This role is for someone who can lead through both direction and craft, knowing when to empower the team and when to jump in and design alongside them.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and scale a high-performing team of product designers across the buyer funnel.
* Define and drive the vision, strategy, and execution for the buyer experience in collaboration with cross-functional partners.
* Partner with research, data, and product to develop deep customer empathy and inform high-impact design decisions.
* Shape intuitive, elegant systems across discovery, live shopping, and post-purchase experiences.
* Ensure our experiences are accessible, inclusive, and delightfully human.
* Champion design quality and consistency across surfaces while enabling speed and iteration.
* Nurture a strong design culture through mentorship, feedback, and high standards for craft and thinking.
* Represent design in executive conversations and influence company-wide priorities.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years of product design experience, with at least 3+ years leading teams.
* A player-coach mindset-excited to mentor, but equally passionate about designing and solving problems hands-on.
* Strong portfolio showcasing interaction and visual design skills, with a track record of shipping successful products.
* Proven success designing and scaling customer-facing experiences across a complex funnel (acquisition through retention).
* Deep expertise in interaction design, systems thinking, and user-centered design.
* Strong understanding of search, discovery, personalization, and taxonomy design principles.
* Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, or live shopping platforms is a major plus.
* A strong collaborator who thrives at the intersection of product, business, and user needs.
* A portfolio that demonstrates thoughtful, elegant solutions to complex problems.

**Why You’ll Love This Role**
You’ll help define how the next generation of users discover, shop, and engage with sellers and communities they love. You’ll work alongside a passionate and ambitious team that values joy, experimentation, and deep customer empathy. And you’ll help build a design culture where creativity and performance go hand in hand.
  
  
If you’re an experienced design leader who loves craft, strategy, and collaboration, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
****Reporting Structure****
Jon Malkemus - VP of Design
